meanings_summary.en: farmer; peasant; agricultural worker
meanings_summary.es: agricultor; campesino; trabajador agrícola

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The people (民) who dedicate their lives to cultivating the agricultural soil (农) are farmers (农民).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La gente (民) que entrega su vida al trabajo de la agricultura (农) constituye el campesinado (农民).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Traditional Chinese society was founded on agriculture ('以农为本'). Farmers formed the essential moral, physical, and economic bedrock of civilization.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two consecutive rising second tones: nóng mín (35-35). Ensure both syllables rise smoothly from mid to high without truncation.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 农民 specifically identifies people whose livelihood and identity are tied to agricultural cultivation and rural life.

contrasts.analysis: 农民 refers specifically to agricultural laborers working in fields, whereas 工人 refers to industrial, factory, or manual construction laborers.
农民 is the standard modern socioeconomic and statistical term for the peasantry, whereas 农夫 carries a classical, poetic, or ancient literary overtone.
农民 designates an occupational and social class centered on farming, whereas 乡民 emphasizes geographic residence (villagers/country folk) regardless of occupation.

Compare with 氏 (shì, clan) which lacks the internal cross-stroke
Combines 亡 (perish) and 民 (people)
Has 目 (eye) radical on the left of 民

senses.definition_en: a person who works in agriculture or lives in rural agricultural communities
senses.definition_es: campesino; persona que trabaja en el campo o la agricultura
senses.example_phrase: 当地农民 (local farmers)

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对连年歉收的土地，勤劳的农民依然日出而作、日落而息，盼望着来年能有好收成。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì liánnián qiànshōu de tǔdì, qínláo de nóngmín yīrán rì chū ér zuò, rì luò ér xī, pànwàng zhe láinián néng yǒu hǎo shōucheng.
example_sentences.en: Facing land with consecutive poor harvests, hardworking farmers still labor from sunrise to sunset, hoping for a good yield next year.
example_sentences.es: Frente a tierras con cosechas escasas año tras año, los diligentes campesinos siguen trabajando de sol a sol, con la esperanza de tener una buena cosecha el año venidero.

example_sentences.hanzi: 近年来，国家出台了一系列惠农政策，切实提高了农民的收入水平和农村的生活品质。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jìnniánlái, guójiā chūtái le yí xìliè huìnóng zhèngcè, qièshí tígāo le nóngmín de shōurù shuǐpíng hé nóngcūn de shēnghuó pǐnzhì.
example_sentences.en: In recent years, the state has enacted a series of pro-agriculture policies, effectively raising farmers' income levels and rural living quality.
example_sentences.es: En los últimos años, el Estado ha promulgado una serie de políticas de apoyo al agro, mejorando de manera tangible los ingresos de los agricultores y la calidad de vida rural.

work when the sun rises; peasant rhythm of life
intensive farming; meticulous cultivation
spring ploughing and autumn harvesting

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A farmer working under the broad sky clearing fields with simple tools.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un campesino trabajando bajo el cielo despejando los campos con herramientas manuales.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram depicting a common subject or people of the state.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: The collective eyes and hands of people laboring together across the land.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Los ojos y manos colectivos de la gente que labora unida en la tierra.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 春秋时期，许多出身底层的平民与农民在连年战乱中艰难度日。但正是那些懂得体恤双亲、辛勤耕作的纯朴子弟，以真挚的孝行留名青史，成为后世铭记的道德典范。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chūnqiū shíqī, xǔduō chūshēn dǐcéng de píngmín yǔ nóngmín zài liánnián zhànluàn zhōng jiānnán dùrì. Dàn zhèng shì nàxiē dǒngdé tǐxù shuāngqīn, xínqín gēngzuò de chúnpǔ zǐdì, yǐ zhēnzhì de xiàoxíng liúmíng qīngshǐ, chéngwéi hòushì míngjì de dàodé diǎnfàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: During the Spring and Autumn period, many commoners and farmers struggled through consecutive years of warfare. Yet those who cared for their parents and labored with genuine filial devotion became revered moral exemplars throughout history.
extended_reading_passages.es: Durante las épocas de guerras continuas, muchos campesinos humildes luchaban por subsistir; sin embargo, aquellos jóvenes leales que cuidaban con esmero de sus padres dejaron una huella imborrable de piedad filial.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在古代传统社会中，农民不仅是粮食的主要生产者，更是维系国家赋税与国防稳定的根基。每逢动荡与饥荒之年，农民承受的苦难尤为深重，因而休养生息与轻徭薄赋往往成为历代盛世的核心举措。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài gǔdài chuántǒng shèhuì zhōng, nóngmín bùjǐn shì liángshi de zhǔyào shēngchǎnzhe, gèng shì wéixì guójiā fùshuì yǔ guófáng wěndìng de gēnjī. Měi féng dòngdàng yǔ jīhuāng zhī nián, nóngmín chéngshòu de kǔnàn yóuwéi shēnzhòng, yīn'ér xiūyǎng shēngxī yǔ qīngyáo bófù wǎngwǎng chéngwéi lìdài shèngshì de héxīn jǔcuò.
extended_reading_passages.en: In ancient society, farmers were not only the primary producers of grain but the economic and defensive foundation of the realm. In times of war and famine, the peasantry bore the heaviest burdens, making tax relief and peace the hallmarks of flourishing dynasties.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la sociedad tradicional, los campesinos eran el cimiento del sustento nacional y fiscal. En periodos de conflicto o hambruna, padecían las mayores penurias, por lo que el alivio de cargas y la paz constituían la clave de las épocas doradas.

meanings_summary.en: for successive years; year after year; continuously over years
meanings_summary.es: durante años sucesivos; año tras año; año con año

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When calendar cycles link (连) continuously like marching carts across each passing year (年), events happen for successive years (连年).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando los ciclos se eslabonan (连) de manera ininterrumpida año tras año (年), transcurren años sucesivos (连年).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In agrarian history, consecutive years of good or bad weather ('连年灾荒' or '连年丰收') directly determined survival. The term emphasizes cumulative duration.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two consecutive second tones: lián nián (35-35). Both rise with sustained melodious pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 连年 emphasizes events or conditions repeating or persisting across multiple calendar years without interruption.

contrasts.analysis: 连年 stresses uninterrupted continuation across consecutive years (连年丰收, 连年战争), while 常年 stresses customary all-year-round permanence (常年在外打工, 常年积雪).
连年 functions adverbially to convey an unbroken multi-year sequence, whereas 每年 simply specifies an annual frequency or rate per individual year.
连年 is strictly confined to year-scale intervals, whereas 接连 describes actions or occurrences happening in immediate rapid succession within minutes, days, or months.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 井 inside 辶 instead of 车
Has 元 inside 辶 instead of 车
Similar to 年 but lacks the horizontal base stroke and side hook
Vertical stroke pierces top, whereas 年 has an upper horizontal stroke

senses.definition_en: happening continuously or consecutively over multiple years
senses.definition_es: durante años consecutivos; año tras año
senses.example_phrase: 连年丰收 (successive bumper harvests)

example_sentences.hanzi: 由于连年干旱少雨，当地水库的水位急剧下降，给居民的日常生活带来了诸多不便。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú liánnián gānhàn shǎoyǔ, dāngdì shuǐkù de shuǐwèi jíjù xiàjiàng, gěi jūmín de rìcháng shēnghuó dàilái le zhūduō bùbiàn.
example_sentences.en: Due to consecutive years of drought and scarce rain, local reservoir water levels dropped sharply, causing many inconveniences for residents' daily lives.
example_sentences.es: Debido a la sequía prolongada durante años sucesivos, el nivel de los embalses locales bajó drásticamente, ocasionando inconvenientes en la vida cotidiana de los vecinos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 得益于技术升级与海外市场开拓，该制造企业实现了连年增长，营业收入屡创新高。
example_sentences.pinyin: Déyì yú jìshù shēngjí yǔ hǎiwài shìchǎng kāituò, gāi zhìzào qǐyè shíxiàn le liánnián zēngzhǎng, yíngyè shōurù lǚ chuàng xīngāo.
example_sentences.en: Benefiting from technological upgrades and overseas market expansion, the manufacturing enterprise achieved growth for successive years, repeatedly hitting record revenues.
example_sentences.es: Gracias a la modernización tecnológica y a la apertura de mercados en el exterior, la empresa manufacturera logró un crecimiento interanual continuo, alcanzando récords de ingresos.

incessant warfare and unending disasters
misfortunes never come singly
amply fed and clothed

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic and phono-semantic: carts (车) following one another in a line along the road (辶), conveying continuity.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Carts (车) following consecutively along a road (辶) form an unbroken line.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Carros (车) en marcha continua por el camino (辶) simbolizan una hilera ininterrumpida.

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 禾 (grain harvest cycle in ancient seal script)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph of a person carrying ripe stalk of grain (禾), representing the annual agricultural harvest cycle.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Carrying ripe bundles of grain marks the passage of a fruitful year.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Cargar espigas de grano maduro marca el cumplimiento de un ciclo anual de cosecha.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 春秋战国之际，列国争雄，天下连年征战不休。在动荡岁月里，田地荒芜，粮食短缺，百姓生活困顿不堪，许多仁人志士为守护年迈双亲而奔波劳碌，留下了令人动容的感人故事。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chūnqiū zhànguó zhī jì, lièguó zhēngxióng, tiānxià liánnián zhēngzhàn bùxiū. Zài dòngdàng suìyuè lǐ, tiándì huāngwú, liángshi duǎnquē, bǎixìng shēnghuó kùndùn bùkān, xǔduō rénrén zhìshì wèi shǒuhù niánmài shuāngqīn ér bēnbō láolù, liúxià le lìngrén dòngróng de gǎnrén gùshì.
extended_reading_passages.en: During the Spring and Autumn and Warring States eras, rival states fought unceasingly for successive years. In these turbulent times of barren fields and scarce food, common folk struggled deeply, yet devoted individuals braved great hardships to care for elderly parents.
extended_reading_passages.es: Durante épocas de rivalidad entre reinos, la guerra se prolongó año tras año. En medio del desorden, con campos yermos y escasez de comida, muchas personas abnegadas se desvivieron por proteger a sus ancianos progenitores.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 历史研究显示，古代社会的政权兴衰往往与自然灾害及连年战乱密切关联。长期的农业欠收与连年饥荒不仅会动摇国库储备，还会引发剧烈的流民迁移，促使执政者不得不反思民生保障与统治策略。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Lìshǐ yánjiū xiǎnshì, gǔdài shèhuì de zhèngquán xīngshuāi wǎngwǎng yǔ zìrán zāihài jí liánnián zhànluàn mìqiè guānlián. Chángqī de nóngyè qiànshōu yǔ liánnián jīhuāng bùjǐn huì dòngyáo guókù chǔbèi, hái huì yǐnfā jùliè de liúmín qiānyí, cùshǐ zhízhèngzhě bùdébù fǎnsī mínshēng bǎozhàng yǔ tǒngzhì cèlüè.
extended_reading_passages.en: Historical research indicates that dynastic fortunes were closely tied to natural catastrophes and consecutive years of warfare. Chronic crop failures and unending famines depleted state reserves and displaced populations, compelling rulers to reform policies.
extended_reading_passages.es: El estudio histórico muestra que la estabilidad dinástica dependía de resistir catástrofes y guerras sucesivas. Las cosechas fallidas año tras año vaciaban las reservas estatales y provocaban desplazamientos masivos, forzando reformas en la gobernanza.

meanings_summary.en: war; warfare; military conflict
meanings_summary.es: guerra; conflicto bélico; contienda armada

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When soldiers raise their halberds in battle (战) to fiercely contend (争) over territory, the destructive result is war (战争).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando los combatientes alzan las armas (战) para disputar (争) territorio, se desata la calamidad de la guerra (战争).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Chinese military philosophy (孙子兵法) views war as the most consequential affairs of state, emphasizing defensive caution and avoidance of armed conflict whenever possible.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone followed by high-level 1st tone: zhàn zhēng (51-55). Deliver 'zhàn' firmly, then maintain a crisp, stable high plateau on 'zhēng'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 战争 denotes large-scale, organized political and armed violence between states, nations, or organized military blocs.

contrasts.analysis: 战争 refers to an entire war or conflict spanning years and nations, while 战役 refers to a specific localized military campaign or operational battle within a larger war.
战争 is the macro-level geopolitical military clash, whereas 战斗 refers to micro-level combat or tactical fire-fights fought by soldiers on the front line.
战争 requires organized military operations, whereas 冲突 encompasses broader non-military clashes, diplomatic friction, or border skirmishes that may not escalate to full-scale war.

senses.definition_en: organized armed conflict between states, nations, or factions
senses.definition_es: lucha armada organizada entre naciones o facciones; guerra
senses.example_phrase: 发动战争 (launch a war)

example_sentences.hanzi: 那场旷日持久的战争给沿途村落带来了深重的灾难，许多家庭因此骨肉分离、流离失所。
example_sentences.pinyin: Nà chǎng kuàngrì-chíjiǔ de zhànzhēng gěi yántú cūnluò dàilái le shēnzhòng de zāinàn, xǔduō jiātíng yīncǐ gǔròufēnlí, liúlí-shīsuǒ.
example_sentences.en: That protracted war brought profound disasters to villages along its path, tearing families apart and leaving countless people displaced.
example_sentences.es: Aquella guerra prolongada trajo profundas calamidades a las aldeas circundantes, separando a familias enteras y dejándolas sin hogar.

example_sentences.hanzi: 国际社会应当积极倡导通过和平对话与外交谈判解决分歧，竭力避免战争的爆发。
example_sentences.pinyin: Guójì shèhuì yīngdāng jījí chàngdǎo tōngguò hépíng duìhuà yǔ wàijiāo tánpàn jiějué fēnqí, jiélì bìmiǎn zhànzhēng de bàofā.
example_sentences.en: The international community should actively advocate resolving disputes through peaceful dialogue and diplomatic negotiations, doing everything possible to avert the outbreak of war.
example_sentences.es: La comunidad internacional debe fomentar el diálogo pacífico y las negociaciones diplomáticas para resolver disputas, evitando a toda costa el estallido de la guerra.

fight a hundred battles and win a hundred victories
fight a battle on paper; armchair strategizing

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 戈 (bronze weapon of war) alongside 占 (phonetic), representing armed combat and military campaigns.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A warrior gripping a bronze halberd (戈) upon hearing the battle divination (占).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un guerrero empuñando una alabarda de bronce (戈) tras consultar el oráculo de batalla (占).

character_decomposition.sound_component: 彐/手 (hand reaching up from below contesting an object)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic compound: two hands reaching in opposite directions grasping and competing for the same item.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two pairs of hands grasping and wrestling for the same coveted treasure.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos manos que forcejean y disputan en sentidos opuestos por un mismo objeto preciado.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在频繁的动荡年代，战争让无数原本宁静的乡村化为废墟。孝子在烽火连天的乱世中，冒着生命危险奔走数千里，只为给年老的父母换取一口维持生命的温饱之粮。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài pínfán de dòngdàng niándài, zhànzhēng ràng wúshù yuánběn níngjìng de xiāngcūn huàwéi fèixū. Xiàozǐ zài fēnghuǒliántiān de luànshì zhōng, màozhe shēngmìng wēixiǎn bēnzǒu shù qiānlǐ, zhǐ wèi gěi niánlǎo de fùmǔ huànqǔ yì kǒu wéichí shēngmìng de wēnbǎo zhī liáng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In an era of turmoil, war reduced countless peaceful villages to rubble. Amidst unrelenting flames of conflict, filial sons risked their lives traveling vast distances just to secure bowls of grain for aging parents.
extended_reading_passages.es: En una época de constante caos bélico, la guerra redujo pacíficas aldeas a escombros. Hijos abnegados desafiaron graves peligros atravesando enormes distancias con el solo fin de obtener comida para sus ancianos padres.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 现代历史学家通过对古代文献的考证发现，长期的战争往往导致农田荒废、劳动力匮乏以及人口结构的急剧失衡。唯有建立起稳固的和平秩序，工农业生产才能重新复苏，社会文明方能持续向前发展。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xiàndài lìshǐxuéjiā tōngguò duì gǔdài wénxiàn de kǎozhèng fāxiàn, chángqī de zhànzhēng wǎngwǎng dǎozhì nóngtián huāngfèi, láodònglì kuìfá yǐjí rénkǒu jiégòu de jíjù shīhéng. Wéiyǒu jiànlì qǐ wěngù de hépíng zhìxù, gōngnóngyè shēngchǎn cáinéng chóngxīn fùsū, shèhuì wénmíng fāng néng chíxù xiàngqián fāzhǎn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Modern historians' analyses of ancient records reveal that protracted warfare inevitably triggered abandoned farmlands, acute labor shortages, and severe demographic imbalances. Only by fostering stable peace could production recover and civilization advance.
extended_reading_passages.es: El examen de documentos antiguos demuestra que la guerra continua provocaba el abandono del campo, escasez de mano de obra y desequilibrios demográficos. Únicamente instaurando una paz duradera podía reactivarse la producción y florecer la civilización.

meanings_summary.en: half of a lifetime; half one's life
meanings_summary.es: media vida; la mitad de la vida

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When you divide in half (半) the long generations and journey of human life (辈) marked by time (子), you get half a lifetime (半辈子).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Dividir a la mitad (半) la trayectoria de las generaciones y la existencia (辈) personificada (子) equivale a media vida (半辈子).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese cultural narratives, 半辈子 carries deep emotional resonance of enduring hardship for one's family, raising children, or toiling selflessly.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling 4th tone followed by falling 4th tone and neutral tone: bàn bèi zi (51-51-0). 'zi' is pronounced unstressed and light.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 半辈子 denotes the duration of half one's chronological life, frequently weighted with recollections of sacrifice, struggle, or dedication.

contrasts.compared_word: 半辈子 vs. 一辈子
contrasts.analysis: 半辈子 covers approximately half of one's lifetime, whereas 一辈子 encompasses an entire lifetime from birth to death.
半辈子 is a colloquial and warm oral expression, whereas 半生 is elegant, written, and literary.
半辈子 highlights accumulated duration and personal emotional struggle over decades, whereas 中年 objectively classifies an age demographic.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Similar upper horns to 半 but has three full horizontal strokes
Has horizontal top stroke and bottom level line instead of divided ox
Has 心 at bottom instead of 车
The upper component of 辈 without the 车 base

etymological_cognates.gloss_en: half a day; a long time

senses.definition_en: half of a person's lifespan, often reflecting hardship or prolonged experience
senses.definition_es: la mitad de la vida de una persona; media vida
senses.example_phrase: 辛苦了半辈子 (worked hard for half one's life)

example_sentences.hanzi: 父亲在田间地头辛勤劳作了大半辈子，如今终于能安享晚年、颐养天年了。
example_sentences.pinyin: Fùqīn zài tiánjiān dìtóu xīnqín láozuò le dà bànbèizi, rújīn zhōngyú néng ānxiǎng wǎnnián, yíyǎng tiānnián le.
example_sentences.en: Father labored tirelessly in the fields for over half a lifetime; now he can finally enjoy his twilight years in peace.
example_sentences.es: Mi padre trabajó incansablemente en los campos agrícolas durante más de media vida; hoy por fin puede disfrutar con tranquilidad de su vejez.

example_sentences.hanzi: 他在乡村教育一线坚守了半辈子，用知识的火种点亮了无数大山深处孩子的求学梦想。
example_sentences.pinyin: Tā zài xiāngcūn jiàoyù yíxiàn jiānshǒu le bànbèizi, yòng zhīshi de huǒzhǒng diǎnliàng le wúshù dàshān shēnchù háizi de qiúxué mèngxiǎng.
example_sentences.en: He persevered on the frontlines of rural education for half a lifetime, using knowledge to kindle the learning dreams of countless mountain children.
example_sentences.es: Dedicó media vida a la docencia en zonas rurales desfavorecidas, encendiendo con su saber los anhelos de superación de numerosos niños campesinos.

toiled and worried for half a lifetime

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 许多父母为了儿女的生活无忧，默默操劳了半辈子。他们从黑发熬到白头，将最美好的青春岁月毫无保留地倾注在家庭之中，这份深沉无私的爱意值得后辈用一生去感恩与铭记。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xǔduō fùmǔ wèile érnǚ de shēnghuó wúyōu, mòmò cāoláo le bànbèizi. Tāmen cóng hēifà áo dào báitóu, jiāng zuì měihǎo de qīngchūn suìyuè háowú bǎoliú de qīngzhù zài jiātíng zhīzhōng, zhè fèn shēnchén wúsī de àiyì zhídé hòubèi yòng yìshēng qù gǎn'ēn yǔ míngjì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Many parents toil selflessly for half a lifetime so their children may live free of hardship. Working from youth until their hair turns white, their devotion deserves lifelong gratitude.
extended_reading_passages.es: Muchos padres se desviven durante media vida para asegurar el bienestar de sus hijos. Entregando sus mejores años sin reservas, esa abnegación merece ser recordada y agradecida por siempre.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在传统传记文学中，主人公往往经历了大半辈子的颠沛流离与困厄磨难，才淬炼出坚毅沉稳的品格。正是这种历经半辈子的生活积淀，使其在风云变幻的历史关头能够展现出超越常人的担当与气魄。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài chuántǒng zhuànjì wénxué zhōng, zhǔréngōng wǎngwǎng jīnglì le dà bànbèizi de diānpèi-liúlí yǔ kùn'è mònán, cái cuìliàn chū jiānyì chénwěn de pǐngé. Zhèng shì zhè zhǒng lìjīng bànbèizi de shēnghuó jīdiàn, shǐ qí zài fēngyún-biànhuàn de lìshǐ guāntóu nénggòu zhǎnxiàn chū chāoyuè chángrén de dāndāng yǔ qìpò.
extended_reading_passages.en: In traditional biographies, protagonists often endure wanderings and tribulations for half a lifetime before forging resilience. This deep accumulation of life lessons enables them to shoulder monumental duties at pivotal historic junctures.
extended_reading_passages.es: En las biografías tradicionales, los protagonistas suelen sobrellevar penurias y desarraigo durante media vida para forjar su temple. Esta vasta experiencia les permite asumir responsabilidades extraordinarias en momentos decisivos.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A tired worker pauses, bows their head (页), and sits down to enjoy a well-deserved meal (顿).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un trabajador exhausto inclina la cabeza (页), hace una pausa y se sienta a degustar una merecida comida (顿).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Originally meaning to touch the head to the ground in kowtow or pause, 顿 shifted through discrete units of action to become the indispensable measure word for daily meals.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-falling 4th tone: dùn (51). When paired with 一 (yī), 一 undergoes tone sandhi to become 2nd tone: yí dùn (35-51).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 顿 serves as a classifier for bounded eating occasions, verbal scoldings, or actions of physical/temporal stopping.

contrasts.analysis: 顿 is the common colloquial classifier for any meal, whereas 餐 is more formal, lexical, and nominal.
顿 measures repetitive human interactions like scoldings or meals, whereas 番 measures prolonged mental effort or repeated processes.
顿 indicates a brief, momentary pause in rhythm, speech, or thought before continuing, whereas 停 denotes coming to a complete stop or cessation.

example_sentences.hanzi: 经过了一整天繁重的高强度劳动，一家人围坐在一起吃上一顿热气腾腾的晚餐，便是最大的安慰。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò le yì zhěng tiān fánzhòng de gāoxiàngdù láodòng, yì jiā rén wéizuò zài yìqǐ chī shang yí dùn rèqì-téngténg de wǎncān, biàn shì zuì dà de ānwèi.
example_sentences.en: After a whole day of strenuous labor, the whole family sitting together eating a steaming hot dinner was the greatest comfort.
example_sentences.es: Tras una agotadora jornada de intenso trabajo, sentarse en familia a compartir una comida caliente suponía el mayor de los consuelos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 发言人在宣布关键政策前略微顿了顿，环视全场后才郑重宣布了这项关乎民生保障的重要决议。
example_sentences.pinyin: Fāyánrén zài xuānbù guānjiàn zhèngcè qián lüèwēi dùn le dùn, huánshì quánchǎng hòu cái zhèngzhòng xuānbù le zhè xiàng guānhū mínshēng bǎozhàng de zhòngyào juéyì.
example_sentences.en: The spokesperson paused briefly before announcing the key policy, looking around the room before solemnly proclaiming this decision concerning people's livelihood.
example_sentences.es: El portavoz hizo una breve pausa antes de anunciar la política clave, observando la sala antes de proclamar solemnemente la resolución de bienestar social.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在那个物资极度匮乏的年代，能让父母吃上一顿安稳可口的白米饭，是许多游子心头最大的牵挂。为了这一顿热饭，他们不惜背负沉重的粮食，在风雪交加的山道上徒步前行。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài nàge wùzī jídù kuìfá de niándài, néng ràng fùmǔ chī shang yí dùn ānwěn kěkǒu de báimǐfàn, shì xǔduō yóuzǐ xīntóu zuì dà de qiānguà. Wèile zhè yí dùn rèfàn, tāmen bùxī bēifù chénzhòng de liángshi, zài fēngxuě-jiāojiā de shāndào shàng túbù qiánxíng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In an era of acute scarcity, providing elderly parents with a hearty meal of white rice was a traveler's deepest concern. For that warm meal, filial sons shouldered heavy sacks and trudged along snow-swept mountain paths.
extended_reading_passages.es: En épocas de extrema escasez, procurar que los padres disfrutaran de una comida reconfortante de arroz blanco era el mayor anhelo de un hijo. Por esa cena caliente, cargaban pesados sacos a pie por gélidos senderos montañosos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 传统礼仪中的“顿首”体现了古代士人对尊长最诚挚的敬意。而在日常生活中，“顿”作为量词记录了普通百姓的生活节律：从清晨到日暮，一家人围坐共享一顿简朴的餐食，凝聚着生生不息的家庭温情。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Chuántǒng lǐyí zhōng de "dùnshǒu" tǐxiàn le gǔdài shìrén duì zūnzhǎng zuì zhēnzhì de jìngyì. Ér zài rìcháng shēnghuó zhōng, "dùn" zuòwéi liàngcí jìlù le pǔtōng bǎixìng de shēnghuó jiélǜ: cóng qīngchén dào rìmù, yì jiā rén wéizuò gòngxiǎng yí dùn jiǎnpǔ de cānshí, níngjù zhe shēngshēng-bùxī de jiātíng wēnqíng.
extended_reading_passages.en: In traditional etiquette, bowing low (顿首) showed utmost respect. In daily life, 顿 serves as a measure word charting domestic rhythms: from dawn to dusk, a family gathering around a simple meal embodies enduring affection.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la etiqueta tradicional, inclinar la cabeza reflejaba profundo respeto. Asimismo, 顿 marca los ritmos cotidianos: de la mañana al anochecer, compartir una comida modesta en familia encarna la calidez y el afecto inquebrantable del hogar.

meanings_summary.en: to satisfy; to meet (needs/demands); satisfied; content
meanings_summary.es: satisfacer; cumplir; satisfecho; contento

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When water fills a vessel to the brim (满) and the feet stand grounded in sufficiency (足), one feels completely satisfied (满足).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando el agua colma la vasija (满) y los pies descansan firmes en la abundancia (足), uno se siente plenamente satisfecho (满足).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Traditional Chinese philosophy teaches that knowing what is enough brings peace and avoids disgrace (知足不辱). 满足 emphasizes inner contentment.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by rising 2nd tone: mǎn zú (214-35). 'mǎn' dips smoothly before transitioning cleanly up to the high crest of 'zú'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 满足 conveys both the objective fulfillment of conditions/demands and the subjective psychological feeling of sufficiency.

contrasts.analysis: 满足 emphasizes fulfilling requirements, appetites, or basic desires, whereas 满意 specifically conveys approval and pleasure toward an outcome or someone's performance.
满足 can function as a transitive verb or emotive adjective, whereas 充足 is purely an objective adjective describing abundant material or temporal supply.
满足 focuses on reaching an internal state of contentment, whereas 称心 means perfectly matching one's ideal taste or expectation.

example_sentences.en: As long as he could see his aging parents eat a bowl of hot rice, his heart would feel immense happiness and contentment.

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了满足国际市场对高品质低碳产品的旺盛需求，公司加快了生产线智能化改造的步伐。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile mǎnzú guójì shìchǎng duì gāopǐnzhì dītàn chǎnpǐn de wàngshèng xūqiú, gōngsī jiākuài le shēngchǎnxiàn zhìnénghuà gǎizào de bùfá.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 子路幼年家境贫寒，常常只能吃野菜充饥。然而只要能让父母吃上一顿饱饭，他的心中就感到由衷的满足。真正的孝心不在于财富多寡，而在于倾尽全力的真挚关爱。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǐlù yòunián jiājìng pínhán, chángcháng zhǐ néng chī yècài chōngjī. Rán'ér zhǐyào néng ràng fùmǔ chī shang yí dùn bǎofàn, tā de xīnzhōng jiù gǎndào yóuzhōng de mǎnzú. Zhēnzhèng de xiàoxīn bú zàiyú cáifù duōguǎ, ér zàiyú qīngjìn quánlì de zhēnzhì guān'ài.
extended_reading_passages.en: In youth, Zilu was very poor and often ate wild greens. Yet as long as he could serve his parents a full meal of rice, his heart felt deep satisfaction. Filial piety lies not in wealth, but in earnest devotion.
extended_reading_passages.es: En su juventud, Zilu era pobre y comía hierbas silvestres; sin embargo, con conseguir un plato de arroz para sus padres sentía una inmensa satisfacción. La piedad filial no radica en las riquezas, sino en la entrega sincera.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代消费主义社会中，人们往往容易陷入无休止的欲望追逐，而忽视了精神层面的富足。心理学研究表明，学会珍惜已有并满足于简单生活的人，其主观幸福感和心理抗逆力远高于不断追求物质攀比的群体。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài xiāofèizhǔyì shèhuì zhōng, rénmen wǎngwǎng róngyì xiànrù wúxiūzhǐ de yùwàng zhuīzhú, ér hūshì le jīngshén céngmiàn de fùzú. Xīnlǐxué yánjiū biǎomíng, xuéhuì zhēnxī yǐyǒu bìng mǎnzú yú jiǎndān shēnghuó de rén, qí zhǔguān xìngfúgǎn hé xīnlǐ kàngnìlì yuǎn gāoyú bùduàn zhuīqiú wùzhì pānbǐ de qúntǐ.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern consumer society, people easily fall into relentless material pursuits, neglecting spiritual enrichment. Psychological studies demonstrate that individuals who appreciate what they possess and find contentment in simple living enjoy higher well-being and resilience.
extended_reading_passages.es: En las sociedades de consumo, es fácil caer en la búsqueda insaciable de bienes descuidando el bienestar interior. La psicología demuestra que quienes valoran lo que tienen y se sienten satisfechos con una vida sencilla alcanzan una mayor felicidad y fortaleza mental.

meanings_summary.en: sentence-final particle expressing exclamation, excitement, change of state (fusion of 了 and 啊)
meanings_summary.es: partícula final que denota exclamación, entusiasmo o cambio de estado (fusión de 了 y 啊)

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: An exclamation from the mouth (口) pulling (拉) emotions together forms the joyful particle 'la' (啦).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Una exclamación que brota de la boca (口) proyectando (拉) emociones alegres da vida a la partícula 'la' (啦).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Linguistically, 啦 is the fused colloquial contraction of the perfective aspect marker 了 (le) and the exclamatory particle 啊 (a), conveying vivid immediacy and warmth in spoken dialogue.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Neutral tone: la (0). It is pronounced light, short, and toneless at the end of clauses, taking its pitch onset naturally from the preceding tone.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 啦 serves as a lively clause-final modal particle expressing emotional immediacy, relief, enthusiasm, or completion.

contrasts.analysis: 啦 embodies the emotional phonological fusion of 了 (completion) + 啊 (exclamation), sounding distinctly warmer, more enthusiastic, and animated than the objective grammatical marker 了.
啦 is exclusively declarative and exclamatory, whereas 吗 is an interrogative particle creating yes/no questions.
啦 conveys emotional certainty or celebration of fact, whereas 吧 conveys suggestion, consultation, or gentle probability.

example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò màncháng ér jiānxīn de báshè, niánqīng de Zǐlù zhōngyú bēizhe chéndiāndiān de mǐdài huí dào jiā la!
example_sentences.en: After a long and arduous journey on foot, young Zilu finally returned home carrying the heavy sack of rice!

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 当子路顶着刺骨的严寒与漫天风雪推开家门时，他激动地喊道：“爹，娘，我换到米回来啦！”这一声呼喊，道尽了数千里跋涉的辛劳与一家人团聚的无限欣慰。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Dāng Zǐlù dǐngzhe cìgǔ de yánhán yǔ màntiān fēngxuě tuīkāi jiāmén shí, tā jīdòng de hǎndào: "Diē, niáng, wǒ huàn dào mǐ huílái la!" Zhè yì shēng hūhǎn, dàojìn le shù qiānlǐ báshè de xīnláo yǔ yì jiā rén tuánjù de wúxiàn xīnwèi.
extended_reading_passages.en: When Zilu pushed open the door amidst piercing cold and snow, he cried excitedly: "Father, Mother, I've brought the rice back!" That cry released the exhaustion of miles traveled and melted into reunion.
extended_reading_passages.es: Cuando Zilu empujó la puerta desafiando el frío y la ventisca, gritó con emoción: "¡Padre, madre, ya regresé con el arroz!". Esa exclamación resumió el esfuerzo de la caminata y trajo un gozo inmenso al hogar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在汉语口语与现代叙事文学中，语气词“啦”往往能为平实的语句注入浓郁的生活情趣与生动情感。无论是欢呼丰收的喜悦，还是宣告难题迎刃而解的如释重负，一个“啦”字便能瞬间拉近说话者与听众之间的心理距离。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài Hànyǔ kǒuyǔ yǔ xiàndài xùshì wénxué zhōng, yǔqìcí "la" wǎngwǎng néng wèi píngshí de yǔjù zhùrù nóngyù de shēnghuó qíngqù yǔ shēngdòng qínggǎn. Wúlùn shì huānhū fēngshōu de xǐyuè, háishì xuāngào nántí yíngrèn'érjiě de rúshìzhòngfù, yí gè "la" zì biàn néng shùnjiān lājìn shuōhuàzhě yǔ tīngzhòng zhījiān de xīnlǐ jùlí.
extended_reading_passages.en: In spoken Chinese and literature, the modal particle 'la' infuses ordinary sentences with vivid warmth. Whether exclaiming joy over a harvest or sighing relief at solving a hardship, a single 'la' instantly bridges emotional distance between speaker and listener.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la lengua hablada y la narrativa china, la partícula 'la' infunde calidez cotidiana a las frases. Ya sea celebrando una buena cosecha o anunciando con alivio la solución a un problema, un simple 'la' aproxima al interlocutor con naturalidad afectiva.

meanings_summary.en: ashamed; guilty; mortified; conscience-stricken
meanings_summary.es: avergonzado; apenado; mortificado; con remordimiento

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When moral shortcomings cut the heart (惭) and guilt haunts the conscience like a ghost (愧), one feels deeply ashamed (惭愧).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando la falta hiere el corazón (惭) y la culpa ronda la conciencia como una sombra (愧), surge la profunda vergüenza (惭愧).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Confucian ethics, the sense of shame is regarded as the origin of righteousness. Recognizing one's unworthiness through 惭愧 is the prerequisite for moral self-cultivation.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by falling 4th tone: cán kuì (35-51). 'cán' rises steadily before dropping firmly into 'kuì'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 惭愧 focuses on inner moral unworthiness, guilt, or regret when measuring oneself against expectations, benefactors, or ethical ideals.

contrasts.analysis: 惭愧 arises from moral guilt, regret, or feeling unworthy of praise, whereas 害羞 refers to social shyness, timidity, or embarrassment.
惭愧 stems from falling short of moral duty or reciprocal expectations, while 内疚 focuses specifically on remorse for having harmed or let down another person.
惭愧 is an internal ethical emotion of remorse, whereas 难堪 describes the external awkwardness and social loss of face in an embarrassing situation.

senses.definition_en: feeling shame or distress due to one's shortcomings, errors, or unworthiness
senses.definition_es: avergonzado; mortificado por las propias faltas o insuficiencias
senses.example_phrase: 感到惭愧 (feel ashamed)

example_sentences.hanzi: 看到父母为了供自己读书而日夜操劳、省吃俭用，小明内心深感惭愧，发誓一定要加倍努力。
example_sentences.pinyin: Kàndào fùmǔ wèile gōng zìjǐ dúshū ér rìyè cāoláo, shěngchī-jiǎnyòng, Xiǎomíng nèixīn shēn gǎn cánkuì, fāshì yídìng yào jiābèi nǔlì.
example_sentences.en: Seeing his parents toil day and night and pinch pennies to pay for his schooling, Xiaoming felt deeply ashamed and vowed to redouble his efforts.
example_sentences.es: Al ver a sus padres desvivirse día y noche privándose de todo para costearle los estudios, Xiaoming se sintió profundamente avergonzado y juró esforzarse el doble.

example_sentences.hanzi: 作为项目负责人未能按期交付高质量方案，他当面向全体团队成员表达了真诚的惭愧与歉意。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi xiàngmù fùzérén wèinéng ànqī jiāofù gāozhìliàng fāng'àn, tā dāngmiàn xiàng quántǐ tuánduì chéngyuán biǎodá le zhēnchéng de cánkuì yǔ qiànyì.
example_sentences.en: As project lead failing to deliver a high-quality proposal on schedule, he expressed sincere shame and apologies directly to all team members.
example_sentences.es: Como líder del proyecto que no entregó la propuesta de alta calidad a tiempo, expresó una sincera vergüenza y disculpas ante todo el equipo.

collocations.en: be aware of one's own unworthiness
showing not the slightest hint of shame

idioms.meaning_en: feel unworthy and ashamed by comparison
feel inferior and humbled by another's superiority
so ashamed that one wishes the ground would swallow them up
feel at ease and justified with a clear conscience

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 忄 (heart/emotion) + 斩 (phonetic / knife cut), depicting the sharp, cutting internal sting of guilt in one's heart.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A heart (忄) stung sharply as if severed (斩) by moral remorse.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un corazón (忄) lacerado por el agudo remordimiento moral (斩).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 忄 (heart/mind) + 鬼 (ghostly guilt haunting the mind).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A heart (忄) haunted by shadowy spirits (鬼) of guilt and unworthiness.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un corazón (忄) perseguido por los fantasmas interiores (鬼) de la culpa moral.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 子路成年后官至大夫，出行车马相随，席上山珍海味。然而面对丰厚的俸禄，他却常常黯然神伤，心中满是惭愧与遗憾，只恨双亲早已不在，自己再也无法背米尽孝了。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǐlù chéngnián hòu guān zhì dàfū, chūxíng chēmǎ xiāngsuí, xí shàng shānzhēn-hǎiwèi. Rán'ér miànduì fēnghòu de fènglù, tā què chángcháng ànrán shénshāng, xīnzhōng mǎn shì cánkuì yǔ yíhàn, zhǐ hèn shuāngqīn zǎoyǐ búzài, zìjǐ zài yě wúfǎ bēimǐ jìnxiào le.
extended_reading_passages.en: Later in life, Zilu became a prominent official with chariots and delicacies. Yet amidst wealth, he felt deep shame and grief, lamenting that his parents had passed and he could no longer carry rice to care for them.
extended_reading_passages.es: Años después, Zilu alcanzó un alto cargo rodeado de carruajes y banquetes. Sin embargo, sentía una honda vergüenza y pesar, pues sus padres ya habían fallecido y jamás podría volver a cargar arroz para cuidarlos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 孟子曾言：“人不可以无耻，无耻之耻，无耻矣。”在儒家修齐治平的德性伦理中，知耻与惭愧绝非消极软弱的表现，而是个体省察自我缺失、明辨是非善恶的觉醒起点，更是推动人格自我升华与道德完善的精神动力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mèngzǐ céng yán: "Rén bù kěyǐ wú chǐ, wú chǐ zhī chǐ, wú chǐ yǐ." Zài Rújiā xiū-qí-zhì-píng de déxìng lúnlǐ zhōng, zhī chǐ yǔ cánkuì juéfēi xiāojí ruǎnruò de biǎoxiàn, ér shì gètǐ xǐngchá zìwǒ quēshī, míngbiàn shìfēi shàn'è de juéxǐng qǐdiǎn, gèng shì tuīdòng réngé zìwǒ shēnghuá yǔ dàodé wánshàn de jīngshén dònglì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Mencius declared: "A person must not be without shame." In Confucian virtue ethics, possessing a sense of shame (惭愧) is not weakness, but the awakening of moral conscience that drives personal elevation and ethical integrity.
extended_reading_passages.es: Mencio afirmaba que nadie debe carecer de pudor moral. En la ética confuciana, sentir vergüenza no es debilidad, sino el despertar reflexivo para discernir el bien del mal e impulsar la superación personal.

meanings_summary.en: to make up one's mind secretly; to resolve firmly in private
meanings_summary.es: tomar una determinación en secreto; resolver firmemente en privado

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: In the private darkness of the mind (暗), planting downward (下) a decisive breach (决) of will across the heart (心) means making up one's mind secretly (暗下决心).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: En la íntima penumbra del alma (暗), sembrar hacia adentro (下) una firme decisión (决) en el corazón (心) significa jurarse algo en secreto (暗下决心).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Chinese narrative tradition valorizes quiet, resolute inner oaths over empty verbal boasting. An oath sworn silently to oneself indicates deep maturity and indomitable endurance.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling-falling-rising-high: àn xià jué xīn (51-51-35-55). Note that '决' rises cleanly on tone 2, followed by steady tone 1 on 'xīn'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 暗下决心 highlights an internal, private psychological commitment forged without external declaration.

contrasts.compared_word: 暗下决心 vs. 下定决心
contrasts.analysis: 暗下决心 emphasizes that the resolution is formed silently in private without letting others know, whereas 下定决心 simply denotes forming a firm resolution, which can be announced publicly.

contrasts.compared_word: 暗下决心 vs. 拿定主意
contrasts.analysis: 暗下决心 carries intense emotional resolve, long-term moral weight, and determination, whereas 拿定主意 usually refers to making a practical choice or settling on a specific plan of action.

contrasts.compared_word: 暗下决心 vs. 立下誓言
contrasts.analysis: 暗下决心 is an unspoken mental vow, whereas 立下誓言 involves swearing an explicit verbal oath, often before witnesses.

senses.definition_en: to form a resolute, silent inward commitment without declaring it outwardly
senses.definition_es: tomar una decisión firme y callada en el interior de uno mismo
senses.example_phrase: 暗下决心改变现状 (secretly resolve to change the situation)

example_sentences.hanzi: 看到父母日渐苍老的面容和简陋的土屋，他在心底暗下决心，一定要通过自己的勤劳改变家庭的命运。
example_sentences.pinyin: Kàndào fùmǔ rìjiàn cānglǎo de miànróng hé jiǎnlòu de tǔwū, tā zài xīndǐ ànxià juéxīn, yídìng yào tōngguò zìjǐ de qínláo gǎibiàn jiātíng de mìngyùn.
example_sentences.en: Seeing his parents' aging faces and their humble earthen hut, he secretly resolved in his heart to change their family's destiny through diligent labor.
example_sentences.es: Al contemplar los rostros envejecidos de sus padres y la humilde choza, decidió en su interior con firmeza que cambiaría el destino familiar mediante el trabajo arduo.

example_sentences.hanzi: 经历了初创时期的重重阻碍与挫折，团队负责人暗下决心，无论面对多大压力都要坚持完成核心技术攻关。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīnglì le chūchuàng shíqī de zhòngzhòng zǔ'ài yǔ cuòzhé, tuánduì fùzérén ànxià juéxīn, wúlùn miànduì duō dà yālì dōuyào jiānchí wánchéng héxīn jìshù gōngguān.
example_sentences.en: Having endured setbacks in the startup phase, the project director secretly resolved to conquer core technical hurdles no matter how great the pressure.
example_sentences.es: Tras superar tropiezos durante los inicios del proyecto, el director tomó la firme resolución interna de persistir hasta dominar las tecnologías clave frente a cualquier obstáculo.

make up one's mind secretly in one's heart
secretly resolve to change the status quo
privately resolve not to disappoint expectations
secretly resolve to close the gap

idioms.meaning_en: make a firm resolution
resolve to strive for strength and success
grit one's teeth and bear through hardship
firmly committed and unwavering in one's resolve

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 日 (sun obscure/absent) + 音 (sound), depicting darkness, concealment, or unspoken private thoughts.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: The sun (日) eclipsed, cloaking thoughts in secret soundless quietude (音).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: El sol (日) oculto bajo la sombra, guardando reflexiones en discreto silencio (音).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Indicative character: an indicator mark beneath a base horizontal boundary line, signifying downward motion or fixing.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A mark positioned firmly downward under a baseline line.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una marca que señala hacia abajo bajo una línea base, indicando firmeza.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 冫/氵 (surging flow) + 夬 (cleaving through an obstacle), representing decisive breakthrough.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Cutting decisively through frozen obstacles like water breaching a dam.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Romper con firmeza diques u obstáculos como el agua que fluye incontenible.

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 心 (pictograph of human heart with valves)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Pictographic depiction of the anatomical human heart, the metaphorical seat of consciousness and resolve.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: The beating heart chamber holding one's deepest vows and spirit.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La cámara del corazón que custodia los votos y anhelos más profundos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 目睹年迈双亲在饥寒交迫中艰难支撑，年轻的子路在心底暗下决心：哪怕翻山越岭、历尽千难万险，也一定要去百里之外打工背米，让父母不再挨饿受冻。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mùdǔ niánmài shuāngqīn zài jīhán-jiāopò zhōng jiānnán zhīchēng, niánqīng de Zǐlù zài xīndǐ ànxià juéxīn: nǎpà fānshān-yuèlǐng, lìjìn qiānnán-wànxiǎn, yě yídìng yào qù bǎilǐ zhī wài dǎgōng bēimǐ, ràng fùmǔ búzài ái'è shòudòng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Seeing his elderly parents struggle amid hunger and freezing cold, young Zilu secretly resolved in his heart: even if crossing steep mountains and enduring countless trials, he would journey far away to earn and carry rice for them.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al ver a sus ancianos progenitores pasar hambre y frío, el joven Zilu decidió en secreto que, aunque debiera escalar montañas y sortear mil peligros, viajaría lejos a trabajar para llevarles arroz y aliviar sus penas.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在许多励志人物的成长历程中，改变人生命运的关键契机往往不是轰轰烈烈的宣言，而是一个人在困境中暗下决心的沉静时刻。那种发自内心深处的自我期许与坚毅信念，能够在漫长的岁月里转化为源源不断的前进动力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xǔduō lìzhì rénwù de chéngzhǎng lìchéng zhōng, gǎibiàn rénshēng mìngyùn de guānjiàn qìjī wǎngwǎng bú shì hōnghōnglièliè de xuānyán, ér shì yí gè rén zài kùnjìng zhōng ànxià juéxīn de chénjìng shíkè. Nà zhǒng fā zì nèixīn shēnchù de zìwǒ qīxǔ yǔ jiānyì xìnniàn, nénggòu zài màncháng de suìyuè lǐ zhuǎnhuà wéi yuányuán-bùduàn de qiánjìn dònglì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the journeys of inspiring figures, life-altering turning points are rarely loud declarations, but quiet moments when one secretly makes up one's mind in adversity. That deep internal conviction transforms into enduring motivation.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la vida de quienes triunfan frente a la adversidad, el punto de inflexión no suele ser una proclama ruidosa, sino el instante íntimo en que se proponen superarse. Esa determinación callada se convierte con el tiempo en una fuerza imparable.

meanings_summary.en: to feel wronged; aggrieved; to cause somebody to feel wronged; unfair treatment
meanings_summary.es: agraviado; ofendido; sentirse tratado injustamente; hacer sufrir agravio

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When you yield patiently (委) yet find yourself bent down under unfair pressure (屈), you feel wronged and aggrieved (委屈).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Ceder con paciencia (委) solo para verse doblegado bajo una carga injusta (屈) hace sentir un profundo agravio (委屈).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In traditional Chinese relationships, 委屈 represents the bitter swallow of self-subordination or false blame for the greater good of family harmony, bearing humiliation without complaint.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by neutral tone: wěi qu (214-0). 'qu' loses its original high-level tone and is read light, brief, and soft.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 委屈 focuses on internal sorrow and emotional pain caused by unfair treatment, unjust blame, or living beneath standard dignity.

contrasts.analysis: 委屈 specifically requires feeling that an unfair injustice or misunderstanding caused one's suffering, whereas 难过 is general sorrow or sadness.
委屈 describes the emotional hurt and grievance experienced inside, whereas 冤枉 focuses on the factual error of false accusation itself.
委屈 arises from interpersonal unfairness, whereas 遗憾 is regret or sorrow over missed opportunities or unavoidable circumstances.

Has 禾 over 乃 instead of 女
Has 尸 with 古 inside instead of 出

senses.definition_en: feeling aggrieved, hurt, or suffering an unjust slight
senses.definition_es: agraviado; dolido por un trato injusto
senses.example_phrase: 受了委屈 (suffered an injustice / felt wronged)

senses.definition_en: to put someone to inconvenience or treat without due regard
senses.definition_es: hacer pasar agravio o incomodidad a alguien
senses.example_phrase: 委屈你了 (sorry to put you out / trouble you)

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对他人的误解与冷嘲热讽，他强忍着内心的委屈，没有做过多的辩解，而是用实际行动证明了自己。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì tārén de wùjiě yǔ lěngcháo-rèfěng, tā qiáng rěn zhe nèixīn de wěiqu, méiyǒu zuò guòduō de biànjiě, ér shì yòng shíjì xíngdòng zhèngmíng le zìjǐ.
example_sentences.en: Facing misunderstandings and cynical mockery from others, he held back his inner grievance without making excuses, proving himself through concrete actions instead.
example_sentences.es: Frente a las incomprensiones y burlas ajenas, contuvo el dolor de sentirse agraviado sin dar explicaciones superfluas, demostrando su valía con hechos concretos.

example_sentences.hanzi: 家里条件实在有限，这次只能委屈你在简陋的客房里将就挤几个晚上了。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jiālǐ tiáojiàn shízài yǒuxiàn, zhè cì zhǐ néng wěiqu nǐ zài jiǎnlòu de kèfáng lǐ jiāngjiù jǐ jǐ gè wǎnshang le.
example_sentences.en: Our home conditions are truly modest; this time we must trouble you to squeeze into the humble guest room for a few nights.
example_sentences.es: Las condiciones de la casa son muy modestas; esta vez tendremos que molestarte haciéndote pasar la noche en una habitación muy sencilla.

collocations.en: compromise out of accommodation (variant of 委曲求全)

idioms.meaning_en: make concessions to achieve one's purpose; compromise to accommodate
suffer unjust treatment with grievances unredressed
cry out against injustice
swallow one's sobs and choke down tears

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic compound: ripe bending grain (禾) over a woman (女), indicating bowing, yielding, or entrusting responsibilities.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Yielding graciously like bending grain (禾) carried by a patient daughter (女).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Inclinarse dócilmente como espiga madura de trigo (禾) en manos de una hija paciente (女).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic and phono-semantic: a human body (尸) bent under external pressure struggling to emerge (出), hence feeling wronged or subjugated.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A person stooping under heavy pressure, unable to stand upright.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona que se encorva bajo una presión asfixiante sin poder erguirse plenamente.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 子路在富人家中干苦力时，偶尔也会遭遇严苛的挑剔与苛待。但他将满腹委屈默默咽回肚子里，因为他明白，只要能换得白米带回家给双亲充饥，个人的些许委屈根本算不了什么。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǐlù zài fùrén jiāzhōng gàn kǔlì shí, ǒu'ěr yě huì zāoyù yánkē de tiāoti yǔ kēdài. Dàn tā jiāng mǎnfù wěiqu mòmò yān huí dùzi lǐ, yīnwèi tā míngbai, zhǐyào néng huàndé báimǐ dài huí jiā gěi shuāngqīn chōngjī, gèrén de xiěxǔ wěiqu gēnběn suàn bù liǎo shénme.
extended_reading_passages.en: Laboring in wealthy households, Zilu occasionally faced harsh fault-finding. Yet he swallowed his grievances in silence, knowing that as long as he earned rice to feed his parents, personal slights mattered little.
extended_reading_passages.es: Al servir como peón en casas acomodadas, Zilu sufría a veces desdenes y exigencias desmedidas. No obstante, tragaba sus agravios en silencio, sabiendo que llevar comida a sus padres estaba muy por encima del orgullo personal.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 人际交往中，因信息不对称导致的误会往往容易让人心生委屈。健康的心理调节机制在于学会客观理性地区分他人言论与自我价值，在感到受委屈时不盲目内耗，而是通过及时坦诚的沟通化解分歧，重塑彼此信任。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Rénjì jiāowǎng zhōng, yīn xìnxī bùduìchèn dǎozhì de wùhuì wǎngwǎng róngyì ràng rén xīn shēng wěiqu. Jiànkāng de xīnlǐ tiáojié jīzhì zàiyú xuéhuì kèguān lǐxìng de qūfēn tārén yánlùn yǔ zìwǒ jiàzhí, zài gǎndào shòu wěiqu shí bù mángmù nèihào, ér shì tōngguò jíshí tǎnchéng de gōutōng huàjiě fēnqí, chóngsù bǐcǐ xìnrèn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In interpersonal interactions, misunderstandings from information gaps easily foster grievances. Healthy emotional regulation involves distinguishing external words from self-worth, avoiding internal friction when feeling wronged, and rebuilding trust through candid communication.
extended_reading_passages.es: En las relaciones humanas, los malentendidos suelen despertar sentimientos de agravio. La madurez emocional radica en separar las opiniones ajenas de la propia valía personal, evitando el desgaste interno y reconstruyendo la confianza mutua mediante el diálogo sincero.

meanings_summary.en: hundreds of miles away; far away beyond a hundred li
meanings_summary.es: a cientos de leguas de distancia; a más de cien li de distancia; muy lejos

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Measuring a hundred (百) rural leagues (里) of (之) distance leading out into the beyond (外) places you hundreds of miles away (百里之外).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Recorrer cien (百) leguas (里) de (之) distancia que se internan en el exterior lejano (外) conduce a cientos de leguas de distancia (百里之外).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient China, one 里 was about 500 meters. 百里 (~50 km) was an immense distance on foot over treacherous mountain roads, highlighting extraordinary filial devotion.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping-dipping-high-falling: bǎi lǐ zhī wài. In rapid speech, bǎi undergoes 3rd tone sandhi before lǐ: bái lǐ zhī wài (35-214-55-51).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 百里之外 evokes spatial vastness and geographic separation across arduous terrain, often emphasizing the devotion required to bridge it.

contrasts.compared_word: 百里之外 vs. 千里迢迢
contrasts.analysis: 百里之外 locates a specific distance boundary, while 千里迢迢 describes the exhausting process of traveling over thousands of miles.

contrasts.compared_word: 百里之外 vs. 远隔重洋
contrasts.analysis: 百里之外 refers to overland distance in rural or domestic geography, whereas 远隔重洋 describes separation by immense oceans across continents.

contrasts.compared_word: 百里之外 vs. 遥远
contrasts.analysis: 百里之外 is a vivid spatial idiom with historical and concrete measurement imagery, whereas 遥远 is a general neutral adjective meaning far or remote.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the upper horizontal stroke 一 of 百
Has 王 (jade) radical on the left of 里
Has 夂 instead of 卜 next to 夕
Similar left side 夕 to 外

senses.definition_en: situated or occurring at a great distance of a hundred li or more
senses.definition_es: a más de cien li de distancia; en un lugar remoto o lejano
senses.example_phrase: 远在百里之外 (far away hundreds of miles away)

example_sentences.hanzi: 听说百里之外的富庶城镇有做工挣粮的机会，孝子子路便告别双亲，踏上了艰苦的远行之路。
example_sentences.pinyin: Tīngshuō bǎilǐ zhī wài de fùshù chéngzhèn yǒu zuògōng zhèngliáng de jīhuì, xiàozǐ Zǐlù biàn gàobié shuāngqīn, tàshang le jiānkǔ de yuǎnxíng zhī lù.
example_sentences.en: Hearing that there were opportunities to work for grain in an affluent town hundreds of miles away, the filial son Zilu bid farewell to his parents and embarked on the arduous journey.
example_sentences.es: Al enterarse de que a más de cien leguas de distancia había oportunidades de trabajar para conseguir grano, el devoto hijo Zilu se despidió de sus padres y emprendió el arduo camino.

example_sentences.hanzi: 该观测站位于距市区百里之外的高山之巅，拥有极为理想的无光害天文观测环境。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gāi guāncèzhàn wèiyú jù shìqū bǎilǐ zhī wài de gāoshān zhī diān, yōngyǒu jíwéi lǐxiǎng de wúguānghài tiānwén guāncè huánjìng.
example_sentences.en: Situated atop a high mountain hundreds of miles away from urban centers, the observatory enjoys ideal conditions free from light pollution.
example_sentences.es: La estación astronómica se encuentra en la cumbre de una montaña a más de cien leguas de la ciudad, ofreciendo condiciones ideales sin contaminación lumínica.

rush to a place hundreds of miles away
come from hundreds of miles away

idioms.meaning_en: one in a hundred; cream of the crop
unyielding; undaunted by repeated setbacks
leave out of consideration; disregard
beyond the highest heavens; vanish into thin air

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic and phono-semantic: 一 (unity) atop 白 (count), symbolizing the numerical unit hundred.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: One horizon line (一) uniting hundredfold abundance (白).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una línea horizontal (一) coronando la centena en cuenta plena (白).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic compound: 田 (field) over 土 (earth), originally a rural hamlet or unit of agricultural land measurement.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Cultivated fields (田) divided upon fertile soil (土) measuring rural distance.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Campos de labranza (田) trazados sobre tierra fértil (土) que definen la distancia campesina.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient pictograph of a foot stepping forward from a baseline, grammaticalized into a genitive or relational particle.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A foot stepping forward linking one location to another.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una huella que avanza vinculando una posición con otra.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic compound: performing divination (卜) at evening (夕), outside normal auspicious daytime rituals, hence beyond or outer.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Looking out at the evening moon (夕) seeking answers outside familiar walls.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Contemplar la luna vespertina (夕) buscando respuestas más allá de los muros familiares.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 为了让父母在乱世中免于饥馑，子路徒步奔波于百里之外，替富豪大户舂米做工。每当夜深人静，眺望百里之外故乡的微弱灯火，他心头的思念与笃定便更加深沉。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Wèile ràng fùmǔ zài luànshì zhōng miǎnyú jījǐn, Zǐlù túbù bēnbō yú bǎilǐ zhī wài, tì fùháo dàhù chōngmǐ zuògōng. Měi dāng yèshēn rénjìng, tiàowàng bǎilǐ zhī wài gùxiāng de wēiruò dēnghuǒ, tā xīntóu de sīniàn yǔ dǔdìng biàn gèngjiā shēnchén.
extended_reading_passages.en: To save his parents from starvation during war, Zilu traveled hundreds of miles on foot to pound rice for rich masters. In the quiet of night, gazing toward his distant village, his devotion grew ever deeper.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con el fin de librar a sus padres del hambre en tiempos convulsos, Zilu caminó hasta un pueblo a más de cien leguas para trabajar. En el silencio de la noche, contemplar las luces lejanas de su hogar redoblaba su compromiso filial.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 古代交通条件极其落后，百里之外的地理阻隔往往意味着数日艰苦卓绝的徒步攀涉。然而，“百里负米”的典故却将这一漫长艰辛的空间距离转化为衡量孝道深浅的精神尺度，成为中华孝文化中历久弥新的动人篇章。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Gǔdài jiāotōng tiáojiàn jíqí luòhòu, bǎilǐ zhī wài de dìlǐ zǔgé wǎngwǎng yìwèizhe shù rì jiānkǔ-zhuójué de túbù pānshè. Rán'ér, "bǎilǐ fùmǐ" de diǎngù què jiāng zhè yì màncháng jiānxīn de kōngjiān jùlí zhuǎnhuà wéi héngliáng xiàodào shēnqiǎn de jīngshén chǐdù, chéngwéi Zhōnghuá xiàowénhuà zhōng lìjiǔ-míxīn de dòngrén piānzhāng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Ancient travel was arduous; crossing a hundred li meant days of walking across rugged terrain. Yet the story of carrying rice transformed this physical distance into a spiritual measure of filial devotion, remaining a timeless cultural touchstone.
extended_reading_passages.es: El transporte antiguo era sumamente precario, y recorrer más de cien leguas requería días enteros de extenuante caminata. Sin embargo, la leyenda de Zilu convirtió esa distancia en un símbolo perdurable del amor filial desinteresado.

meanings_summary.en: to work; to do manual labor; to perform physical jobs
meanings_summary.es: trabajar; hacer faenas; realizar labores físicas

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Using your hands to do (干) lively physical tasks (活) in daily spoken rhythm (儿) means doing manual work (干活儿).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Empuñar herramientas para ejecutar (干) faenas llenas de actividad vital (活) con desparpajo oral (儿) es trabajar físicamente (干活儿).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Northern spoken Chinese, 干活儿 captures the hearty spirit of everyday manual laborers and peasants, emphasizing muscle, sweat, and endurance.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling tone followed by rising tone with erhua: gàn huór (51-35r). The 'huó' syllable smoothly rolls into retroflex 'r' while ascending.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 干活儿 specifically emphasizes physical, bodily, or manual labor in oral and informal daily registers.

contrasts.analysis: 干活儿 is colloquial and focuses predominantly on physical chores or manual jobs, whereas 工作 is the universal formal term for any professional job.
干活儿 is spoken and casual, whereas 劳动 is a formal socio-political and economic term.
干活儿 is modern vernacular conversation, whereas 劳作 is literary, written, and poetic.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Similar to 干 but has a hook on the vertical stroke
Has a diagonal slash at the top instead of a horizontal stroke
Has 讠 (speech) with 舌 instead of 氵
Top stroke differs from 儿 (open top)

senses.definition_en: to engage in manual, agricultural, or physical labor
senses.definition_es: trabajar; hacer faenas físicas o manuales
senses.example_phrase: 出去干活儿 (go out to work)

example_sentences.hanzi: 他不怕脏也不怕累，每天天不亮就跟着大伙儿一起到工地上卖力干活儿。
example_sentences.pinyin: Tā bú pà zāng yě bú pà lèi, měitiān tiān bú liàng jiù gēnzhe dàhuǒr yìqǐ dào gōngdì shàng màilì gànhuór.
example_sentences.en: He was not afraid of dirt or exhaustion; every morning before dawn he went to the construction site with everyone to work vigorously.
example_sentences.es: Sin temerle al polvo ni al cansancio, cada madrugada acudía con los demás peones a la obra para trabajar con ahínco.

example_sentences.hanzi: 车间主任要求所有操作人员在进入生产线干活儿时，必须严格佩戴安全防护装备。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chējiān zhǔrèn yāoqiú suǒyǒu cāozuò rényuán zài jìnrù shēngchǎnxiàn gànhuór shí, bìxū yángé pèidài ānquán fánghù zhuāngbèi.
example_sentences.en: The workshop supervisor required all operators to strictly wear safety gear when working on the production line.
example_sentences.es: El jefe de taller exigió a todos los operarios llevar rigurosamente equipos de protección individual al entrar a la línea de montaje para trabajar.

idioms.meaning_en: deft and quick with hands and feet
start early and finish late; work round the clock
work hard to build prosperity

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Pictographic depiction of a wooden pitchfork, pestle, or weapon, extending to manual work, action, and doing.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A pestle or agricultural implement held firmly to perform work.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un mazo o apero agrícola empuñado con firmeza para realizar tareas.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 氵 (water) + 舌 (tongue/saliva), symbolizing vitality, living, and active tasks.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Flowing water (氵) bringing life to thirsty tongues and vibrant energy to work.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Agua viva (氵) humedeciendo la lengua, símbolo de dinamismo, vida y actividad.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Pictograph of a young human walking, used in Northern Chinese as the rhotic nominal/colloquial suffix '-r'.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A lively child walking, softening nouns into spoken expressions.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un niño que camina, aportando el matiz oral y cariñoso del sufijo rótico del norte.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 来到富家之后，子路干起活儿来手脚格外麻利。无论是劈柴、挑水还是舂米，他从不偷懒耍滑，只希望能多攒下一点粮食和银子，早日背回家孝敬父母。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Láidào fùjiā zhīhòu, Zǐlù gàn qǐ huór lái shǒujiǎo géwài máli. Wúlùn shì pǐchái, tiāoshuǐ háishì chōngmǐ, tā cóngbù tōulǎn-shuǎhuá, zhǐ xīwàng néng duō zǎnxià yìdiǎn liángshi hé yínzi, zǎorì bēi huí jiā xiàojìng fùmǔ.
extended_reading_passages.en: After arriving at the wealthy manor, Zilu worked with exceptional agility. Chopping wood, carrying water, or threshing rice, he never slacked, longing only to save grain and silver for his parents.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la hacienda acaudalada, Zilu realizaba las faenas con asombrosa rapidez. Ya fuera cortando leña, cargando agua o moliendo grano, no escatimaba esfuerzos con tal de juntar alimento para sus progenitores.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在北方方言口语中，“干活儿”三个字饱含着对质朴勤劳美德的高度赞扬。从田间农人到建筑工人，每一双沾满泥土的老茧双手，正是依靠脚踏实地干活儿的坚韧毅力，筑就了坚实的物质文明基石。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài běifāng fāngyán kǒuyǔ zhōng, "gànhuór" sān gè zì bǎohán zhe duì zhìpǔ qínláo měidé de gāodù zànyáng. Cóng tiánjiān nóngrén dào jiànzhù gōngrén, měi yì shuāng zhānmǎn nítǔ de lǎojiǎn shuāngshǒu, zhèng shì yīkào jiǎotà-shídì gànhuór de jiānrèn yìlì, zhùjiù le jiānshí de wùzhì wénmíng jīshí.
extended_reading_passages.en: In Northern vernacular, '干活儿' conveys deep respect for honest toil. From farmhands to construction workers, calloused hands laboring steadfastly lay the bedrock of civilization.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el habla cotidiana, "ganhuor" ensalza la laboriosidad honesta. Desde campesinos hasta peones, las manos curtidas que trabajan de sol a sol sustentan las bases materiales del bienestar social.

meanings_summary.en: host; master; owner; proprietor
meanings_summary.es: amo; anfitrión; dueño; propietario

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The person (人) holding primary authority like a steady flame atop a lampstand (主) is the owner and host (主人).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La persona (人) que sostiene la llama principal de autoridad en el hogar (主) es el amo o anfitrión (主人).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese social philosophy, 主 (host) and 宾 (guest) define fundamental ritual dynamics. In civic consciousness, the people are celebrated as the true masters of the nation.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by rising 2nd tone: zhǔ rén (214-35). 'zhǔ' dips low before ascending into 'rén'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 主人 denotes a person possessing ownership, managerial primacy, or host obligations toward guests/employees.

contrasts.analysis: 主人 is general and personal, whereas 东道主 specifically designates the host nation, city, or organizing body of major conferences or competitions.
主人 refers to the general proprietor or host, while 房东 is strictly a business-legal term for the landlord leasing property to tenants.
主人 indicates ownership or hospitality, whereas 领导 refers to a managerial supervisor or political director exercising hierarchical command.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the upper flame dot 丶 of 主
Has dot at lower right of 王, not at the top
Right stroke overlaps left, whereas in 人 left stroke begins at top
The two strokes do not touch at the apex

senses.definition_en: an owner of property, pet, or estate; a person who employs servants/workers
senses.definition_es: amo; dueño; propietario; patrón
senses.example_phrase: 房屋主人 (owner of the house)

senses.definition_en: host receiving guests
senses.definition_es: anfitrión que recibe a sus invitados
senses.example_phrase: 热情的主人 (hospitable host)

example_sentences.hanzi: 庄园主人见年轻的子路为人忠厚诚实、干活勤快，便决定将他留下来长期做工。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhuāngyuán zhǔrén jiàn niánqīng de Zǐlù wéirén zhōnghòu chéngshí, gànhuó qínkuài, biàn juédìng jiāng tā liú xiàlái chángqī zuògōng.
example_sentences.en: Seeing that young Zilu was honest, dependable, and diligent in labor, the estate master decided to keep him for long-term work.
example_sentences.es: Viendo que el joven Zilu era honesto, leal y trabajador, el dueño de la hacienda decidió contratarlo de forma permanente.

example_sentences.hanzi: 作为本次国际青年创新论坛的东道主，主人以热忱周到的服务赢得了各国与会代表的一致赞誉。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi běncì guójì qīngnián chuàngxīn lùntán de dōngdàozhǔ, zhǔrén yǐ rèchén zhōudào de fúwù yíngdé le gèguó yùhuì dàibiǎo de yízhì zànyù.
example_sentences.en: As host of this international youth innovation forum, the organizers won unanimous praise from multinational delegates for warm, attentive service.
example_sentences.es: Como anfitrión del foro internacional de innovación juvenil, el organizador se ganó el elogio unánime de los delegados extranjeros por su hospitalidad impecable.

idioms.meaning_en: the guest eclipses the host; the secondary supersedes the primary
turn from guest into host; take the initiative
run the household and take charge
both host and guests thoroughly enjoy themselves

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Pictographic depiction of an oil lamp with flame burning steadily on a stand, symbolizing the head of household presiding over sacred fires.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A sacred flame burning atop an altar lampstand, representing authority and leadership.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una llama sagrada que arde sobre un candelabro, símbolo de autoridad y primacía doméstica.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Pictograph of a human standing with legs apart, representing humanity.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A human walking forward with two supporting legs.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un ser humano caminando con paso firme sobre dos piernas.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 大户人家的主人起初并不相信这位衣衫褴褛的年轻人能吃苦。然而几天下来，见子路老实本分、干活毫不懈怠，主人深受感动，不仅按时发给工钱，还在临别时赠予奖金与白米。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Dàhù rénjiā de zhǔrén qǐchū bìng bù xiāngxìn zhè wèi yīshān-lánlǚ de niánqīngrén néng chīkǔ. Rán'ér jǐ tiān xiàlái, jiàn Zǐlù lǎoshi běnfèn, gànhuó háobù xièdài, zhǔrén shēnshòu gǎndòng, bùjǐn ànshí fā gěi gōngqián, hái zài línbié shí zèngyǔ jiǎngjīn yǔ báimǐ.
extended_reading_passages.en: The master of the wealthy household initially doubted this ragged youth could bear hardship. But after days of witnessing Zilu's honest and tireless work, the master was moved, paying full wages and rewarding him with extra silver and rice.
extended_reading_passages.es: El dueño de la rica mansión dudaba al principio de que aquel joven andrajoso soportara la faena. Mas al verlo trabajar con lealtad y sin desmayo, conmovido, le pagó su jornal completo y le obsequió plata y arroz.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在社会学理论中，“主人意识”代表着个体对社群公共事务的高度自觉与责任感。当每一个公民都从被动的旁观者转变为积极的参与者，将自己视为社区与国家的主人时，整个社会的民主治理与文明发展才能获得持久的生命力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài shèhuìxué lǐlùn zhōng, "zhǔrén yìshí" dàibiǎo zhe gètǐ duì shèqún gōnggòng shìwù de gāodù zìjué yǔ zérèngǎn. Dāng měi yí gè gōngmín dōu cóng bèidòng de pángguānzhě zhuǎnbiàn wéi jījí de cānyùzhě, jiāng zìjǐ shìwéi shèqū yǔ guójiā de zhǔrén shí, zhěnggè shèhuì de mínzhǔ zhìlǐ yǔ wénmíng fāzhǎn cáinéng huòdé chíjiǔ de shēngmìnglì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In sociological theory, "master consciousness" represents proactive civic civic responsibility. When citizens transform from passive spectators into engaged participants viewing themselves as true masters of community and country, democratic governance flourishes.
extended_reading_passages.es: En sociología, la conciencia de dueño refleja el compromiso cívico activo. Cuando cada ciudadano deja de ser espectador para verse como protagonista y dueño del destino común, la gobernanza y la civilización cobran una fuerza perdurable.

meanings_summary.en: to leave behind; to stay behind; to keep; to retain
meanings_summary.es: dejar; quedarse; permanecer; conservar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Stopping to stay in the home fields (留) and settling downward (下) firmly means to leave behind or stay (留下).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Detenerse a permanecer en el campo familiar (留) y fijarse hacia abajo (下) equivale a quedarse o dejar una huella (留下).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese spatial cognition, 下 as a directional resultative complement signifies solid deposition, settling, or permanence.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by falling 4th tone or neutral tone: liú xià (35-51) or liú xia (35-0). In compounds like 留下来, xia is typically unstressed.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 留下 emphasizes the state or result of remaining behind, being retained, or leaving a physical/emotional legacy.

contrasts.analysis: 留下 indicates staying behind permanently or leaving something behind, whereas 停留 emphasizes a temporary pause or transit layover.
留下 can be positive or neutral, whereas 抛下 carries a strong negative connotation of abandoning or casting aside responsibilities.
留下 is standard spoken and written vocabulary for any physical or abstract result, while 遗留 is a formal, historical term denoting lingering problems.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 氵 (water) radical on the left with 留 on the right
Has 木 (tree) radical on the left with 留 on the right
Has 疒 (sickness) radical on the outside of 留
Similar upper dot and slash to 下

senses.definition_en: to remain behind or cause someone/something to stay
senses.definition_es: quedarse; retener; hacer que alguien permanezca
senses.example_phrase: 留下来吃饭 (stay to eat)

senses.definition_en: to leave behind as a record, memory, or bequest
senses.definition_es: dejar atrás; legar; dejar una huella
senses.example_phrase: 留下深刻印象 (leave a deep impression)

example_sentences.hanzi: 考虑到山路风雪难行且家中父母急盼米粮，子路婉言谢绝了主人挽留他留下过冬的好意。
example_sentences.pinyin: Kǎolǜ dào shānlù fēngxuě nánxíng qiě jiāzhōng fùmǔ jípàn mǐliáng, Zǐlù wǎnyán xièjué le zhǔrén wǎnliú tā liúxià guòdōng de hǎoyì.
example_sentences.en: Considering the mountain paths snow-bound and his parents eagerly awaiting rice, Zilu politely declined the master's kind invitation to stay through the winter.
example_sentences.es: Al ver los senderos cubiertos de nieve y sabiendo que sus padres esperaban con ansias el arroz, Zilu declinó amablemente la invitación del patrón de quedarse a pasar el invierno.

example_sentences.hanzi: 这位杰出教育家毕生奉献于偏远乡村，为后人留下了极其宝贵的教学手稿和崇高的精神财富。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhè wèi jiéchū jiàoyùjiā bìshēng fèngxiàn yú piānyuǎn xiāngcūn, wèi hòurén liúxià le jíqí bǎoguì de jiàoxué shǒugǎo hé chónggāo de jīngshén cáifù.
example_sentences.en: This outstanding educator dedicated his life to remote villages, leaving behind invaluable teaching manuscripts and noble spiritual wealth for posterity.
example_sentences.es: Aquel ilustre maestro consagró su vida a las aldeas remotas, legando a las generaciones venideras valiosos manuscritos y un elevado patrimonio espiritual.

idioms.meaning_en: leave a name in the annals of history; immortalized
show mercy; hold back one's hand
leave future troubles in one's wake
linger on, forgetting to return

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Halting before the farm gates (卯) to stay rooted in fertile fields (田).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Detenerse ante los portales (卯) para echar raíces en campos fértiles (田).
