character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una señal descendente que indica la fijación o permanencia de una acción.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 尽管主人再三诚意劝阻，希望他留下来继续做工避开风雪，但子路心中唯有家中断炊的老母。他不愿多留一日，只愿将辛劳换来的粮食尽快送到父母手中。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn zhǔrén zàisān chéngyì quànzǔ, xīwàng tā liú xiàlái jìxù zuògōng bìkāi fēngxuě, dàn Zǐlù xīnzhōng wéiyǒu jiāzhōng duànchuī de lǎomǔ. Tā bú yuàn duō liú yí rì, zhǐ yuàn jiāng xīnláo huànlái de liángshi jǐnkuài sòng dào fùmǔ shǒuzhōng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Although the master sincerely urged him to stay to work through the blizzard, Zilu thought only of his starving mother. Unwilling to stay an extra day, he longed to carry the hard-won grain home.
extended_reading_passages.es: Pese a la sincera insistencia del patrón para que se quedara a pasar el temporal, Zilu solo pensaba en su madre sin sustento. No quiso demorarse ni un día más para llevarles el arroz cuanto antes.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 岁月如奔流不息的江水，然而那些为理想与仁爱默默付出的人，总能在历史的长河中留下不可磨灭的印记。物质财富终将随风消散，唯有高尚的道德操守与无私品格，才能为后世留下跨越千年的精神灯塔。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suìyuè rú bēnliú-bùxī de jiāngshuǐ, rán'ér nàxiē wèi lǐxiǎng yǔ rén'ài mòmò fùchū de rén, zǒng néng zài lìshǐ de chánghé zhōng liúxià bùkě-mómè de yìnjì. Wùzhì cáifù zhōng jiāng suí fēng xiāosàn, wéiyǒu gāoshàng de dàodé cāoshǒu yǔ wúsī pǐngé, cáinéng wèi hòushì liúxià kuàyuè qiānnián de jīngshén dēngtǎ.
extended_reading_passages.en: Years flow like an unstoppable river, yet those who sacrifice for love and ideals always leave indelible marks in history. Material wealth scatters, but noble virtue leaves an enduring spiritual lighthouse for posterity.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los años discurren como un río veloz, pero quienes se entregan con nobleza dejan huellas imborrables en la historia. Las riquezas materiales se desvanecen; solo la virtud y la integridad desinteresada legan un faro moral perdurable.

meanings_summary.en: to get to work; to start working; to plunge into labor
meanings_summary.es: ponerse a trabajar; empezar la faena; abocarse al trabajo

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Rising up (起) to do (干) lively labor (活) as energy comes forth (来) means you enthusiastically get to work (干起活来).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Levantarse (起) para emprender (干) la faena (活) con ímpetu que fluye (来) es ponerse a trabajar de lleno (干起活来).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The grammatical construction V + 起来 (with inserted object 活) marks the inceptive aspect, signaling the burst of forward momentum and sustained continuation of manual toil.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling-dipping-rising-rising/neutral: gàn qǐ huó lái (51-214-35-35) or gàn qi huó lai with unstressed 'qi' and 'lai'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 干起活来 captures the inception, dynamic energy, and immersive flow of plunging into physical labor.

contrasts.compared_word: 干起活来 vs. 开始工作
contrasts.analysis: 干起活来 is an inceptive colloquial phrase emphasizing manual vigor and physical flow, whereas 开始工作 is formal and objective for beginning any job or project.

contrasts.compared_word: 干起活来 vs. 着手处理
contrasts.analysis: 干起活来 focuses on manual labor and bodily action, whereas 着手处理 focuses on taking bureaucratic or intellectual steps to handle problems.

contrasts.compared_word: 干起活来 vs. 动工
contrasts.analysis: 干起活来 applies to individuals or small groups beginning tasks, while 动工 formally denotes breaking ground on major civil engineering projects.

senses.definition_en: to start working energetically with momentum
senses.definition_es: ponerse a trabajar activamente; emprender la faena con brío
senses.example_phrase: 一干起活来就忘我 (completely absorbed once getting to work)

example_sentences.hanzi: 只要一干起活来，他就全身心投入其中，不知不觉几个小时就过去了。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhǐyào yì gàn qǐ huó lái, tā jiù quánshēnxīn tóurù qízhōng, bùzhī-bùjué jǐ gè xiǎoshí jiù guòqù le.
example_sentences.en: As soon as he got to work, he threw himself into it wholeheartedly, and hours slipped by without him noticing.
example_sentences.es: En cuanto se ponía a trabajar, se volcaba en cuerpo y alma en la faena, pasando las horas sin apenas darse cuenta.

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了赶在雨季前完成水库大坝加固工程，工人们挽起袖子干起活来，工地上呈现出一派热火朝天的景象。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile gǎn zài yǔjì qián wánchéng shuǐkù dàbà jiāgù gōngchéng, gōngrénmen wǎn qǐ xiùzi gàn qǐ huó lái, gōngdì shàng chéngxiàn chū yí pài rèhuǒ-cháotiān de jǐngxiàng.
example_sentences.en: To finish reinforcing the reservoir dam before the rainy season, workers rolled up their sleeves and got to work, creating a bustling, spirited scene.
example_sentences.es: Para terminar el refuerzo de la presa antes de las lluvias, los obreros se arremangaron y se pusieron a trabajar con entusiasmo, llenando la obra de dinamismo.

bury oneself in hard work
strive to be first and fear being left behind

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An agricultural pestle or weapon gripped to do tasks.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un mazo o vara empuñada con fuerza para trabajar.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Ponerse de pie (走) para emprender con brío una acción (己).

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Ripe wheat arriving from afar, welcoming productive harvest labor.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Trigo espigado que arriba maduro, invitando a la labor de la cosecha.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 年轻的子路骨子里透着庄稼人的朴实与倔强，只要一干起活来，浑身就仿佛有使不完的力气。他手脚不停地推磨挑水，粗糙的双手磨出了厚厚的老茧，也赢得了主人发自内心的赏识。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Niánqīng de Zǐlù gǔzilǐ tòuzhe zhuāngjiarén de pǔshí yǔ juèjiàng, zhǐyào yì gàn qǐ huó lái, húnshēn jiù fǎngfú yǒu shǐ bù wán de lìqi. Tā shǒujiǎo bù tíng de tuīmò tiāoshuǐ, cūcāo de shuāngshǒu mó chū le hòuhòu de lǎojiǎn, yě yíngdé le zhǔrén fā zì nèixīn de shǎngshí.
extended_reading_passages.en: In his bones, young Zilu possessed a peasant's stubborn diligence; once he got to work, he seemed blessed with boundless strength. Pushing millstones and hauling water untiringly, his calloused hands earned the master's genuine admiration.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el fondo de su ser, el joven Zilu albergaba la laboriosidad recia del campesino: en cuanto empezaba a trabajar, desplegaba una energía inagotable. Moliendo grano y acarreando agua sin cesar, sus manos encallecidas se ganaron la estima del patrón.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 心理学中的“心流”状态，生动地体现在劳动者全神贯注干起活来的精神风貌中。当一个人彻底屏除杂念、将专注力全部凝聚于眼前的具体劳作时，劳动便不再是一种机械的负担，而升华为锻造坚韧心智与实现自我价值的修行过程。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xīnlǐxué zhōng de "xīnliú" zhuàngtài, shēngdòng de tǐxiàn zài láodòngzhě quánshén-guānzhù gàn qǐ huó lái de jīngshén fēngmào zhōng. Dāng yí gè rén chèdǐ bǐngchú zániàn, jiāng zhuānzhùlì quánbù níngjù yú yǎnqián de jùtǐ láozuò shí, láodòng biàn búzài shì yì zhǒng jīxiè de fùdān, ér shēnghuá wéi duànzào jiānrèn xīnji yǔ shíxiàn zìwǒ jiàzhí de xiūxíng guòchéng.
extended_reading_passages.en: The psychological concept of 'flow' is vividly seen when laborers get to work with total absorption. Shedding distractions and focusing completely on the task transforms toil from a chore into a path of self-cultivation.
extended_reading_passages.es: El estado de flujo se aprecia con claridad cuando un trabajador se entrega a la faena con total concentración. Al despojarse de distracciones y abocarse al quehacer presente, el trabajo se sublima en una forja de entereza interior y autorrealización.

meanings_summary.en: hardworking; diligent; industrious; assiduous
meanings_summary.es: trabajador; diligente; industrioso; asiduo

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Applying tireless muscle power (勤) to spread your wings and soar above obstacles (奋) embodies true diligence (勤奋).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Aplicar fuerza constante (勤) para desplegar las alas y superarse (奋) constituye la verdadera diligencia (勤奋).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Traditional Chinese culture considers 勤 (diligence) as the supreme virtue in farming and scholarship, forming the foundation of filial responsibility.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by falling 4th tone: qín fèn (35-51). 'qín' ascends crisply before dropping powerfully on 'fèn'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 勤奋 describes sustained, conscious effort, discipline, and industrious dedication in work or study.

contrasts.analysis: 勤奋 applies to study, mental work, research, or career aspirations, whereas 勤劳 primarily characterizes physical, manual, and agricultural toil.
勤奋 stresses steady consistency and active engagement, whereas 刻苦 stresses enduring physical hardship, deprivation, and self-denial.
勤奋 is an enduring character trait and moral disposition, while 努力 can refer to either a temporary burst of energy or general striving.

senses.definition_en: showing steady, earnest, and energetic effort in work or study
senses.definition_es: trabajador; diligente; que se esfuerza con constancia
senses.example_phrase: 勤奋工作 (work diligently)

example_sentences.hanzi: 凭借着勤奋踏实的工作态度，他在短短几年内便从一名普通学徒成长为行业骨干。
example_sentences.pinyin: Píngjiè zhe qínfèn tàshí de gōngzuò tàidù, tā zài duǎnduǎn jǐ nián nèi biàn cóng yì míng pǔtōng xuétú chéngzhǎng wéi hángyè gǔgàn.
example_sentences.en: Relying on a diligent and grounded work attitude, within just a few years he grew from an ordinary apprentice into an industry backbone.
example_sentences.es: Gracias a su actitud diligente y perseverante, en pocos años pasó de ser un simple aprendiz a convertirse en un pilar fundamental del sector.

example_sentences.hanzi: 科学研究是一条充满艰辛的探索之路，唯有勤奋钻研且耐得住寂寞的人才能最终摘取科学的桂冠。
example_sentences.pinyin: Kēxué yánjiū shì yì tiáo chōngmǎn jiānxīn de tànsuǒ zhī lù, wéiyǒu qínfèn zuānyán qiě nài de zhù jìmò de rén cáinéng zuìzhōng zhāiqǔ kēxué de guìguān.
example_sentences.en: Scientific research is an arduous exploratory journey; only those who study diligently and endure solitude can ultimately claim the laurels of science.
example_sentences.es: La investigación científica es un camino colmado de rigores; únicamente quienes indagan con asiduidad y toleran la soledad logran alcanzar la cima del saber.

hardworking and thrifty
diligence can make up for lack of natural talent
work hard with determination for strength

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 力 (muscle power) + 堇 (kneading heavy clay/loam), depicting strenuous physical toil.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Exerting muscle strength (力) untiringly like an artisan molding clay (堇).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Aplicar fuerza muscular (力) sin desmayo como un alfarero que amasa arcilla (堇).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ancient ideogram of a bird spreading wings to take flight from a field, extending to exerting effort, striving, and soaring.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A majestic bird bursting forth from the fields (田) spreading its wings (大) to soar.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un ave que levanta el vuelo desde el campo (田) desplegando sus alas (大) con brío.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在百里之外打工的日子里，年轻的子路凭借勤奋踏实的作风赢得了众人的敬重。不论是烈日当空还是风雨交加，他始终尽心竭力做好每一项杂务，毫无怨言。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài bǎilǐ zhī wài dǎgōng de rìzi lǐ, niánqīng de Zǐlù píngjiè qínfèn tàshí de zuòfēng yíngdé le zhòngrén de jìngzhòng. Búlùn shì lièrì dāngkōng háishì fēngyǔ-jiāojiā, tā shǐzhōng jìnxīn-jiélì zuòhǎo měi yí xiàng záwù, háowú yuànyán.
extended_reading_passages.en: During days of labor hundreds of miles away, young Zilu won everyone's respect through diligence. Whether under scorching sun or biting storms, he performed every chore wholeheartedly without complaint.
extended_reading_passages.es: En sus jornadas de trabajo lejos de casa, el joven Zilu se ganó el respeto de todos por su laboriosidad. Ya bajo el sol abrasador o la lluvia gélida, cumplía cada tarea con esmero y sin lamentarse.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 古往今来，凡在科学、艺术或思想领域取得卓越建树者，无一不具备极其崇高的勤奋品格。天赋固然能够为学者打开灵感之门，但唯有持之以恒的勤奋探索与反复打磨，才能跨越重重险阻，铸就传世经典的学术丰碑。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Gǔwǎng-jīnlái, fán zài kēxué, yìshù huò sīxiǎng lǐngyù qǔdé zhuóyuè jiànshù zhě, wú yī bú jùbèi jíqí chónggāo de qínfèn pǐngé. Tiānfù gùrán nénggòu wèi xuézhě dǎkāi línggǎn zhī mén, dàn wéiyǒu chízhīyǐhéng de qínfèn tànsuǒ yǔ fǎnfù dǎmó, cáinéng kuàyuè zhòngzhòng xiǎnzǔ, zhùjiù chuánshì jīngdiǎn de xuéshù fēngbēi.
extended_reading_passages.en: Throughout history, all who achieved greatness in science, art, or thought possessed unwavering diligence. While talent may open doors of inspiration, only persevering labor and refinement can overcome hurdles to create monumental masterpieces.
extended_reading_passages.es: A lo largo de la historia, quienes alcanzaron la grandeza en las ciencias o las artes sobresalieron por su constante diligencia. El talento puede abrir la puerta a la inspiración, pero solo la búsqueda infatigable permite forjar legados imperecederos.

meanings_summary.en: silver; money; silver currency
meanings_summary.es: plata; dinero de plata; moneda

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Precious gleaming metal (银) formed into everyday spending currency (子) is silver money (银子).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El metal brillante (银) moldeado como divisa de cambio en la vida diaria (子) es la plata amonedada (银子).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In imperial Chinese society, silver ingots symbolized purchasing power and security. Ordinary laborers worked tirelessly for months just to earn a few taels of silver to support families.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by neutral tone: yín zi (35-0). 'zi' is pronounced lightly with reduced vowel length.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 银子 historical currency designation specifically highlighting silver ingots or colloquial hard money.

contrasts.analysis: 银子 refers specifically to silver currency or ancient monetary ingots, whereas 钱 is the universal contemporary term for money.
银子 is historical, narrative, and spoken, whereas 白银 is the formal chemical and macroeconomic commodity term.
银子 refers to metallic silver specie, whereas 钞票 strictly designates paper banknotes and printed currency.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 彳 (step) on the left instead of 钅
Has 犭 (dog) on the left instead of 钅
Has 忄 (heart) on the left instead of 钅
Has 木 (tree) on the left instead of 钅

senses.definition_en: silver metal used historically as currency, ingots, or money
senses.definition_es: plata; dinero o moneda de plata en la antigüedad
senses.example_phrase: 几两银子 (a few taels of silver)

example_sentences.hanzi: 拿到主人发放的几两沉甸甸的银子作为工钱，他舍不得多花一分，小心翼翼地缝进内衣口袋里。
example_sentences.pinyin: Nádào zhǔrén fāfàng de jǐ liǎng chéndiāndiān de yínzi zuòwéi gōngqián, tā shěbude duō huā yì fēn, xiǎoxīn-yìyì de féng jìn nèiyī kǒudài lǐ.
example_sentences.en: Receiving several heavy taels of silver from the master as wages, he was loath to spend even a penny, carefully sewing them into his inner garment pocket.
example_sentences.es: Al recibir del patrón unos pesados taeles de plata como salario, no se atrevió a gastar ni un céntimo y los cosió con cuidado en el bolsillo de su ropa interior.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在中国古代货币史中，白银与铜钱长期并行流通，银子通常用于大宗商品贸易与官府赋税结算。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài Zhōngguó gǔdài huòbì shǐ zhōng, báiyín yǔ tóngqián chángqī bìngxíng liútōng, yínzi tōngcháng yòngyú dàzōng shāngpǐn màoyì yǔ guānfǔ fùshuì jiésuàn.
example_sentences.en: In ancient Chinese monetary history, silver and copper coins circulated in tandem, with silver ingots commonly used for bulk commerce and official tax settlement.
example_sentences.es: En la historia monetaria de la antigua China, la plata y las monedas de cobre coexistieron, empleándose la plata para el gran comercio y el pago de tributos estatales.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 子路用打工换来的银子在集镇上买了一大袋上等白米。他紧紧攥着剩下的一点碎银子，心中满是欣喜，因为这些粮食足够让年迈的父母吃上几个月的饱饭了。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǐlù yòng dǎgōng huànlái de yínzi zài jīzhèn shàng mǎi le yí dà dài shàngděng báimǐ. Tā jǐnjǐn zuànzhe shèngxià de yìdiǎn suìyínzi, xīnzhōng mǎn shì xīnxǐ, yīnwèi zhèxiē liángshi zúgòu ràng niánmài de fùmǔ chī shang jǐ gè yuè de bǎofàn le.
extended_reading_passages.en: With the silver earned from his labor, Zilu bought a large sack of premium white rice at the town market. Gripping the remaining broken silver tightly, he rejoiced knowing this food would nourish his parents for months.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con la plata ganada en su faena, Zilu compró un gran saco de arroz de primera en el pueblo. Apretando contra su pecho los pocos trozos de plata sobrantes, sintió una alegría inmensa sabiendo que sus padres no pasarían hambre en meses.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 明清以来的经济史研究证实，白银货币化对中国古代商品经济的发展产生了深远影响。“银子”不仅是市场交易的主要流通媒介，更深刻塑造了城乡劳动力流动、雇佣报酬支付以及传统赋税征收的基本模式。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Míng-Qīng yǐlái de jīngjìshǐ yánjiū zhèngshí, báiyín huòbìhuà duì Zhōngguó gǔdài shāngpǐn jīngjì de fāzhǎn chǎnshēng le shēnyuǎn yǐngxiǎng. "Yínzi" bùjǐn shì shìchǎng jiāoyì de zhǔyào liútōng méijiè, gèng shēnkè sùzào le chéng-xiāng láodònglì liúdòng, gùyòng bàochou zhīfù yǐjí chuántǒng fùshuì zhēngshōu de jīběn móshì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Historical economic studies since the Ming and Qing dynasties confirm that silver monetization profoundly impacted ancient trade. Silver served not only as the primary medium of exchange, but shaped labor mobility, wages, and tax regimes.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los estudios económicos confirman que la monetización de la plata desde las épocas Ming y Qing dinamizó el comercio. La plata sirvió de divisa principal y modeló la migración de mano de obra, los salarios y la recaudación fiscal.

meanings_summary.en: to obtain; to receive; to gain; to achieve; to win

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When what you seek is acquired into your hands (得) and arrives fully in your possession (到), you have obtained it (得到).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando lo que buscas cae en tus manos (得) y arriba a su destino final (到), lo has obtenido por completo (得到).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The compound combines the acquisition verb 得 with the resultative attainment complement 到, creating a classic Chinese grammatical resultative construction.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by falling 4th tone or neutral tone: dé dào (35-51) or dé dao (35-0). In fast connected speech, 'dao' is often destressed.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 得到 marks the successful acquisition or receipt of tangible benefits, intangible approval, or results.

contrasts.analysis: 得到 is common in both spoken and written registers and pairs widely with passive verbs, whereas 获得 is more formal, usually pairing with achievements, prizes, or rights.
得到 stresses receiving something beneficial or objective, whereas 受到 stresses undergoing external influence or passive experience, including negative impacts.
得到 emphasizes the passive or natural reception of something, whereas 取得 emphasizes proactive struggle and intentional effort to capture results.

example_sentences.hanzi: 经过长达数月的艰苦努力，他的创新方案终于得到了行业专家的一致认可与高度赞赏。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò chángdá shù yuè de jiānkǔ nǔlì, tā de chuàngxīn fāng'àn zhōngyú dédào le hángyè zhuānjiā de yízhì rènkě yǔ gāodù zànyǎng.
example_sentences.en: After months of arduous effort, his innovative proposal finally received unanimous recognition and high praise from industry experts.
example_sentences.es: Tras meses de arduo empeño, su propuesta innovadora obtuvo por fin el reconocimiento unánime y los más altos elogios de los expertos del sector.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在现代法治社会中，每一位公民的合法权益都应当依法得到切实有效的保护。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài xiàndài fǎzhì shèhuì zhōng, měi yí wèi gōngmín de héfǎ quányì dōu yīngdāng yīfǎ dédào qièshí yǒuxiào de bǎohù.
example_sentences.en: In a modern society governed by law, the lawful rights and interests of every citizen should be effectively protected according to law.
example_sentences.es: En un Estado de derecho moderno, los derechos e intereses legítimos de cada ciudadano deben ser protegidos de forma eficaz conforme a la ley.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 子路在富家做工不仅得到了应得的报酬，更得到了主人的敬重与赞许。然而在他看来，能够早日让家中的父母得到温饱，才是他付出所有汗水换来的最大回报。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǐlù zài fùjiā zuògōng bùjǐn dédào le yīngdé de bàochou, gèng dédào le zhǔrén de jìngzhòng yǔ zànxǔ. Rán'ér zài tā kànlái, nénggòu zǎorì ràng jiāzhōng de fùmǔ dédào wēnbǎo, cái shì tā fùchū suǒyǒu hànshuǐ huànlái de zuì dà huíbào.
extended_reading_passages.en: Working in the wealthy household, Zilu received not only fair wages, but also the master's respect. Yet to him, bringing food to warm his parents was the greatest reward for all his sweat.
extended_reading_passages.es: Trabajando en la hacienda, Zilu no solo obtuvo su merecido sueldo, sino la estima del patrón. Mas para él, lograr que sus padres tuvieran pan fue la mayor recompensa a sus desvelos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代企业管理学中，员工内心的成就感与归属感，往往需要在组织中得到充分的尊重与肯定。唯有当劳动者的辛勤付出能够得到公平合理的回报与制度保障时，整个团队才能凝聚起强大的向心力与创新活力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài qǐyè guǎnlǐxué zhōng, yuángōng nèixīn de chéngjiùgǎn yǔ guīshǔgǎn, wǎngwǎng xūyào zài zǔzhī zhōng dédào chōngfèn de zūnzhòng yǔ kěndìng. Wéiyǒu dāng láodòngzhě de xīnqín fùchū nénggòu dédào gōngpíng hélǐ de huíbào yǔ zhìdù bǎozhàng shí, zhěnggè tuánduì cáinéng níngjù qǐ qiángdà de xiàngxīnlì yǔ chuàngxīn huólì.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern organizational management, employees' sense of accomplishment requires ample respect and affirmation. Only when laborers' earnest toil receives fair remuneration and institutional guarantees can a team maintain cohesion and innovative vitality.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la gestión empresarial moderna, la motivación del personal requiere respeto y reconocimiento. Solo cuando el esfuerzo de los trabajadores obtiene una compensación justa y garantías institucionales, el equipo consolida su cohesión y empuje innovador.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: An elder (老) whose character is packed solid with truth and integrity without deceit (实) is truly honest (老实).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un anciano (老) cuyo carácter está colmado de solidez y verdad sin engaños (实) es un hombre cabal y honesto (老实).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In traditional agrarian communities, 老实 is praised as the bedrock of moral decency, contrasting sharply with slick, deceitful opportunism.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by neutral tone: lǎo shi (214-0). In spoken Mandarin, 'shi' is unstressed and short.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 老实 characterizes unpretentious honesty, lack of cunning deceit, and dutiful, well-behaved conduct.

contrasts.analysis: 诚实 focuses specifically on telling the truth and not lying, whereas 老实 encompasses broader behavior, including docility, simplicity, and lack of trickery.
老实 emphasizes moral innocence and lack of deceit, whereas 踏实 focuses on practical diligence, emotional peace of mind, and reliable work methods.
老实 is common colloquial speech, whereas 忠厚 carries a classical moral tone denoting deep loyalty and benevolent magnanimity.

example_sentences.hanzi: 庄园管家发现年轻的子路为人老实厚道、从不偷奸耍滑，便对他十分信赖，交给他更多重要事务。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhuāngyuán guǎnjiā fāxiàn niánqīng de Zǐlù wéirén lǎoshi hòudào, cóngbù tōujiān-shuǎhuá, biàn duì tā shífēn xìnlài, jiāogěi tā gèng duō zhòngyào shìwù.
example_sentences.en: The estate steward noticed that young Zilu was honest, steadfast, and never deceitful, trusting him greatly and entrusting him with more important tasks.
example_sentences.es: El mayordomo descubrió que el joven Zilu era una persona honrada y cabal que jamás hacía trampas, por lo que confió en él plenamente encomendándole labores de peso.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在面对组织问询时，他老老实实地说明了事情的原委，毫无隐瞒地承担了自己应当承担的管理责任。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài miànduì zǔzhī wènxún shí, tā lǎolao-shíshí de shuōmíng le shìqíng de yuánwěi, háowú yǐnmán de chéngdān le zìjǐ yīngdāng chéngdān de guǎnlǐ zérèn.
example_sentences.en: When questioned by the organization, he honestly explained the whole affair, candidly accepting his due managerial responsibility without concealment.
example_sentences.es: Al ser interrogado por la comisión, explicó los hechos con total sinceridad y transparencia, asumiendo su cuota de responsabilidad sin ocultar nada.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在那个礼崩乐坏、尔虞我诈的乱世之中，像子路这样老实淳朴、言出必行的仁厚君子尤为罕见。他的一言一行皆发自纯粹赤诚，对父母的孝顺更是没有丝毫矫饰与伪善。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài nàge lǐbēng-yuèhuài, ěryú-wǒzhà de luànshì zhīzhōng, xiàng Zǐlù zhèyàng lǎoshi chúnpǔ, yánchū-bìxíng de rénhòu jūnzǐ yóuwéi hǎnjiàn. Tā de yìyán-yìxíng jiē fā zì chúncuì chìchéng, duì fùmǔ de xiàoshùn gèng shì méiyǒu sīháo jiǎoshì yǔ wěishàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amid turmoil and deceit, honest and upright gentlemen like Zilu were rare. Every word and deed flowed from genuine sincerity, and his devotion to his parents contained no hint of pretense.
extended_reading_passages.es: En una época de intrigas y desmoronamiento moral, caballeros tan honestos y cabales como Zilu eran una joya. Cada uno de sus actos emanaba de una pureza genuina, sin asomo de hipocresía en su amor filial.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 民间常说“老实人吃亏”，但在长期的社会博弈与信用演化中，老实守信的个体往往能够建立起最稳固的信誉资本。现代行为经济学实验证实，真诚老实的合作态度不仅能降低沟通协作成本，更是维系健康社会信任网络的基石。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Mínjiān cháng shuō "lǎoshirén chīkuī", dàn zài chángqī de shèhuì bóyì yǔ xìnyòng yǎnhuà zhōng, lǎoshi shǒuxìn de gètǐ wǎngwǎng nénggòu jiànlì qǐ zuì wěngù de xìnyù zīběn. Xiàndài xíngwéi jīngjìxué shíyàn zhèngshí, zhēnchéng lǎoshi de hézuò tàidù bùjǐn néng jiàngdī gōutōng xiézuò chéngběn, gèng shì wéixì jiànkāng shèhuì xìnrèn wǎngluò de jīshí.
extended_reading_passages.en: Folks say "honest people lose out," yet in long-term social cooperation, honesty builds sterling credit capital. Behavioral economics proves that sincere, honest collaboration lowers friction and anchors societal trust.
extended_reading_passages.es: Aunque el refrán afirme que la bondad peca de ingenua, la honestidad forja a largo plazo el crédito moral más sólido. La economía conductual demuestra que la cooperación sincera abarata la desconfianza y cimienta redes sociales sanas.

meanings_summary.en: on-site; the actual place; in the field; practical
meanings_summary.es: sobre el terreno; en el lugar de los hechos; in situ; práctico

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Walking with solid purpose (实) directly upon the real ground (地) places you firmly on-site (实地).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Pisar con certeza sólida (实) directamente sobre el suelo físico (地) significa investigar sobre el terreno (实地).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese epistemology, truth must be tested through feet planted firmly on the ground (脚踏实地) and field research (实地调研), rejecting baseless dogmatism.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by falling 4th tone: shí dì (35-51). 'shí' rises steadily from mid-pitch before snapping into low-falling 'dì'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 实地 specifies physical presence at the actual location where events occur, contrasting against laboratory or theoretical analysis.

contrasts.analysis: 实地 focuses on the geographic or physical field context, whereas 现场 highlights the immediate time-space occurrence of an event or performance.
实地 emphasizes the method of on-site inquiry, whereas 本地 designates local geographic jurisdiction and residents.
实地 is a spatial noun meaning on-site or in the field, whereas 实践 is a philosophical and action-oriented noun/verb denoting putting theory into human practice.

senses.definition_en: the actual physical site or field where events or conditions occur
senses.definition_es: sobre el terreno; in situ; lugar real de los hechos
senses.example_phrase: 实地考察 (on-site inspection)

example_sentences.hanzi: 专家组不辞劳苦深入偏远山区进行实地考察，全面掌握了当地水土流失的第一手详实资料。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhuānjiāzǔ bùcí-láokǔ shēnrù piānyuǎn shānqū jìnxíng shídì kǎochá, quánmiàn zhǎngwò le dāngdì shuǐtǔ liúshī de dì-yī shǒu xiángshí zīliào.
example_sentences.en: The expert team spared no effort delving deep into remote mountains for on-site inspections, mastering first-hand detailed data on local soil erosion.
example_sentences.es: El grupo de expertos no escatimó esfuerzos para adentrarse en las montañas a fin de realizar una inspección sobre el terreno, obteniendo datos de primera mano sobre la erosión del suelo.

example_sentences.hanzi: 该地质工程项目要求技术团队必须前往实地测量岩层数据，严禁仅凭历史图纸闭门造车。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gāi dìzhì gōngchéng xiàngmù yāoqiú jìshù tuánduì bìxū qiánwǎng shídì cèliáng yáncéng shùjù, yánjìn jǐn píng lìshǐ túzhǐ bìmén-zàochē.
example_sentences.en: The geological project required technical staff to measure rock strata on-site, strictly forbidding armchair designs based solely on obsolete maps.
example_sentences.es: El proyecto de ingeniería geológica exigió al equipo medir los estratos rocosos in situ, prohibiendo estrictamente diseñar a ciegas basándose solo en planos viejos.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Pisar la tierra fértil (土) que se extiende sobre el suelo del mundo (也).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 子路深知，单靠空想无法解决双亲的饥寒。唯有亲自走向实地，用双脚丈量百里山川，用双手承担繁重劳作，才能换来实实在在的白米与铜钱，兑现对父母最赤诚的承诺。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǐlù shēnzhī, dān kào kōngxiǎng wúfǎ jiějué shuāngqīn de jīhán. Wéiyǒu qīnzì zǒuxiàng shídì, yòng shuāngjiǎo zhàngliáng bǎilǐ shānchuān, yòng shuāngshǒu chéngdān fánzhòng láozuò, cáinéng huànlái shíshízàizài de báimǐ yǔ tóngqián, duìxiàn duì fùmǔ zuì chìchéng de chéngnuò.
extended_reading_passages.en: Zilu knew that wishing alone could not solve his parents' hunger. Only by stepping into the field, measuring miles on foot and laboring with his hands, could he bring home real rice and coins to fulfill his filial vow.
extended_reading_passages.es: Zilu sabía que lamentarse no calmaría el hambre de sus padres. Solo acudiendo sobre el terreno a pie y realizando faenas con sus manos podría conseguir arroz y dinero contante para honrar su promesa filial.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在社会科学与人文学科研究中，扎根实地的田野调查是克服理论空洞化的关键法宝。研究者唯有深入实地倾听民众心声、细致观察社会运行的微观肌理，方能产出经得起历史检验的真知灼见。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài shèhuì kēxué yǔ rénwén xuékē yánjiū zhōng, zhāgēn shídì de tiányě diàochá shì kèfú lǐlùn kōngdònghuà de guānjiàn fǎbǎo. Yánjiūzhě wéiyǒu shēnrù shídì qīngtīng mínzhòng xīnshēng, xìzhì guānchá shèhuì yùnxíng de wēiguān jīlǐ, fāng néng chǎnchū jīngdeqǐ lìshǐ jiǎnyàn de zhēnzhī-zhuójiàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In social sciences and humanities, grounded fieldwork on-site is the antidote to hollow abstraction. Only by venturing into the field to listen to people and observe society can scholars produce profound insights that stand the test of time.
extended_reading_passages.es: En las ciencias sociales y humanidades, la investigación sobre el terreno es esencial para no caer en abstracciones vacías. Solo adentrándose in situ para escuchar al pueblo y observar la realidad pueden alcanzarse conclusiones certeras y perdurables.

meanings_summary.en: salary; wages; remuneration for manual labor
meanings_summary.es: salario; jornal; sueldo por trabajo manual; paga

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The monetary compensation (钱) earned through skillful manual labor (工) constitutes an honest wage (工钱).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La compensación en dinero (钱) obtenida mediante el esfuerzo y la labor artesanal (工) conforma el jornal (工钱).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In traditional Chinese societies, 工钱 refers specifically to wages for tangible physical labor, held with high moral respect as the fruits of honest sweat.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-level 1st tone followed by rising 2nd tone: gōng qián (55-35). 'gōng' sustains high pitch before transitioning to upward 'qián'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 工钱 is colloquial vocabulary referring specifically to wages paid for physical, manual, or craft work.

contrasts.analysis: 工钱 is colloquial and spoken, typically referring to task wages for manual laborers, whereas 工资 is formal and standard across all employment contracts.
工钱 emphasizes physical toil and sweat, whereas 薪水 often refers to white-collar corporate salaries or monthly allowances.
工钱 is strictly monetary cash for labor, whereas 报酬 is a broad formal term encompassing monetary payments, royalties, or consulting fees.

Top line crosses vertical stem in different proportions
Has 纟 (silk) radical on the left with 戋 on the right

senses.definition_en: payment or wages given for physical or manual labor
senses.definition_es: sueldo o paga por trabajo manual o jornalero
senses.example_phrase: 结清工钱 (settle wages)

example_sentences.hanzi: 到了年底，工程包工头按时将一整年的辛苦工钱如数结清并发放到了每一位工友手中。
example_sentences.pinyin: Dào le niándǐ, gōngchéng bāogōngtóu ànshí jiāng yì zhěng nián de xīnkǔ gōngqián rúshù jiéqīng bìng fāfàng dào le měi yí wèi gōngyǒu shǒuzhōng.
example_sentences.en: At year's end, the contractor settled and distributed the full year's hard-earned wages on time into each worker's hands.
example_sentences.es: A finales de año, el contratista liquidó puntualmente el salario de todo el año, entregándolo íntegro a cada uno de los peones.

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了保障广大灵活就业者的合法权益，劳动仲裁部门开通了针对拖欠工钱行为的绿色维权通道。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile bǎozhàng guǎngdà línghuó jiùyèzhě de héfǎ quányì, láodòng zhòngcái bùmén kāitōng le zhēnduì tuōqiàn gōngqián xíngwéi de lǜsè wéiquán tōngdào.
example_sentences.en: To protect flexible workers' lawful rights, the labor arbitration department opened an expedited channel specifically for wage arrears.
example_sentences.es: Para salvaguardar los derechos legítimos de los trabajadores, el departamento laboral habilitó una vía rápida contra el impago o retraso de jornales.

idioms.meaning_en: remuneration according to work performed
more work yields greater rewards
distinguished service; contributions forged through sweat
reap without sowing; gain without labor

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Pictographic depiction of a carpenter's square or building tool, symbolizing craft, construction, and manual labor.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A carpenter's square and plumb line held to build structures.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: La escuadra y plomada de un artesano empleadas para edificar obras sólidas.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 钅 (metal) + 戋 (small/cleaved bronze spade implement), originally a small agricultural spade tool used as early currency, later money.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Bronze coins cast from metal (钅) clinking in a leather pouch.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Monedas de bronce fundidas en metal (钅) tintineando en una faltriquera.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 子路在富人家中舂米多日，领到了沉甸甸的银子作为工钱。他小心翼翼地把工钱包在粗布帕子里，舍不得给自己买一件御寒的棉衣，只想着用这些钱给父母买米充饥。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǐlù zài fùjiā zhòng chōngmǐ duō rì, lǐngdào le chéndiāndiān de yínzi zuòwéi gōngqián. Tā xiǎoxīn-yìyì de bǎ gōngqián bāo zài cūbù pàzi lǐ, shěbude gěi zìjǐ mǎi yí jiàn yùhán de miányī, zhǐ xiǎngzhe yòng zhèxiē qián gěi fùmǔ mǎi mǐ chōngjī.
extended_reading_passages.en: Pounding rice for days in the rich house, Zilu received heavy silver as wages. Carefully wrapping the coins in a cloth, he refrained from buying warm clothes for himself, eager only to buy rice for his parents.
extended_reading_passages.es: Tras moler grano durante días, Zilu recibió unas pesadas monedas de plata como salario. Envolviéndolas con cuidado en un pañuelo basto, no gastó en ropa de abrigo para sí, anhelando solo comprar arroz para sus padres.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 劳动报酬是现代劳动法与社会正义的核心议题。“工钱”二字凝结着千百年来基层劳动者的生存尊严与血汗付出。建立完善的工资支付保障制度，杜绝任何形式的薪资拖欠，是维护社会公平与劳动者合法权益的基本底线。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Láodòng bàochou shì xiàndài láodòngfǎ yǔ shèhuì zhèngyì de héxīn yìtí. "Gōngqián" èr zì níngjié zhe qiānbǎinián lái jīcéng láodòngzhě de shēngcún zūnyán yǔ xuèhàn fùchū. Jiànlì wánshàn de gōngzī zhīfù bǎozhàng zhìdù, dùjué rènhé xíngshì de xīnzī tuōqiàn, shì wéihù shèhuì gōngpíng yǔ láodòngzhě héfǎ quányì de jīběn dǐxiàn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Remuneration is the core topic of modern labor law. The word '工钱' encapsulates centuries of working-class dignity and honest sweat. Establishing sound wage guarantees and preventing wage arrears are vital baselines for social justice.
extended_reading_passages.es: La remuneración del trabajo es el núcleo de la justicia social. La palabra "gongqian" encierra la dignidad y el sudor de generaciones de trabajadores. Erradicar los impagos y asegurar salarios dignos constituye un deber elemental de equidad.

meanings_summary.en: to calculate; to compute; to count; to consider as; to plan
meanings_summary.es: calcular; contar; computar; considerar como; planear

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Using two hands to manipulate bamboo counting rods (竹) lets you tally and calculate (算) with precision.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Mover con ambas manos las varillas de cálculo de bambú (竹) permite computar y calcular (算) con exactitud.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: Ancient Chinese mathematics relied on bamboo counting rods (筹算) and the abacus (算盘). Calculation was both a science and an everyday mercantile skill.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-falling 4th tone: suàn (51). Deliver with decisive, crisp downward inflection.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 算 encompasses arithmetic calculation, cognitive planning, and deeming/considering something to qualify under a category.

contrasts.analysis: 算 is versatile, everyday, and idiomatic (算了吧, 说了算, 总算), whereas 计算 is technical and mathematical for quantitative operations.
算 means to officially deem or count as, whereas 以为 indicates subjective, often erroneous presumption.
算 can function as calculating or evaluating, while 打算 is strictly a mental intention or plan for future actions.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 自 (nose) above 畀 instead of 竹
Has 朿 below 竹 instead of 目+廾
Has 官 below 竹 instead of 目+廾
Has 相 below 竹 instead of 目+廾

senses.definition_en: to calculate, reckon, or tally numbers/finances
senses.definition_es: calcular; computar; hacer cuentas
senses.example_phrase: 算一算总账 (calculate the total account)

senses.definition_en: to consider, regard, or count as; at long last
senses.definition_es: considerar; contar como; por fin
senses.example_phrase: 这就算完成了 (this counts as finished)

example_sentences.hanzi: 掌柜仔细拨弄着手里的算盘，反复核算了三遍，确保每一笔收支账目都分毫不差。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhǎngguì zǐxì bōnòng zhe shǒulǐ de suànpán, fǎnfù hésuàn le sān biàn, quèbǎo měi yì bǐ shōuzhī zhàngmù dōu fēnháo-bùchà.
example_sentences.en: The shopkeeper meticulously flicked the beads of his abacus, calculating three times to ensure every income and expense entry was accurate to the penny.
example_sentences.es: El tendero movió con esmero las cuentas del ábaco, recalculando tres veces para cerciorarse de que cada asiento contable cuadrara al céntimo.

example_sentences.hanzi: 历经长达三年的刻苦钻研与反复试验，新技术测试终于取得了圆满成功，这下总算大功告成了！
example_sentences.pinyin: Lìjīng chángdá sān nián de kèkǔ zuānyán yǔ fǎnfù shìyàn, xīn jìshù cèshì zhōngyú qǔdé le yuánmǎn chénggōng, zhèxià zǒngsuàn dàgōng-gàochéng le!
example_sentences.en: After three years of painstaking research and experiments, the technology test finally succeeded completely; at long last the grand mission was accomplished!
example_sentences.es: Tras tres años de paciente investigación y ensayos constantes, la nueva tecnología superó con éxito las pruebas; ¡por fin se coronó la gran obra!

idioms.meaning_en: meticulous planning and strict budgeting
miraculous foresight and ingenious calculation

idioms.pinyin: rén suàn bù rú tiān suàn
idioms.meaning_en: man proposes, God disposes; human calculation falls short of Heaven's
discuss leisurely from a long-term perspective

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic compound: hands (廾) manipulating bamboo counting rods (竹) on a counting board (目/具).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two hands manipulating bamboo rods (竹) on an abacus to tally wealth.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos manos ágiles manipulando varillas de bambú (竹) sobre un ábaco para llevar las cuentas.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 子路在归途中一边顶着寒风赶路，一边在心里暗暗盘算：剩下的一小袋米不仅够父母度过严冬，剩余的银子还能添置几件厚实的冬衣。想到这里，刺骨的寒意便被胸中的温暖驱散了。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǐlù zài guītú zhōng yìbiān dǐngzhe hánfēng gǎnlù, yìbiān zài xīnlǐ àn'àn pánsuan: shèngxià de yì xiǎo dài mǐ bùjǐn gòu fùmǔ dùguò yándōng, shèngyú de yínzi hái néng tiānzhì jǐ jiàn hòushi de dōngyī. Xiǎngdào zhèlǐ, cìgǔ de hányì biàn bèi xiōngzhōng de wēnnuǎn qūsàn le.
extended_reading_passages.en: Hurrying through icy gales on his return, Zilu calculated in his heart: the sack of rice would feed his parents through winter, and leftover silver could buy warm clothes. The cold melted in his warm devotion.
extended_reading_passages.es: Caminando contra el gélido viento, Zilu calculaba en silencio: el arroz mantendría a sus padres todo el invierno y la plata restante serviría para ropa de abrigo. La dicha interior disipó el frío.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 中国古代筹算与珠算体系展现了独特的算法智慧。从《九章算术》到明代普及的珠算，“算”不仅是商业贸易中厘清盈亏的实用工具，更承载着先民通过理性数理格物致知、探求天地运行法则的哲学追求。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zhōngguó gǔdài chóusuàn yǔ zhūsuàn tǐxì zhǎnxiàn le dútè de suànfǎ zhìhuì. Cóng "Jiǔzhāng Suànshù" dào Míngdài pǔjí de zhūsuàn, "suàn" bùjǐn shì shāngyè màoyì zhōng líqīng yíngkuī de shíyòng gōngjù, gèng chéngzài zhe xiānmín tōngguò lǐxìng shùlǐ géwù-zhìzhī, tànqiú tiāndì yùnxíng fǎzé de zhéxué zhuīqiú.
extended_reading_passages.en: Ancient Chinese counting-rod and abacus arithmetic embodied mathematical genius. From "The Nine Chapters" to the abacus, calculation served not only commerce but philosophers seeking heavenly principles.
extended_reading_passages.es: Los sistemas antiguos de varillas y ábaco reflejaron un ingenio matemático único. El cómputo no solo resolvía transacciones comerciales, sino que guiaba la búsqueda filosófica de las leyes cósmicas.

meanings_summary.en: bonus; financial award; prize money; monetary incentive
meanings_summary.es: prima; bono; gratificación; premio en metálico

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When merited honors and praise (奖) are bestowed in the form of precious money (金), you receive a financial bonus (奖金).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando el mérito y el elogio (奖) se retribuyen con dinero contante (金), se recibe una gratificación económica (奖金).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese administrative and business philosophy, rewards and punishments are the two levers of governance. 奖金 embodies the material incentive driving diligence.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by high-level 1st tone: jiǎng jīn (214-55). 'jiǎng' dips fully before vaulting into clear high tone on 'jīn'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 奖金 specifically denotes supplementary incentive cash awarded above base wages for superior performance or contest prizes.

contrasts.analysis: 工资 is base, contractual guaranteed compensation for regular employment, whereas 奖金 is variable, performance-linked bonus cash.
奖金 is strictly monetary cash rewards, whereas 奖品 denotes physical non-monetary prizes such as trophies, medals, or electronics.
奖金 is an incentive premium above normal earnings, while 报酬 covers the entire compensation package for labor or intellectual service.

Has 水 (water) below 将 instead of 大
Has 酉 (ferment vessel) below 将
Has 人 (person) atop 王 instead of 金

senses.definition_en: supplementary money awarded as incentive, reward for merit, or prize
senses.definition_es: prima; bono económico; dinero concedido como premio
senses.example_phrase: 发放年终奖金 (distribute year-end bonus)

example_sentences.hanzi: 庄园主人格外赞赏子路的诚实与勤劳，在结清常规工钱之外，还特意额外赠予了他一笔丰厚的奖金。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zhuāngyuán zhǔrén géwài zànshǎng Zǐlù de chéngshí yǔ qínláo, zài jiéqīng chángguī gōngqián zhīwài, hái tèyì éwài zèngyǔ le tā yì bǐ fēnghòu de jiǎngjīn.
example_sentences.en: The estate master admired Zilu's honesty and diligence so much that besides settling regular wages, he specially gifted him a generous bonus.
example_sentences.es: El dueño de la hacienda apreció tanto la honradez y diligencia de Zilu que, además de liquidar su jornal habitual, le concedió una generosa gratificación adicional.

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了激发科研人员攻坚克难的创新活力，该高新技术园区设立了总额超千万的科技成果专项奖金。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile jīfā kēyán rényuán gōngjiān-kènán de chuàngxīn huólì, gāi gāoxīnjìshù yuánqū shèlì le zǒng'é chāo qiānwàn de kējì chéngguǒ zhuānxiàng jiǎngjīn.
example_sentences.en: To ignite researchers' innovative drive to tackle core challenges, the high-tech park established a specialized tech achievement bonus pool exceeding 10 million yuan.
example_sentences.es: Para alentar a los investigadores a superar retos tecnológicos, el parque científico creó un fondo especial de primas que supera los diez millones de yuanes.

heavy rewards attract brave men
award prizes according to merit
turn iron into gold; magical transformative power

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A valiant commander (将) presenting honors and gifts to a loyal hound (大/犬).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un general (将) que condecora y premia la lealtad de un fiel sabueso (大/犬).

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Precious nuggets of golden metal mined from deep veins of earth.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Valiosas pepitas de oro extraídas de las vetas profundas de la tierra.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 不仅按时领到了工钱，主人还因其忠厚多赠予了子路一笔意外的奖金。子路手握沉甸甸的银两，对主人的仁厚深怀感恩，立刻奔向集镇采购最饱满的稻谷与干粮。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Bùjǐn ànshí lǐngdào le gōngqián, zhǔrén hái yīn qí zhōnghòu duō zèngyǔ le Zǐlù yì bǐ yìwài de jiǎngjīn. Zǐlù shǒu wò chéndiāndiān de yínliǎng, duì zhǔrén de rénhòu shēn huái gǎn'ēn, lìkè bēn xiàng jīzhèn cǎigòu zuì bǎomǎn de dàogǔ yǔ gānliáng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Not only did he receive his wages on time, but the master gifted Zilu an unexpected bonus for honesty. Gripping the heavy silver with gratitude, Zilu hurried to the town market to buy grains.
extended_reading_passages.es: Además de cobrar su sueldo a tiempo, el patrón premió la lealtad de Zilu con una gratificación imprevista. Sosteniendo la plata con gratitud, marchó de prisa al pueblo a comprar grano.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 现代薪酬激励机制普遍将浮动奖金作为提升团队效能与留存核心人才的关键工具。合理的奖金分配机制不仅能够打破干多干少一个样的平均主义弊端，更能将组织的长远战略目标与劳动者的个体切身利益紧密绑定。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xiàndài xīnchóu jīlì jīzhì pǔbiàn jiāng fúdòng jiǎngjīn zuòwéi tíshēng tuánduì xiàonéng yǔ liúcún héxīn réncái de guānjiàn gōngjù. Hélǐ de jiǎngjīn fēnpèi jīzhì bùjǐn nénggòu dǎpò gàn duō gàn shǎo yíyàng de píngjūnzhǔyì bìduān, gèng néng jiāng zǔzhī de chángyuǎn zhànlüè mùbiāo yǔ láodòngzhě de gètǐ qiēshēn lìyì jǐnmì bǎngdìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Modern compensation systems widely adopt performance bonuses to enhance productivity and retain talent. A sound bonus mechanism eliminates egalitarian complacency, aligning strategic goals with employee welfare.
extended_reading_passages.es: La retribución variable mediante primas constituye un pilar de la gestión moderna. Una asignación equitativa supera la desmotivación igualitarista y alinea el éxito de la empresa con el beneficio del trabajador.

meanings_summary.en: to start on a journey; to set off; to hit the road; to get on track
meanings_summary.es: ponerse en camino; emprender el viaje; ponerse en marcha; encarrilarse

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Stepping upward (上) to place your feet on the open road (路) means setting off on a journey (上路).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Dar un paso al frente (上) para pisar el camino abierto (路) significa ponerse en marcha (上路).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese journey literature, 上路 marks the emotional farewell parting home and loved ones to face unknown mountain perils.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two consecutive falling 4th tones: shàng lù (51-51). Pronounce both with firm, crisp downward inflection.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 上路 focuses on the concrete initial moment of starting to travel along a highway or road.

contrasts.analysis: 上路 specifically evokes physical motion onto a road or path, whereas 出发 is the standard general verb for departure from any origin point.
上路 is informal, narrative, and spoken, whereas 启程 is formal, literary, or ceremonial.
上路 marks the beginning of the trip, whereas 赶路 focuses on hurrying rapidly while already mid-journey to reach a destination in time.

senses.definition_en: to set out on a journey or trip; to take to the road
senses.definition_es: ponerse en camino; emprender la marcha

example_sentences.hanzi: 天刚蒙蒙亮，年轻的子路便背起沉甸甸的百斤大米，冒着漫天飞舞的风雪毅然踏步上路。
example_sentences.pinyin: Tiān gāng méngméngliàng, niánqīng de Zǐlù biàn bēiqǐ chéndiāndiān de bǎi jīn dàmǐ, màozhe màntiān-fēiwǔ de fēngxuě yìrán tàbù shànglù.
example_sentences.en: Just as dawn faintly broke, young Zilu shouldered the hundred-catty sack of rice and resolutely hit the road amidst whirling snow.
example_sentences.es: Cuando apenas despuntaba el alba, el joven Zilu se echó a la espalda el pesado saco de cien libras de arroz y se puso resueltamente en camino bajo la ventisca.

example_sentences.hanzi: 新手司机在取得驾照后必须经过系统的跟车陪练，熟悉复杂路况之后方可独立驾车上路。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xīnshǒu sījī zài qǔdé jiàzhào hòu bìxū jīngguò xìtǒng de gēnchē péiliàn, shúxī fùzá lùkuàng zhīhòu fāng kě dúlì jiàchē shànglù.
example_sentences.en: Novice drivers must undergo accompanied practice after obtaining a license, driving on the road independently only after mastering complex traffic.
example_sentences.es: Los conductores noveles deben realizar prácticas acompañadas tras obtener la licencia, conduciendo por carretera de forma autónoma solo tras familiarizarse con el tráfico.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 虽然寒风呼啸、积雪没膝，但为了让久病的双亲尽快吃上热腾腾的白米饭，子路咬紧牙关，在天未破晓之时便义无反顾地上路了。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suīrán hánfēng hūxiào, jīxuě mòxī, dàn wèile ràng jiǔbìng de shuāngqīn jǐnkuài chī shang rèténgténg de báimǐfàn, Zǐlù yǎojǐn yáguān, zài tiān wèi pòxiǎo zhī shí biàn yìwúfǎngù de shànglù le.
extended_reading_passages.en: Though icy winds howled and snow was knee-deep, Zilu gritted his teeth and resolutely set off before dawn so his ailing parents could eat hot rice as soon as possible.
extended_reading_passages.es: Aunque el viento aullaba y la nieve cubría los caminos, Zilu apretó los dientes y partió resueltamente antes del alba para llevarles arroz caliente a sus padres enfermos.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 人生就像一场漫长的远行，每一次背起行囊上路，都是对自我意志的淬炼与升华。无论前方的道路如何崎岖险峻，唯有怀揣坚定的信念与爱意，才能在风霜雨雪的洗礼中走出属于自己的坚实步伐。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Rénshēng jiù xiàng yì chǎng màncháng de yuǎnxíng, měi yí cì bēiqǐ xíngnáng shànglù, dōu shì duì zìwǒ yìzhì de cuìliàn yǔ shēnghuá. Wúlùn qiánfāng de dàolù rúhé qíqū xiǎnjùn, wéiyǒu huáichuāi jiāndìng de xìnniàn yǔ àiyì, cáinéng zài fēngshuāng-yǔxuě de xǐlǐ zhōng zǒuchū shǔyú zìjǐ de jiānshí bùfá.
extended_reading_passages.en: Life is a long journey; every time one shoulders a pack and hits the road, the will is tempered and refined. No matter how rugged the path ahead, holding firm conviction and love allows one to stride solidly through storms.
extended_reading_passages.es: La vida es un largo viaje: cada partida con el morral a cuestas templa el carácter. Por escabroso que sea el camino, abrigar convicción y amor permite avanzar con paso firme a través de cualquier tempestad.

meanings_summary.en: to pass by; to pass through; to go past on one's way
meanings_summary.es: pasar por; pasar de paso; transitar de camino

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Traveling along the road (路) and stepping past (过) intermediate stops means passing by (路过).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Transitar por el camino (路) y cruzar de largo (过) por una parada intermedia significa pasar de paso (路过).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese cultural geography, traveling between countryside hamlets meant passing by market hubs, serving as temporary shelters for travelers.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two consecutive falling 4th tones: lù guò (51-51) or lù guo (51-0) when unstressed as a complement.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 路过 emphasizes passing through or near an intermediate location along a route toward a distinct ultimate destination.

contrasts.analysis: 路过 specifically denotes passing by a physical geographical site on one's route, whereas 经过 encompasses both passing locations and undergoing temporal processes.
路过 implies passing near or skirting by a place en route, whereas 穿过 denotes piercing directly through the center of a physical space or barrier.
路过 is everyday spoken language, while 途经 is formal, written transportation terminology used in schedules and itineraries.

senses.definition_en: to pass by or travel through a place en route to another destination
senses.definition_es: pasar por; transitar de paso por un lugar
senses.example_phrase: 路过小镇 (pass through a small town)

example_sentences.hanzi: 在背米返乡的漫长旅途中，子路路过了一座热闹的小集镇，稍作歇息并喝了碗热开水暖身。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài bēimǐ fǎnxiāng de màncháng lǚtú zhōng, Zǐlù lùguò le yí zuò rènao de xiǎo jīzhèn, shāo zuò xiēxi bìng hē le wǎn rè kāishuǐ nuǎnshēn.
example_sentences.en: On his long journey home carrying rice, Zilu passed through a bustling small town, resting briefly and drinking hot water to warm his body.
example_sentences.es: En el largo trayecto de regreso con el arroz, Zilu pasó por un concurrido pueblo, descansando un instante y tomando agua caliente para templar el cuerpo.

example_sentences.hanzi: 我这次去上海出差正好路过苏州，便顺道去探望了多年未曾谋面的大学同窗好友。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zhè cì qù Shànghǎi chūchāi zhènghǎo lùguò Sūzhōu, biàn shùndào qù tànwàng le duō nián wèicéng móumiàn de dàxué tóngchuāng hǎoyǒu.
example_sentences.en: On my business trip to Shanghai I happened to pass through Suzhou, so I stopped by to visit a college friend I hadn't seen in years.
example_sentences.es: En mi viaje de negocios a Shanghái pasé por Suzhou, así que aproveché para visitar a un buen compañero de universidad al que no veía hacía años.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 子路背着重负路过喧闹的集市，路旁热气腾腾的饭菜香气扑鼻而来。但他摸了摸怀里的银两，想到家中挨饿的双亲，没有停下享用一口，而是匆匆迈步赶路。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǐlù bēizhe zhòngfù lùguò xuānnào de jíshì, lùpáng rèqì-téngténg de fàncài xiāngqì pūbí ér lái. Dàn tā mō le mō huáilǐ de yínliǎng, xiǎngdào jiāzhōng ái'è de shuāngqīn, méiyǒu tíngxià xiǎngyòng yì kǒu, ér shì cōngcōng màibù gǎnlù.
extended_reading_passages.en: Carrying his heavy load, Zilu passed by the bustling bazaar where appetizing aromas drifted from stalls. But touching the silver in his coat and thinking of his parents, he hurried past without stopping.
extended_reading_passages.es: Con el pesado saco a cuestas, Zilu pasó junto al bullicioso mercado con humeantes aromas de comida. Mas tocando la plata que guardaba y pensando en sus padres hambrientos, aceleró el paso sin detenerse.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 人生旅途中，我们往往会路过无数美丽的风景与繁华的驿站。许多人容易在暂时的安逸中迷失初衷，而唯有那些时刻牢记心中灯塔、不为沿途诱惑所驻足的行者，才能最终抵达魂牵梦绕的温暖彼岸。(89 Hanzi)
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Rénshēng lǚtú zhōng, wǒmen wǎngwǎng huì lùguò wúshù měilì de fēngjǐng yǔ fánhuá de yìzhàn. Xǔduō rén róngyì zài zànshí de ānyì zhōng míshī chūzhōng, ér wéiyǒu nàxiē shíkè láojì xīnzhōng dēngtǎ, bù wèi yántú yòuhuò suǒ zhùzú de xíngzhě, cáinéng zuìzhōng dǐdá húnqiān-mèngrào de wēnnuǎn bǐ'àn.
extended_reading_passages.en: On life's journey, we pass by countless picturesque landscapes and bustling stations. Many lose their initial resolve in comfort, yet only those who keep their inner lighthouse in mind and resist distractions can arrive at the warm shores of their dreams.
extended_reading_passages.es: A lo largo de la vida pasamos por innumerables parajes seductores. Muchos extravían su propósito original en la comodidad pasajera; solo aquellos que recuerdan su faro interior avanzan sin vacilar hasta alcanzar el cálido destino anhelado.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A heavy bronze anchor of metal (钅) set down with unwavering solidity (真) anchors a peaceful market town (镇).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un sólido ancla de bronce (钅) asentado con firmeza y verdad (真) da estabilidad al pueblo (镇).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient Chinese administrative geography, 镇 evolved from military garrisons into thriving market towns bridging rural villages and county cities.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-falling 4th tone: zhèn (51). Deliver with decisive, full dropping pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 镇 specifies a township or urban-rural intermediate settlement larger than a village but smaller than a city, or the verb to pacify.

contrasts.analysis: 镇 is an administrative town or commercial center with shops and municipal services, whereas 村 is a smaller agricultural hamlet or village.
镇 is subordinate to counties/districts, whereas 市 is a major city or municipality with large populations and industrial scale.
镇 refers to an entire township community, whereas 坊 refers to a neighborhood block or craft workshop.

example_sentences.hanzi: 穿过这片连绵起伏的崇山峻岭，前面便是方圆数十里内最为繁华热闹的商贸小镇。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chuānguò zhè piàn liánmián-qǐfú de chóngshān-jùnlǐng, qiánmiàn biàn shì fāngyuán shùshí lǐ nèi zuìwéi fánhuá rènao de shāngmào xiǎozhèn.
example_sentences.en: Crossing this undulating range of lofty peaks, ahead lies the most bustling commercial town within dozens of miles.
example_sentences.es: Al cruzar esta cordillera de cumbres escarpadas, se divisa el pueblo comercial más concurrido en decenas de leguas a la redonda.

example_sentences.hanzi: 该古镇依山傍水、风景如画，近年来依托深厚的人文底蕴大力发展了特色文旅产业。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gāi gǔzhèn yīshān-bàngshuǐ, fēngjǐng-rúhuà, jìnniánlái yītuō shēnhòu de rénwén dǐyùn dàlì fāzhǎn le tèsè wénlǚ chǎnyè.
example_sentences.en: Nestled against mountains and flanked by rivers, this picturesque ancient town has vigorously developed cultural tourism rooted in deep heritage.
example_sentences.es: Asentado entre montañas y ríos con paisajes de ensueño, este pueblo histórico ha potenciado el turismo cultural gracias a su rica herencia.

calm and unperturbed in the face of crisis
bring peace and stability to the state
outshining the moon and shaming the flowers

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 钅 (heavy metal paperweight or bronze anchor) + 真 (firm truth), originally meaning a heavy metallic weight to hold down objects, extending to military garrison towns and market settlements.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A heavy bronze metal weight (钅) set firmly to stabilize a bustling community (真).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un pesado pisapapeles de bronce (钅) colocado con firmeza para pacificar y ordenar la villa (真).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 严冬的傍晚，子路终于在漫天飞雪中赶到了百里之外的小镇。小镇街市上炊烟袅袅，他用积攒的工钱在米行买下一大袋白米，随即片刻不停地踏上了归途。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yándōng de bàngwǎn, Zǐlù zhōngyú zài màntiān fēixuě zhōng gǎndào le bǎilǐ zhī wài de xiǎozhèn. Xiǎozhèn jiēshì shàng chuīyān-niǎoniǎo, tā yòng jīzǎn de gōngqián zài mǐháng mǎixià yí dà dài báimǐ, suíjī piànkè bù tíng de tàshang le guītú.
extended_reading_passages.en: On a harsh winter dusk, Zilu finally reached the small town hundreds of miles away through whirling snow. With his hard-earned wages, he bought a large sack of rice and set off on his return without a moment's pause.
extended_reading_passages.es: En un gélido atardecer, Zilu llegó al pueblo a más de cien leguas bajo la ventisca. Compró un gran saco de arroz con sus ahorros y, sin descansar ni un instante, emprendió el camino de vuelta.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 新型城镇化建设赋予了传统乡镇全新的发展活力。许多依山傍水的特色小镇通过深挖本土非遗文化与生态资源，不仅吸引了大量青年人才返乡创业，更在城乡融合发展中探索出一条可持续的共同富裕之路。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xīnxíng chéngzhènhuà jiànshè fùyǔ le chuántǒng xiāngzhèn quánxīn de fāzhǎn huólì. Xǔduō yīshān-bàngshuǐ de tèsè xiǎozhèn tōngguò shēnwā běntǔ fēiyí wénhuà yǔ shēngtài zīyuán, bùjǐn xīyǐn le dàliàng qīngnián réncái fǎnxiāng chuàngyè, gèng zài chéng-xiāng rónghé fāzhǎn zhōng tànsuǒ chū yì tiáo kěchíxù de gòngtóng fùyù zhī lù.
extended_reading_passages.en: New urbanization breathes vibrant life into traditional townships. Nestled among mountains and waterways, distinctive small towns tap into intangible heritage and green resources, attracting young entrepreneurs and pioneering sustainable prosperity.
extended_reading_passages.es: La modernización rural revitalize los municipios tradicionales. Numerosos pueblos pintorescos aprovechan su patrimonio cultural y ecológico para atraer emprendedores jóvenes, abriendo sendas sostenibles de prosperidad compartida.

meanings_summary.es: bolsa; saco; talega; bolsillo; clasificador para bolsas

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Cloth stitched like garments (衣) to substitute (代) hands in carrying heavy loads forms a sturdy sack (袋).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Tejido cosido como una prenda (衣) para suplir (代) las manos y transportar cargas pesadas es un saco (袋).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In ancient agrarian life, coarse hemp sacks were the primary containers for transporting grain harvests and barter goods across long mountain trails.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-falling 4th tone: dài (51). When following 一 (yī), 一 undergoes 2nd tone sandhi: yí dài (35-51).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 袋 denotes a flexible container made of cloth, plastic, paper, or leather used for holding, carrying, or measuring bulk goods.

contrasts.analysis: 包 is a versatile general term for backpacks, handbags, or wrapped parcels, whereas 袋 specifically emphasizes flexible sacks, pouches, or packaging bags.
袋 is modern, practical everyday vocabulary, whereas 囊 is an archaic, literary morpheme reserved for classical idioms.
袋 refers to manufactured bags and sacks, while 兜 is colloquial for clothing pockets or a curved cloth sling.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Upper phonetic component without the bottom 衣

Has 加 above 衣 instead of 代
Has 求 above 衣 instead of 代

example_sentences.hanzi: 瘦弱的子路咬紧牙关，将那沉甸甸的一整袋大米扛在肩头，步履维艰却步履坚定地向家的方向走去。
example_sentences.pinyin: Shòuruò de Zǐlù yǎojǐn yáguān, jiāng nà chéndiāndiān de yì zhěng dài dàmǐ káng zài jiāntóu, bùlǚ-wéijiān què bùlǚ jiāndìng de xiàng jiā de fāngxiàng zǒu qù.
example_sentences.en: Slender Zilu gritted his teeth, shouldered that heavy full sack of rice, and walked toward home with strenuous yet unwavering strides.
example_sentences.es: El enjuto Zilu apretó los dientes, se cargó al hombro aquel pesado saco de arroz y avanzó hacia su hogar con paso dificultoso pero inquebrantable.

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了减少白色污染与塑料垃圾，各大连锁超市全面推广使用可降解环保布袋。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile jiǎnshǎo báisè wūrǎn yǔ sùliào lājī, gè dà liánsuǒ chāoshì quánmiàn tuīguǎng shǐyòng kě-jiàngjiě huánbǎo bùdài.
example_sentences.en: To reduce white pollution and plastic waste, major supermarket chains have fully promoted biodegradable eco-friendly cloth bags.
example_sentences.es: Con el fin de reducir la contaminación plástica, las principales cadenas de supermercados han promovido el uso de bolsas de tela biodegradables.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 代 (phonetic) + 衣 (garment cloth), originally a cloth pouch or sack sewn from woven fabric to store grain or possessions.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Fabric of woven clothing (衣) stitched into a durable sack to carry grain across generations (代).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Tela de prendas cosidas (衣) transformada en un resistente saco para transportar grano (代).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 粗糙的麻袋磨破了子路单薄的衣衫，沉重的米袋将他的肩膀压得红肿淤青。但他用双手紧紧揽住袋口，每前进一步，心中就多一份让父母尽早吃上白米的欣慰。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Cūcāo de mádài mó pò le Zǐlù dānbó de yīshān, chénzhòng de mǐdài jiāng tā de jiānbiǎng yā de hóngzhǒng yūqīng. Dàn tā yòng shuāngshǒu jǐnjǐn lǎn zhù dàikǒu, měi qiánjìn yí bù, xīnzhōng jiù duō yí fèn ràng fùmǔ jìnzǎo chī shang báimǐ de xīnwèi.
extended_reading_passages.en: The rough burlap sack rubbed through Zilu's thin shirt, bruising his shoulders under its heavy weight. Yet he clutched the mouth of the sack tightly, rejoicing with every step that his parents would soon eat white rice.
extended_reading_passages.es: El áspero saco de arpillera rasgó las finas ropas de Zilu, amoratando sus hombros bajo el tremendo peso. Mas sujetaba con firmeza la boca del saco, reconfortado a cada paso con la idea de que sus padres comerían arroz blanco.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 从远古先民用兽皮缝制的储物囊，到工业革命普及的麻袋与现代高分子包装袋，“袋”的发明与演变深刻体现了人类利用工具拓展搬运能力的技术智慧。它不仅改变了物资储运模式，更构成了人类商贸物流史的重要见证。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Cóng yuǎngǔ xiānmín yòng shòupí féngzhì de chǔwùnáng, dào gōngyè gémìng pǔjí de mádài yǔ xiàndài gāofēnzǐ bāozhuāngdài, "dài" de fāmíng yǔ yǎnbiàn shēnkè tǐxiàn le rénlèi lìyòng gōngjù tuòzhǎn bānyùn nénglì de jìshù zhìhuì. Tā bùjǐn gǎibiàn le wùzī chǔyùn móshì, gèng gòuchéng le rénlèi shāngmào wùliú shǐ de zhòngyào jiànzhèng.
extended_reading_passages.en: From prehistoric hide pouches to industrial burlap bags and modern polymers, the sack's evolution showcases human technological ingenuity in cargo transport. It transformed storage and logistics throughout commercial history.
extended_reading_passages.es: Desde las bolsas prehistóricas de piel hasta la arpillera industrial y los polímeros modernos, el saco refleja el ingenio humano para transportar cargas. Esta herramienta revolucionó el almacenamiento y la logística del comercio universal.

meanings_summary.en: to carry on the back; to bear on one's shoulders; to shoulder (burdens)
meanings_summary.es: cargar a la espalda; llevar a cuestas; cargar sobre los hombros

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Using the flesh and muscles (月) of your physical back (北) to haul heavy loads means to carry on the back (背, bēi).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Emplear la carne y los músculos (月) de la espalda (北) para acarrear bultos es cargar a cuestas (背, bēi).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese cultural memory, carrying rice over a hundred li (百里负米) stands as one of the 24 classic exemplars of filial piety, enshrining bodily sacrifice for parents.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-level 1st tone as a verb: bēi (55). Contrast strictly with noun 'bèi' (51, anatomical back) and verb 'bèi' (51, recite by heart, betray).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 背 (bēi) specifically characterizes carrying a burden directly supported on the human back or shoulders.

contrasts.analysis: 背 (bēi) means placing the weight across both shoulders or resting against the back, whereas 扛 (káng) involves propping a load across a single shoulder.
背 (bēi) secures the load against the body's back, whereas 挑 (tiāo) utilizes a carrying pole balanced across shoulders.
背 (bēi) supports weight from behind on the back, whereas 抱 (bào) holds an infant or object forward against the chest.

senses.definition_en: to carry an object or person upon one's back
senses.definition_es: cargar a la espalda; llevar a cuestas
senses.example_phrase: 背着米袋 (carrying a sack of rice on the back)

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对连绵起伏的风雪险峰，身材瘦削的年轻子路毅然背起百斤沉重的白米向家乡走去。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì liánmián-qǐfú de fēngxuě xiǎnfēng, shēncái shòuxuē de niánqīng Zǐlù yìrán bēiqǐ bǎi jīn chénzhòng de báimǐ xiàng jiāxiāng zǒu qù.
example_sentences.en: Facing undulating, snow-swept perilous peaks, thin young Zilu resolutely carried a hundred catties of rice on his back toward home.
example_sentences.es: Frente a las cumbres escarpadas cubiertas de nieve, el joven y delgado Zilu se echó a la espalda cien libras de arroz y avanzó resueltamente hacia su aldea.

example_sentences.hanzi: 作为偏远山区的乡村医生，他三十年如一日背着药箱穿梭于崇山峻岭之间，守护着乡亲们的生命健康。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zuòwéi piānyuǎn shānqū de xiāngcūn yīshēng, tā sānshí nián rú yí rì bēizhe yàoxiāng chuānsuō yú chóngshān-jùnlǐng zhījiān, shǒuhù zhe xiāngqīnmen de shēngmìng jiànkāng.
example_sentences.en: As a rural doctor in remote mountains, for thirty years he has carried his medicine kit on his back, trekking through lofty ranges to safeguard villagers' health.
example_sentences.es: Como médico rural en montañas remotas, durante treinta años ha llevado su botiquín a cuestas entre desfiladeros para cuidar la salud de los aldeanos.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic and ideogrammic: 北 (two people back-to-back) + 肉/月 (human flesh/body), originally the anatomical back, verbalized with tone 1 (bēi) into carrying on the back.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two figures standing back-to-back (北) resting flesh and muscle (月) beneath a heavy sack.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos personas espalda contra espalda (北) templando el músculo y la carne (月) bajo una pesada carga.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 寒风如刀割面，冰雪冻裂了鞋袜，但年轻的子路始终没有放下背上的百斤重担。他每一步都在雪地上印下深深的足迹，用脊梁背起了全家人生存的希望。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Hánfēng rú dāo gē miàn, bīngxuě dòngliè le xiéwà, dàn niánqīng de Zǐlù shǐzhōng méiyǒu fàngxià bēishàng de bǎi jīn zhòngdàn. Tā měi yí bù dōu zài xuědì shàng yìnxià shēnshēn de zújì, yòng jǐliáng bēiqǐ le quán jiārén shēngcún de xīwàng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Biting winds slashed like blades and ice froze his shoes, yet young Zilu never laid down the hundred-catty load on his back. Leaving deep footprints in snow, he shouldered his family's hope of survival.
extended_reading_passages.es: El viento gélido cortaba como navaja y el hielo congelaba sus pies, pero el joven Zilu jamás soltó el pesado saco de su espalda. Dejando profundas huellas en la nieve, cargó a cuestas la esperanza de su familia.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: “子路负米”不仅是一段感人至深的孝道佳话，更深刻具象化了中国传统士人“先天下之忧而忧”的担当精神。那一袋沉甸甸的白米，背在身躯上是家庭维系的生计重托，投射于精神世界则是无怨无悔的道德使命。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: "Zǐlù fùmǐ" bùjǐn shì yí duàn gǎnrén-zhìshēn de xiàodào jiāhuà, gèng shēnkè jùxiànghuà le Zhōngguó chuántǒng shìrén "xiān tiānxià zhī yōu ér yōu" de dāndāng jīngshén. Nà yí dài chéndiāndiān de báimǐ, bēi zài shēnqū shàng shì jiātíng wéixì de shēngjì zhòngtuō, tóushè yú jīngshén shìjiè zé shì wúyuàn-wúhuǐ de dàodé shǐmìng.
extended_reading_passages.en: "Zilu carrying rice" is not only a moving tale of filial piety, but embodies traditional scholars' spirit of shouldering duty before seeking personal ease. Borne on his back, that heavy rice represented family survival and an unswerving moral calling.
extended_reading_passages.es: La historia de Zilu cargando arroz no solo conmueve por su piedad filial, sino que encarna el temple del sabio que antepone el deber al bienestar. Aquel pesado saco sobre sus espaldas era el sustento familiar y una noble misión moral asumida sin quejas.

meanings_summary.en: the back (of the human body); dorsal surface
meanings_summary.es: la espalda (del cuerpo humano); parte posterior

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: The posterior region (后) of human flesh and vertebrae (背) constitutes the anatomical back (后背).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: La región posterior (后) formada por la musculatura y vértebras (背) es la espalda humana (后背).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In somatic Chinese metaphors, 后背 is associated with unshielded vulnerability and steadfast uprightness of character.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two consecutive falling 4th tones: hòu bèi (51-51). 'bèi' is strictly 4th tone as a noun.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 后背 specifically designates the anatomical back of a human body, contrasting with general positional or abstract spatial terms.

contrasts.analysis: 后背 is standard conversational and colloquial vocabulary, whereas 背部 is medical, anatomical, and formal.
后背 refers to the physical anatomical surface of the body, whereas 背后 is a spatial and metaphorical preposition meaning behind someone's back.
后背 refers to the exterior surface of the back, whereas 脊梁 specifically denotes the spinal column or metaphorical moral backbone.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Left hook has open top right, whereas 后 has upper slash 𠂉
Has upper dot over 斤
Has 止 at top over 月 instead of 北
Has top spine strokes over 人 and 月

senses.definition_es: la espalda del cuerpo humano; región dorsal
senses.example_phrase: 后背湿透 (back drenched in sweat/rain)

example_sentences.hanzi: 沉重粗糙的米袋在风雪中剧烈晃动，将年轻子路的后背磨得鲜血淋漓、生疼难忍。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chénzhòng cūcāo de mǐdài zài fēngxuě zhōng jùliè huàngdòng, jiāng niánqīng Zǐlù de hòubèi mó de xiānxuè-línlí, shēngténg-nánrěn.
example_sentences.en: The heavy rough sack of rice rocked violently in the blizzard, scraping young Zilu's back until it bled and ached agonizingly.
example_sentences.es: El pesado y áspero saco de arroz se bamboleaba con la ventisca, raspando la espalda del joven Zilu hasta dejarla en carne viva con un dolor insoportable.

example_sentences.hanzi: 长期保持伏案低头的不良坐姿，极易引起颈椎疲劳以及后背肌肉的慢性劳损与酸痛。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chángqī bǎochí fú'àn dītóu de bùliáng zuòzī, jíyì yǐnqǐ jǐngzhuī píláo yǐjí hòubèi jīròu de mànxìng láosǔn yǔ suāntòng.
example_sentences.en: Maintaining a poor posture hunched over a desk for long periods easily leads to cervical fatigue and chronic strain in back muscles.
example_sentences.es: Mantener una mala postura encorvada sobre el escritorio causa fácilmente fatiga cervical y contracturas musculares crónicas en la espalda.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic compound: an ancient sovereign issuing orders from behind court screens, extending to rear, behind, and after.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Standing behind screen curtains (厂) quietly observing before speaking (口).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Situarse detrás de las cortinas protectoras (厂) observando la retaguardia (口).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic and phono-semantic: 北 (two people back-to-back) + 肉/月 (flesh), the anatomical back of the human body.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Flesh and vertebrae (月) situated behind you in reverse direction (北).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Carne y vértebras (月) dispuestas en sentido inverso al pecho (北).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 虽然风雪如刀削般撕扯着他的后背，米袋的棱角更是勒得皮肤生疼，但子路挺直了脊梁，脚步没有丝毫停滞。只要想到能让父母吃饱穿暖，背上的剧痛便化作了前行的动力。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suīrán fēngxuě rú dāoxiāo bān sīchě zhe tā de hòubèi, mǐdài de léngjiǎo gèng shì lēi de pífū shēngténg, dàn Zǐlù tǐngzhí le jǐliáng, jiǎobù méiyǒu sīháo tíngzhì. Zhǐyào xiǎngdào néng ràng fùmǔ chībǎo chuānnuǎn, bèishàng de jùtòng biàn huàzuò le qiánxíng de dònglì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Though blizzard winds tore at his back and the angular sack bruised his skin, Zilu straightened his spine and marched on without delay. Knowing his parents would be fed and warmed turned the pain into strength.
extended_reading_passages.es: Aunque el temporal azotaba su espalda y las aristas del saco magullaban su piel, Zilu enderezó la columna y no aminoró el paso. Pensar en sus padres abrigados convirtió el dolor en aliento para avanzar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在人体解剖学与生物力学中，后背的肌群与脊椎共同构成了维持直立行走的核心动力链。现代人因长期久坐缺乏运动，后背肌群易发生劳损，因而在日常工作中定期进行伸展运动与端正坐姿显得尤为重要。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài réntǐ jiěpōuxué yǔ shēngwù-lìxué zhōng, hòubèi de jīqún yǔ jǐzhuī gòngtóng gòuchéng le wéichí zhílì xíngzǒu de héxīn dònglìliàn. Xiàndàirén yīn chángqī jiǔzuò quēfá yùndòng, hòubèi jīqún yì fāshēng láosǔn, yīn'ér zài rìcháng gōngzuò zhōng dìngqī jìnxíng shēnzhǎn yùndòng yǔ duānzhèng zuòzī xiǎnde yóuwéi zhòngyào.
extended_reading_passages.en: In human anatomy and biomechanics, the musculature of the back and spinal column form the core kinetic chain for upright locomotion. Prolonged sedentary habits cause strain, making stretching and posture vital.
extended_reading_passages.es: En anatomía humana, los músculos de la espalda y la columna vertebral forman la cadena cinética de la marcha bípeda. El sedentarismo actual desgasta la zona dorsal, por lo que estirar y cuidar la postura resulta prioritario.

meanings_summary.en: very cold; frigid; chilly; freezing
meanings_summary.es: muy frío; gélido; frígido; glacial

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Shivering with ice crystals forming on the floor (寒) beneath the freezing command of winter (冷) immerses you in frigid cold (寒冷).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Tiritar con escarcha bajo el techo (寒) ante el gélido mandato del invierno (冷) sumerge en un frío glacial (寒冷).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese poetry, 寒冷 is not merely sensory meteorology, but evokes moral fortitude and filial hardship under freezing trials.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by dipping 3rd tone: hán lěng (35-214). 'hán' rises smoothly from mid-pitch before diving into deep dip on 'lěng'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 寒冷 specifically describes extremely low ambient temperature or harsh weather conditions.

contrasts.analysis: 冷 is the everyday monosyllabic word for any cold sensation, whereas 寒冷 is a formal disyllabic adjective specifically denoting severe, climate-scale freezing conditions.
寒冷 is bitterly cold and uncomfortable, whereas 凉快 is delightfully cool and pleasant, offering relief from heat.
寒冷 describes generic freezing coldness, while 严寒 is a noun/adjective describing the extreme zenith of bitter winter.

senses.definition_en: possessing or characterized by very low ambient temperature
senses.definition_es: gélido; muy frío; frígido
senses.example_phrase: 寒冷的严冬 (frigid harsh winter)

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对滴水成冰的寒冷天气，子路身着单衣跋涉在深雪之中，呼出的热气瞬间凝结成了白霜。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì dīshuǐ-chéngbīng de hánlěng tiānqì, Zǐlù shēnzhuó dānyī báshè zài shēnxuě zhīzhōng, hūchū de rèqì shùnjiān níngjié chéng le báishuāng.
example_sentences.en: Facing frigid weather where dripping water froze to ice, Zilu trudged through deep snow in thin clothing, his breath instantly condensing into white frost.
example_sentences.es: Frente a un frío glacial donde las gotas de agua se congelaban al caer, Zilu caminaba entre la nieve con ropas finas, condensándose su aliento en escarcha.

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了应对极端寒冷天气对城市基础设施的冲击，市政供暖部门提前启动了全天候应急保障预案。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile yìngduì jíduān hánlěng tiānqì duì chéngshì jīchǔ shèshī de chōngjī, shìzhèng gōngnuǎn bùmén tíqián qǐdòng le quántiānhòu yìngjí bǎozhàng yù'àn.
example_sentences.en: To cope with the impact of extreme frigid weather on municipal infrastructure, the heating authority preemptively activated a round-the-clock emergency plan.
example_sentences.es: Para contrarrestar el impacto del frío extremo en las infraestructuras urbanas, la dirección municipal de calefacción activó un plan de contingencia continuo.
