character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic compound: a person (人) inside a shelter (宀) buried under straw (艹) with ice crystals (冫) freezing beneath, depicting bitter cold.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A person shivering under straw inside a leaky roof (宀) standing on sheets of ice (冫).

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two droplets of freezing ice (冫) commanding temperatures to plunge.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos gotas de hielo congelado (冫) imponiendo un descenso helador de la temperatura.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 天地之间一片苍茫，刺骨的寒冷几乎冻僵了子路的双手与面颊。但他心中跳动着一团滚烫的孝心之火，即便面对千里冰雪，也丝毫无法阻挡他归家的如箭归心。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Tiāndì zhījiān yí piàn cāngmáng, cìgǔ de hánlěng jīhū dòngjiāng le Zǐlù de shuāngshǒu yǔ miànjiá. Dàn tā xīnzhōng tiàodòng zhe yì tuán gǔntàng de xiàoxīn zhī huǒ, jíbiàn miànduì qiānlǐ bīngxuě, yě sīháo wúfǎ zǔdǎng tā guījiā de rújiàn-guīxīn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the vast grey expanse between sky and earth, biting cold froze Zilu's hands and cheeks. But inside his chest burned the fire of filial love; even leagues of ice could not check his eager strides toward home.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la inmensidad desolada, un frío lacerante congelaba las manos y mejillas de Zilu. Mas en su pecho ardía el fuego del amor filial; ni mil leguas de hielo pudieron frenar su impaciente regreso al hogar.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 气候学研究表明，高纬度与高海拔地区的极端寒冷气候对人类聚落形态与能源消耗构成了严峻考验。通过研发新型建筑保温材料与清洁供暖技术，现代社会正有效降低极寒天气带来的负面影响。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Qìhòuxué yánjiū biǎomíng, gāowěidù yǔ gāohǎibá dìqū de jíduān hánlěng qìhòu duì rénlèi jùluò xíngtài yǔ néngyuán xiāohào gòuchéng le yánjùn kǎoyàn. Tōngguò yánfā xīnxíng jiànzhù bǎowēn cáiliào yǔ qīngjié gōngnuǎn jìshù, xiàndài shèhuì zhèng yǒuxiào jiàngdī jíhán tiānqì dàilái de fùmiàn yǐngxiǎng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Climatological studies indicate that extreme cold in high-latitude regions severely tests human settlements and energy consumption. Developing insulation materials and clean heating reduces frigid impacts.
extended_reading_passages.es: La climatología demuestra que el frío extremo en altas latitudes desafía los asentamientos humanos. El desarrollo de aislantes avanzados y calefacción limpia mitiga con éxito el rigor invernal.

meanings_summary.en: slippery; smooth; to slip; to slide; cunning; crafty

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Water (氵) flowing over polished bone (骨) creates a slippery surface where feet slide and slip (滑).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: El agua (氵) corriendo sobre hueso liso (骨) genera una superficie resbalosa donde uno puede patinar (滑).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In cognitive metaphors, physical slipperiness transfers into descriptions of cunning deceit and glib worldly speech.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone: huá (35). The pitch climbs smoothly and cleanly from mid to high plateau.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 滑 describes friction-reduced surfaces causing slipping, or the motion of sliding smoothly across planes.

contrasts.analysis: 滑 emphasizes slipperiness and lack of grip, whereas 光滑 describes smooth, polished, unblemished tactile texture.
滑 is the general verb for sliding or slipping across ice, while 溜 carries connotations of stealthily sneaking away.
滑 denotes the loss of traction or sliding motion, whereas 跌 denotes the resulting downward collapse or fall.

example_sentences.hanzi: 山间积雪融化后再次结冻成冰，陡峭的盘山石阶变得异常湿滑难行，子路差点儿滑倒。
example_sentences.pinyin: Shānjiān jīxuě rónghuà hòu zàicì jiédòng chéng bīng, dǒuqiào de pánshān shíjiē biànde yìcháng shīhuá nánxíng, Zǐlù chàdiǎnr huádǎo.
example_sentences.en: Snow on the mountain melted then froze into ice again; the steep winding stone stairs turned treacherous and slippery, and Zilu almost slipped and fell.
example_sentences.es: La nieve derretida en la montaña volvió a congelarse; los escarpados peldaños de piedra se volvieron traicioneramente resbaladizos y Zilu estuvo a punto de resbalar.

example_sentences.hanzi: 冬季滑雪运动不仅考验运动员的平衡技巧与身体敏捷度，更是一项极具挑战性的极限户外运动。
example_sentences.pinyin: Dōngjì huáxuě yùndòng bùjǐn kǎoyàn yùndòngyuán de pínghéng jìqiǎo yǔ shēntǐ mǐnjiédù, gèng shì yí xiàng jí jù tiǎozhànxìng de jíxiàn hùwài yùndòng.
example_sentences.en: Winter skiing tests not only an athlete's balance and agility, but represents a highly challenging outdoor extreme sport.
example_sentences.es: El esquí invernal no solo pone a prueba el equilibrio y la agilidad corporal, sino que constituye un deporte extremo colmado de adrenalina y desafío.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 氵 (water) + 骨 (bone/polished clean ivory), indicating the slick, friction-free surface of polished wet bone.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Water (氵) pouring over a smooth, polished bone (骨), making it slick and slippery.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Agua (氵) deslizándose sobre un hueso pulido (骨), volviendo la superficie resbaladiza al tacto.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 山崖边的冰雪路面极滑，子路脚底一滑，身子猛地向前倾斜。千钧一发之际，他死死扣住身旁突出的岩石，拼命稳住重心，才没让背后的米袋滚落万丈深渊。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shānyá biān de bīngxuě lùmiàn jí huá, Zǐlù jiǎodǐ yì huá, shēnzi měngde xiàngqián qīngxié. Qiānjūn-yìfà zhī jì, tā sǐsǐ kòuzhù shēnpáng tūchū de yánshí, pīnmìng wěnzhù zhòngxīn, cái méi ràng bèihòu de mǐdài gǔnluò wànzhàng shēnyuān.
extended_reading_passages.en: The icy trail on the cliff edge was treacherous; Zilu slipped, his body pitching forward violently. In the nick of time, he gripped a jutting rock, desperately steadying himself to prevent the rice from plummeting.
extended_reading_passages.es: El sendero helado al borde del abismo era sumamente resbaladizo; Zilu resbaló, tambaleándose hacia adelante. En un instante crítico, se aferró a una roca saliente y equilibró su peso para no perder el saco.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 材料科学在现代防滑技术的应用上取得了重大突破。通过仿生学研究荷叶表面纳米结构以及壁虎足部微观吸盘，工程师研发出新型高摩擦耐磨防滑涂层，显著降低了雨雪天气中路面打滑引发的交通事故发生率。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Cáiliào kēxué zài xiàndài fánghuá jìshù de yìngyòng shàng qǔdé le zhòngdà tūpò. Tōngguò fǎngshēngxué yánjiū héyè biǎomiàn nàmǐ jiégòu yǐjí bìhǔ zúbù wēiguān xīpán, gōngchéngshī yánfā chū xīnxíng gāomócā nàimó fánghuá túcéng, xiǎnzhù jiàngdī le yǔxuě tiānqì zhōng lùmiàn dǎhuá yǐnfā de jiāotōng shìgù fāshēnglǜ.
extended_reading_passages.en: Materials science has achieved major breakthroughs in anti-slip technology. Biomimetic research on lotus leaf nanostructures and gecko footpads enabled engineers to develop high-friction anti-skid coatings, drastically cutting accidents on icy roads.
extended_reading_passages.es: La ciencia de materiales ha logrado avances notables en tecnologías antideslizantes. La biónica inspirada en hojas de loto y gecos permitió crear revestimientos de alta fricción que reducen drásticamente los accidentes en calzadas resbaladizas.

meanings_summary.en: almost; nearly; barely missed
meanings_summary.es: casi; por poco; a punto de

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Falling short (差) by just a tiny speck of a dot (点) in spoken colloquial flow (儿) means you almost or nearly (差点儿) had an accident.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Quedarse corto (差) por apenas una diminuta mota o punto (点) con matiz oral (儿) significa casi o por poco (差点儿).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese pragmatics, 差点儿 expresses relief when a negative catastrophe was barely avoided, but regret when an auspicious outcome was narrowly missed.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Falling-dipping-erhua: chà diǎnr (51-214r). 'diǎn' dips deeply before curling smoothly into retroflex 'r'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 差点儿 is a spoken adverb indicating that an event was within a hair's breadth of happening.

contrasts.analysis: 差点儿 is colloquial and conversational, whereas 几乎 is formal and written, functioning across both quantitative approximations and near-event contexts.
差点儿 is versatile across both fortunate and unfortunate outcomes, whereas 险些 strictly describes narrowly escaping a dangerous accident.

contrasts.compared_word: 差点儿 vs. 差点儿没
contrasts.analysis: In colloquial Mandarin, for undesirable negative events, 差点儿摔倒 and 差点儿没摔倒 both mean almost fell down (but thankfully did not).

example_sentences.hanzi: 山路陡峭湿滑且狂风大作，子路背着百斤米袋身子剧烈一晃，差点儿跌入路旁的悬崖山谷。
example_sentences.pinyin: Shānlù dǒuqiào shīhuá qiě kuángfēng dàzuò, Zǐlù bēizhe bǎi jīn mǐdài shēnzi jùliè yì huàng, chàdiǎnr diērù lùpáng de xuányá shāngǔ.
example_sentences.en: The mountain trail was steep and slippery with howling gales; carrying the hundred-catty rice sack, Zilu swayed violently and almost plunged into the roadside ravine.
example_sentences.es: El sendero de montaña era empinado y resbaloso con vientos huracanados; con el saco de cien libras a cuestas, Zilu se tambaleó con violencia y casi cae por el precipicio.

example_sentences.hanzi: 由于早高峰地铁线路临时发生信号故障，他差点儿错过了这场关乎公司未来融资的重要商业谈判。
example_sentences.pinyin: Yóuyú zǎogāofēng dìtiě xiànlù línshí fāshēng xìnhào gùzhàng, tā chàdiǎnr cuòguò le zhè chǎng guānhū gōngsī wèilái róngzī de zhòngyào shāngyè tánpàn.
example_sentences.en: Due to a signal glitch during the morning rush hour, he almost missed the crucial commercial negotiation regarding future company financing.
example_sentences.es: Por una avería de señal en el metro durante la hora punta matutina, estuvo a punto de perderse la negociación decisiva para la financiación de su empresa.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Contar ovejas (羊) y descubrir una ligera discrepancia que no llega a la cuenta plena.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una pequeña mota de tinta negra (灬) que señala una diferencia minúscula.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un niño que camina con ligereza, aportando fluidez oral al adverbio.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 突如其来的暴风雪刮得人睁不开眼，子路单薄的身躯在风雪中摇晃，脚下一滑差点儿跌落山涧。但他凭借顽强的毅力死死稳住身形，咬紧牙关继续在绝壁边缘向前跋涉。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Tūrúqílái de bàofēngxuě guā de rén zhèng bù kāi yǎn, Zǐlù dānbó de shēnqū zài fēngxuě zhōng yáohuàng, jiǎoxià yì huá chàdiǎnr diēluò shānjiàn. Dàn tā píngjiè wánqiáng de yìlì sǐsǐ wěnzhù shēnxíng, yǎojǐn yáguān jìxù zài juébì biānyuán xiàngqián báshè.
extended_reading_passages.en: A sudden blizzard blinded the way; Zilu's thin frame swayed in the gale, and he slipped and almost plunged into the ravine. Yet with iron will he steadied his body, gritted his teeth, and forged ahead along the cliff.
extended_reading_passages.es: La repentina ventisca cegaba la vista; el frágil cuerpo de Zilu se tambaleó con la tormenta y por poco cae al barranco. Mas con tenaz entereza recuperó el equilibrio y continuó su marcha al borde del abismo.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在汉语口语语法中，“差点儿”作为表示极限临界状态的副词，其语义指向深受说话人主观意愿与语境情感色彩的影响。这种独特的语言心理机制，不仅生动展现了汉民族趋吉避凶的文化心理，也是留学生掌握汉语情态副词的关键难点。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài Hànyǔ kǒuyǔ yǔfǎ zhōng, "chàdiǎnr" zuòwéi biǎoshì jíxiàn línjiè zhuàngtài de fùcí, qí yǔyì zhǐxiàng shēnshòu shuōhuàrén zhǔguān yìyuàn yǔ yǔjìng qínggǎn sècǎi de yǐngxiǎng. Zhè zhǒng dútè de yǔyán xīnlǐ jīzhì, bùjǐn shēngdòng zhǎnxiàn le Hàn mínzú qūjí-bìxiōng de wénhuà xīnlǐ, yě shì liúxuéshēng zhǎngwò Hànyǔ qíngtài fùcí de guānjiàn nándiǎn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In spoken Mandarin, 差点儿 marks threshold near-occurrences whose pragmatic meaning reflects speaker intent and emotive framing. This semantic nuance embodies cultural inclinations toward averting misfortune and is a key concept for learners.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la gramática oral china, "chadianr" denota un umbral crítico cuyo sentido depende del deseo del hablante ante el suceso. Este mecanismo lingüístico refleja la búsqueda psicológica de evitar desgracias y constituye un punto clave en el aprendizaje.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Whipping a tool (用) outward with a flicking tail stroke (乚) flings and casts off (甩) unwanted weight.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Manejar una herramienta (用) con un latigazo curvo (乚) lanza y sacude (甩) lo que estorba.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The character 甩 is an expressive iconic graph; its extended tail stroke visually mimics the sudden acceleration of flicking a whip or flinging off water droplets.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone: shuǎi (214). Dips low to pitch 21 before sweeping upward decisively.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 甩 emphasizes a vigorous swinging, flicking, or whipping motion of limbs, or resolutely discarding/leaving behind burdens.

contrasts.analysis: 扔 is the standard verb for tossing an object into a bin or distance, whereas 甩 involves a whipping, centrifugal motion of the arm or casting off something clinging.
抛 is formal and parabolic, whereas 甩 is vivid, physical, and forceful in vernacular description.
摆 denotes gentle, rhythmic swaying or placing, while 甩 denotes sudden, aggressive flicking.

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对山路上狂暴肆虐的暴风雪，子路用力甩了甩冻僵麻木的双手，哈了一口热气继续迈步前行。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì shānlù shàng kuángbào sìnüè de bàofēngxuě, Zǐlù yònglì shuǎi le shuǎi dòngjiāng mámù de shuāngshǒu, hā le yì kǒu rèqì jìxù màibù qiánxíng.
example_sentences.en: Facing the raging blizzard on the mountain path, Zilu vigorously shook his numb, frozen hands, breathed warmth into his palms, and pressed on.
example_sentences.es: Frente a la tormenta que arreciaba en el sendero, Zilu sacudió con fuerza sus manos entumecidas por el hielo, sopló vaho caliente y prosiguió la marcha.

example_sentences.hanzi: 该领军科技企业依靠核心自主知识产权打破了技术垄断，在关键性能指标上将主要竞争对手远远甩在身后。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gāi lǐngjūn kējì qǐyè yīkào héxīn zìzhǔ zhīshi chǎnquán dǎpò le jìshù lǒngduàn, zài guānjiàn xìngnéng zhǐbiāo shàng jiāng zhǔyào jìngzhēng duìshǒu yuǎnyuǎn shuǎi zài shēnhòu.
example_sentences.en: Relying on proprietary intellectual property, this tech enterprise broke monopolies, leaving major competitors far behind in key metrics.
example_sentences.es: Basándose en patentes propias, la tecnológica puntera quebró el monopolio técnico, dejando muy atrás a sus competidores en rendimiento clave.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un brazo que se proyecta con un gancho flexible (乚) para sacudir o lanzar una carga pesada.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 严寒中，子路的睫毛上结满了厚厚的冰霜，冻得麻木的手指几乎无法握拢。他停下脚步用力甩了甩双手以加速血液循环，随后咬牙重新背紧米袋，大步流星向前奔去。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Yánhán zhōng, Zǐlù de jiémáo shàng jiémǎn le hòuhòu de bīngshuāng, dòng de mámù de shǒuzhǐ jīhū wúfǎ wòlǒng. Tā tíngxià jiǎobù yònglì shuǎi le shuǎi shuāngshǒu yǐ jiāsù xuèyè xúnhuán, suíhòu yǎoyá chóngxīn bēijǐn mǐdài, dàbù-liúxīng xiàngqián bēn qù.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the bitter cold, Zilu's eyelashes were coated in frost and his numb fingers could barely form a fist. He paused and shook his hands to spur circulation, then shouldered the sack tight and hurried onward.
extended_reading_passages.es: En medio del frío glacial, la escarcha cubría las pestañas de Zilu y sus dedos entumecidos apenas podían cerrarse. Se detuvo a sacudir las manos para activar la sangre, aseguró el saco y reanudó la marcha a grandes zancadas.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在全球产业变革的激烈角逐中，任何缺乏危机感的企业都极易被时代浪潮所淘汰。唯有彻底甩掉历史包袱、勇于进行前沿核心技术研发的企业，才能在白热化的市场竞争中将对手远远甩开，牢牢占据产业链高端。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài quánqiú chǎnyè biàngé de jīliè juézhú zhōng, rènhé quēfá wēijīgǎn de qǐyè dōu jíyì bèi shídài làngcháo suǒ táotài. Wéiyǒu chèdǐ shuǎidiào lìshǐ bāofu, yǒngyú jìnxíng qiányán héxīn jìshù yánfā de qǐyè, cáinéng zài báirèhuà de shìchǎng jìngzhēng zhōng jiāng duìshǒu yuǎnyuǎn shuǎikāi, láoláo zhànjù chǎnyèliàn gāoduān.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the intense race of global industrial shifts, complacent firms risk obsolescence. Only enterprises that shake off historical baggage and pursue cutting-edge research can outpace rivals and dominate the value chain.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la reñida competencia industrial global, las empresas complacientes quedan obsoletas con rapidez. Solo aquellas que se desprenden de cargas del pasado e innovan en tecnologías de vanguardia logran aventajar a sus rivales y liderar el mercado.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Holding the crown of your head (页) firm like an upright iron spike (丁) allows you to push against and withstand (顶) all blizzards.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Mantener la coronilla (页) firme como un clavo de hierro (丁) permite resistir y empujar contra (顶) cualquier tempestad.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In classical ethics, 顶天立地 embodies the Confucian ideal of human dignity, propping up heaven above and rooted on earth below, unyielding against storm.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone: dǐng (214). Dips firmly before rising with resonance.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 顶 emphasizes active, frontal resistance opposing oncoming force, physical apex, or supporting weights atop the head.

contrasts.analysis: 顶 emphasizes pushing directly forward against oncoming opposing forces, whereas 扛 emphasizes carrying a heavy physical object rested across the shoulders.
顶 proactively pushes forward into resistance, whereas 挡 creates a defensive shield or barrier to ward off attacks.
顶 applies force upwards or forwards against resistance, whereas 托 gently supports an object from underneath with open palms.

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对呼啸肆虐的刺骨寒风与漫天冰雪，子路咬紧牙关顶风冒雪，在崇山峻岭间步步前行。
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì hūxiào-sìnüè de cìgǔ hánfēng yǔ màntiān bīngxuě, Zǐlù yǎojǐn yáguān dǐngfēng-màoxuě, zài chóngshān-jùnlǐng jiān bùbù qiánxíng.
example_sentences.en: Facing howling, bone-chilling gales and whirling ice and snow, Zilu gritted his teeth and braved the headwinds, advancing step by step across lofty mountain ranges.
example_sentences.es: Frente a vendavales helados y ventiscas que aullaban con furia, Zilu apretó los dientes para desafiar el viento y la nieve, avanzando paso a paso por las cumbres escarpadas.

example_sentences.hanzi: 经过全体抢险队员通宵达旦的顽强拼搏，救援团队终于顶住了百年一遇特大洪峰的猛烈冲击。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò quántǐ qiǎngxiǎn duìyuán tōngxiāo-dádàn de wánqiáng pīnbó, jiùyuán tuánduì zhōngyú dǐngzhù le bǎinián-yíyù tēdà hóngfēng de měngliè chōngjī.
example_sentences.en: After fighting through the night with tenacious struggle, the emergency rescue team finally withstood the fierce onslaught of the century-class flood crest.
example_sentences.es: Tras una noche entera de combate heroico, el equipo de rescate logró por fin resistir la embestida implacable de la mayor crecida en un siglo.

kneel and worship with forehead touching ground; venerate

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 丁 (firm pillar/nail) + 页 (head), originally the crown or apex of the human head, extending to propping up, pushing against, or withstanding pressure.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A firm nail or pillar (丁) supporting the crown of the head (页) to push against heavy weights.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un clavo o pilar firme (丁) que sostiene la coronilla de la cabeza (页) para soportar grandes presiones.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 呼啸的暴风雪像刀子一般刮在脸上，子路深一脚浅一脚地顶着狂风往前挪动。背上的米袋重逾百斤，但他硬是用血肉之躯顶住了严寒的压迫，没有后退半步。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Hūxiào de bàofēngxuě xiàng dāozi yībān guā zài liǎn shàng, Zǐlù shēn yì jiǎo qiǎn yì jiǎo de dǐngzhe kuángfēng wǎng qián nuódòng. Bèishàng de mǐdài zhòng yú bǎi jīn, dàn tā yìng shì yòng xuèròu zhī qū dǐngzhù le yánhán de yāpò, méiyǒu hòutuì bàn bù.
extended_reading_passages.en: The howling blizzard sliced his face like knives as Zilu trudged forward unevenly through the gale. His sack weighed over a hundred catties, but with flesh and blood he withstood the frigid trial without yielding a single step.
extended_reading_passages.es: La ventisca aullante cortaba su rostro como cuchillos mientras Zilu avanzaba a trancas y barrancas contra el vendaval. Aunque cargaba cien libras, su voluntad de hierro resistió el rigor sin retroceder un paso.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 无论是自然灾害的无情考验，还是科技攻坚中的重重险阻，人类文明的发展史就是一部不断顶住压力、向未知领域拓荒的壮丽史诗。唯有具备顶风破浪的非凡气魄，民族与国家才能在风云激荡的世界舞台上立于不败之地。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Wúlùn shì zìrán zāihài de wúqíng kǎoyàn, háishì kējì gōngjiān zhōng de zhòngzhòng xiǎnzǔ, rénlèi wénmíng de fāzhǎnshǐ jiù shì yí bù búduàn dǐngzhù yālì, xiàng wèizhī lǐngyù tuòhuāng de zhuànglì shǐshī. Wéiyǒu jùbèi dǐngfēng-pòlàng de fēifán qìpò, mínzú yǔ guójiā cáinéng zài fēngyún-jīdàng de shìjiè wǔtái shàng lìyú búbàizhīdì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Whether facing ruthless natural disasters or scientific frontiers, human history is an epic of withstanding immense pressure to pioneer the unknown. Only with the courage to brave storms can nations stand invincible on the world stage.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ya frente a catástrofes naturales o retos científicos, la historia humana es una epopeya de resistencia y conquista de lo desconocido. Solo con el coraje de desafiar tempestades pueden las naciones mantenerse invictas en el escenario global.

meanings_summary.en: forward; ahead; onward; toward the front
meanings_summary.es: hacia adelante; adelante; al frente; en adelante

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Stepping toward the beacon (往) and cutting across the path ahead (前) propels you resolutely forward (往前).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Dirigir el paso hacia la meta (往) cortando camino por delante (前) impulsa resueltamente hacia adelante (往前).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese spatial orientation, moving forward (往前走) metaphorically maps onto temporal progress and moral resolve, enduring immediate pain for a greater dawn.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by rising 2nd tone: wǎng qián (214-35). 'wǎng' dips softly before gliding smoothly into high-rising 'qián'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 往前 specifically indicates directional progression forward along a physical track or chronological trajectory.

contrasts.analysis: 往前 and 向前 are largely interchangeable in directional motion; however, 向前 is slightly more formal and frequently appears in slogans, whereas 往前 is natural in colloquial speech.
往前 can dialectally refer to past times, whereas 以后 strictly refers to future chronological time from a reference point.
往前 is an adverbial direction meaning toward the front, whereas 前方 is a spatial noun denoting the physical front area or military front line.

Has 氵 (water) on the left of 主 instead of 彳

Has 灬 (fire) below 前

senses.definition_en: moving or directing attention toward the front or future
senses.definition_es: hacia adelante; al frente; con dirección al porvenir
senses.example_phrase: 一直往前走 (keep walking straight ahead)

example_sentences.hanzi: 哪怕双腿酸痛如灌铅、漫天风雪扑面而来，子路依然咬紧牙关，一步一个脚印坚定地往前走。
example_sentences.pinyin: Nǎpà shuāngtuǐ suāntòng rú guànqiān, màntiān fēngxuě pūmiàn ér lái, Zǐlù yīrán yǎojǐn yáguān, yíbù yí gè jiǎoyìn jiāndìng de wǎng qián zǒu.
example_sentences.en: Even though his legs ached like heavy lead and snow lashed his face, Zilu gritted his teeth, firmly marching forward one step at a time.
example_sentences.es: Aunque las piernas le dolían como plomo y la nieve azotaba su rostro, Zilu apretó los dientes y avanzó hacia adelante con pisadas firmes.

example_sentences.hanzi: 历史车轮滚滚向前不可阻挡，唯有顺应时代潮流、勇毅往前开拓，才能赢得未来的战略主动权。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lìshǐ chēlún gǔngǔn xiàngqián bùkě zǔdǎng, wéiyǒu shùnyìng shídài cháoliú, yǒngyì wǎng qián kāituò, cáinéng yíngdé wèilái de zhànlüè zhǔdòngquán.
example_sentences.en: The wheels of history roll forward irresistibly; only by aligning with the trends and boldly pioneering ahead can we secure strategic initiative.
example_sentences.es: La rueda de la historia avanza incontenible; solo adaptándose a los tiempos y avanzando hacia adelante con valentía se conquista la iniciativa del futuro.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 彳 (stepping along a road) + 主 (lamp light/destination beacon), originally setting out toward a goal.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Stepping along a trail (彳) keeping eyes fixed on a guiding flame (主).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Caminar por un sendero (彳) guiando los pasos hacia una llama orientadora (主).

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Stepping into a boat to cross water, cutting forward through waves.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Embarcar en una barca para cruzar el cauce cortando las olas hacia adelante.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 漫天飞雪中，早已辨不清道路的痕迹。子路凭借着对家乡方向的记忆，迎着呼啸的北风一步步往前挪动。只要每往前走一步，就离温暖的家更近了一分。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Màntiān fēixuě zhōng, zǎoyǐ biàn bù qīng dàolù de hénjì. Zǐlù píngjiè zhe duì jiāxiāng fāngxiàng de jìyì, yíngzhe hūxiào de běifēng yíbùbù wǎng qián nuódòng. Zhǐyào měi wǎng qián zǒu yí bù, jiù lí wēnnuǎn de jiā gèng jìn le yì fēn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In swirling snow, all traces of the path were lost. Guided only by memories of home, Zilu inched forward step by step against the biting north wind. Each step brought him a fraction closer to his warm hearth.
extended_reading_passages.es: Bajo la ventisca que borraba los senderos, Zilu avanzaba paso a paso guiado por el recuerdo del hogar contra el viento del norte. Con cada paso que daba hacia adelante, se hallaba un poco más cerca de su familia.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在充满不确定性的时代洪流中，畏缩不前只会加剧焦虑与被动。人类历史上所有的文明跨越与科学飞跃，无不是在迷雾重重的未知困境中，依靠坚韧不拔的意志坚定地往前探索，在绝境中开辟出崭新的发展坦途。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài chōngmǎn bùquèdìngxìng de shídài hóngliú zhōng, wèisuō-bùqián zhǐ huì jiājù jiāolǜ yǔ bèidòng. Rénlèi lìshǐ shàng suǒyǒu de wénmíng kuàyuè yǔ kēxué fēiyuè, wúbúshì zài míwù-chóngchóng de wèizhī kùnjìng zhōng, yīkào jiānrèn-bùbá de yìzhì jiāndìng de wǎng qián tànsuǒ, zài juéjìng zhōng kāipì chū zhǎnxīn de fāzhǎn tǎntú.
extended_reading_passages.en: Amid currents of uncertainty, shrinking back only compounds anxiety and passivity. All leaps of human civilization were forged in dense mists of the unknown by resolutely exploring forward with indomitable will, clearing fresh paths toward progress.
extended_reading_passages.es: Ante la incertidumbre de los tiempos, vacilar solo alimenta la ansiedad. Los grandes hitos de la civilización y la ciencia se lograron avanzando con determinación en la penumbra de lo desconocido, abriendo nuevos horizontes de progreso en medio de la adversidad.

meanings_summary.en: to support with the hand; to help someone up; to steady; to assist
meanings_summary.es: sostener con la mano; apoyar; ayudar a levantarse; sujetar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Extending a caring hand (扌) to support a walking person (夫) enables them to steady themselves and stand firm (扶).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Extender una mano protectora (扌) para apoyar a una persona (夫) le ayuda a sostenerse y no tropezar (扶).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Confucian morality, 扶老携幼 and 救死扶伤 represent quintessential ethical duties of filial devotion and universal benevolence.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone: fú (35). Glides smoothly upward from mid to high pitch.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 扶 denotes using hands to support, steady, or prevent a person or heavy object from tumbling down.

contrasts.analysis: 扶 is standard for holding an object, railing, or supporting a person's body, whereas 搀 specifically denotes supporting someone gently by grasping their arm.
扶 provides external balance or steadying support from beside or underneath, while 握 denotes enclosing fingers firmly around a tool or hand.
扶 is gentle, steadying, and supportive, whereas 抓 is abrupt, grabbing, or grasping with clawing fingers.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 无 on the right of 扌 instead of 夫
Has 丁 on the right of 扌
Phonetic base without the hand radical 扌
Has longer top line than lower line, unlike 夫

senses.definition_en: to support or steady with hand(s); to help someone up or assist someone walking
senses.definition_es: sostener o apoyar con la mano; ayudar a levantarse a alguien
senses.example_phrase: 扶着栏杆 (holding the railing)

example_sentences.hanzi: 在陡峭结冰的山道上，子路一手死死护住背后的米袋，一手紧紧扶着冰冷的岩壁艰难攀登。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài dǒuqiào jiébīng de shāndào shàng, Zǐlù yìshǒu sǐsǐ hùzhù bèihòu de mǐdài, yìshǒu jǐnjǐn fúzhe bīnglěng de yánbì jiānnán pāndēng.
example_sentences.en: On the steep icy mountain path, Zilu shielded the rice sack on his back with one hand while clutching the freezing rock wall with the other to climb.
example_sentences.es: En el empinado sendero helado, Zilu protegía el saco a su espalda con una mano mientras con la otra se agarraba con fuerza a la fría pared de roca para ascender.

example_sentences.hanzi: 看见一位腿脚不便的老奶奶颤巍巍地过马路，热心的小学生连忙主动跑上前去轻轻搀扶。
example_sentences.pinyin: Kànjiàn yí wèi tuǐjiǎo búbiàn de lǎonǎinai chànwēiwēi de guò mǎlù, rèxīn de xiǎoxuéshēng liánmáng zhǔdòng pǎo shàngqián qù qīngqīng chānfú.
example_sentences.en: Seeing an elderly grandmother with mobility difficulties tremulously crossing the street, the kind-hearted pupil ran forward to gently support her.
example_sentences.es: Al ver a una anciana con dificultades para caminar cruzando la calle con pasos vacilantes, un atento escolar corrió presuroso a sostenerla del brazo.

character_decomposition.sound_component: 夫 (fū / adult man phonetic/steady upright figure)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 扌 (hand) + 夫 (mature man/strength), originally using hands to help an adult or infirm person stand upright and steady.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An outstretched hand (扌) lending strength to an upright man (夫) walking through difficulties.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mano extendida (扌) que brinda sostén a una persona recta (夫) para no caer en el camino.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 山路冻成了坚硬的冰道，子路背上的米袋重重下坠。他不得不弓着身躯，冻得红肿的手指紧紧抠扶着冰凉的石缝，一步一步顽强地向山巅挪动。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shānlù dòng chéng le jiānyìng de bīngdào, Zǐlù bèishàng de mǐdài zhòngzhòng xiàzhuì. Tā bùdébù gōng zhe shēnqū, dòng de hóngzhǒng de shǒuzhǐ jǐnjǐn kōu fúzhe bīngliáng de shífèng, yíbù yíbù wánqiáng de xiàng shāndiān nuódòng.
extended_reading_passages.en: The mountain path froze into solid ice as the rice sack sagged heavily on his back. Stooping low, Zilu gripped icy crevices with red, swollen fingers, clawing his way upward step by step toward the summit.
extended_reading_passages.es: El sendero se congeló en puro hielo y el saco tiraba hacia abajo con fuerza. Encorvado, Zilu aferró sus dedos enrojecidos a las grietas de la roca, trepando paso a paso con tenacidad hacia la cumbre.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 尊老爱幼与扶危济困是中华文明延续数千年的核心道德基因。在现代社会保障体系建设中，“精准扶贫”与“老龄关怀”将传统的道德义理转化为具有法律效力的制度安排，让每一位处于困境中的社会成员都能得到社会的温暖扶助。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zūnlǎo-àiyòu yǔ fúwēi-jìkùn shì Zhōnghuá wénmíng yánxù shùqiānnián de héxīn dàodé jīyīn. Zài xiàndài shèhuì bǎozhàng tǐxì jiànshè zhōng, "jīngzhǔn fúpín" yǔ "lǎolíng guānhuái" jiāng chuántǒng de dàodé yìlǐ zhuǎnhuà wéi jùyǒu fǎlǜ xiàolì de zhìdù ānpái, ràng měi yí wèi chǔyú kùnjìng zhōng de shèhuì chéngyuán dōu néng dédào shèhuì de wēnnuǎn fúzhù.
extended_reading_passages.en: Reverence for elders and helping those in distress are core cultural genes of Chinese civilization. Modern social safety nets translate these virtues into institutional guarantees, ensuring every vulnerable citizen receives warm communal support.
extended_reading_passages.es: Respetar a los mayores y socorrer al desvalido son pilares milenarios de la civilización china. La seguridad social moderna transforma estos valores éticos en derechos institucionales, garantizando que todo ciudadano vulnerable reciba amparo y dignidad.

meanings_summary.en: both hands; two hands
meanings_summary.es: ambas manos; las dos manos

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A matched pair (双) of human hands (手) creates your two working hands (双手).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un par simétrico (双) de manos humanas (手) conforma ambas manos (双手).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Chinese civic ethos, relying on one's two hands is the supreme emblem of self-reliance, honest labor, and filial devotion, rejecting unearned privilege.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-level 1st tone followed by dipping 3rd tone: shuāng shǒu (55-214). 'shuāng' sustains clear high pitch before 'shǒu' dips deeply.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 双手 refers specifically to the matched pair of human hands as organs of touch, labor, holding, and care.

contrasts.analysis: 手 can be singular or generic, whereas 双手 specifically highlights the bilateral pair working in coordination.
双手 denotes anatomical hands, while 手足 literally means hands and feet and metaphorically denotes brothers or close kin.
双手 refers strictly to palms and fingers, whereas 臂膀 denotes arms and shoulders, symbolizing strong physical backing.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 隹 on the right of 又
Has 氵 (water) on the left of 又
Curve hooks to the right at bottom, whereas 手 hooks to the left
Lacks the upper curved slash 丿 of 手

senses.definition_en: the two hands of a human being
senses.definition_es: ambas manos; las dos manos del ser humano
senses.example_phrase: 用双手创造生活 (create a life with both hands)

example_sentences.hanzi: 历经数天冰雪中的徒步跋涉，年轻子路的双手早已被刺骨的严寒冻得红肿开裂、麻木无知。
example_sentences.pinyin: Lìjīng shù tiān bīngxuě zhōng de túbù báshè, niánqīng Zǐlù de shuāngshǒu zǎoyǐ bèi cìgǔ de yánhán dòng de hóngzhǒng kāiliè, mámù-wúzhī.
example_sentences.en: After days of trekking through ice and snow, young Zilu's hands were already red, chapped, and completely numbed by the bitter frost.
example_sentences.es: Tras días de marcha a pie bajo la nieve, las manos del joven Zilu estaban amoratadas, agrietadas y totalmente entumecidas por el frío glacial.

example_sentences.hanzi: 广大劳动者凭借勤劳朴实的双手，在平凡的岗位上默默耕耘，创造出了令世人瞩目的伟大辉煌。
example_sentences.pinyin: Guǎngdà láodòngzhě píngjiè qínláo pǔshí de shuāngshǒu, zài píngfán de gǎngwèi shàng mòmò gēngyún, chuàngzào chū le lìng shìrén zhǔmù de wěidà huīhuáng.
example_sentences.en: Relying on industrious, honest hands, laborers toiling silently in ordinary posts have created great glories admired across the world.
example_sentences.es: Con sus manos laboriosas y honestas, los trabajadores que labran en silencio puestos cotidianos han forjado admirables logros para el mundo.

idioms.meaning_en: build up from nothing with bare hands; self-made
deep brotherly affection like hands and feet
magical hands restore spring; heal patients miraculously
what the heart wishes the hand can do; highly skilled

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Ideogrammic compound: ancient oracle bone graph of two birds gripped in a hand (隹+又), simplified into two hands (又+又) held side by side, denoting a pair or two.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two hands (又+又) working harmoniously side by side as a perfect pair.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos manos (又+又) colocadas la una junto a la otra actuando en perfecta armonía.

character_decomposition.meaning_component: 手 (pictograph of human hand with palm and five fingers)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Pictographic depiction of a human hand showing wrist, palm, and extended fingers.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An open human hand with fingers capable of grasping, crafting, and creating.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una mano humana abierta con dedos ágiles listos para sostener, acariciar y construir.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 虽然风雪交加、滴水成冰，子路的一双手冻得通红麻木，但他依然用双手死死扣住背上的绳索，生怕米袋在剧烈颠簸中滑落，这份深情让天地亦为之动容。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suīrán fēngxuě-jiāojiā, dīshuǐ-chéngbīng, Zǐlù de yì shuāngshǒu dòng de tōnghóng mámù, dàn tā yīrán yòng shuāngshǒu sǐsǐ kòuzhù bèishàng de shéngsuǒ, shēngpà mǐdài zài jùliè diānbǒ zhōng huáluò, zhè fèn shēnqíng ràng tiāndì yì wéi zhī dòngróng.
extended_reading_passages.en: Though wind and snow froze all to ice, and both hands were crimson and numb, Zilu gripped the cords with both hands lest the sack slip on the rough trail, moving heaven and earth.
extended_reading_passages.es: Pese al temporal gélido y a tener las manos rojas e insensibles, Zilu aferró las cuerdas con ambas manos temiendo que el saco resbalara, conmoviendo al cielo con su lealtad filial.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 人类进化的重要里程碑在于直立行走解放了双手。从早期制造简陋的石器打猎割草，到现代操作精密仪器探索深空，人类正是依靠这一双灵巧勤劳的双手，将心中的构想化为现实，创造出灿烂辉煌的物质与精神文明。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Rénlèi jìnhuà de zhòngyào lǐchéngbēi zàiyú zhílì xíngzǒu jiěfàng le shuāngshǒu. Cóng zǎoqī zhìzào jiǎnlòu de shíqì dǎliè gēcǎo, dào xiàndài cāozuò jīngmì yíqì tànsuǒ shēnkōng, rénlèi zhèng shì yīkào zhè yì shuāng língqiǎo qínláo de shuāngshǒu, jiāng xīnzhōng de gòuxiǎng huàwéi xiànshí, chuàngzào chū cànlàn huīhuáng de wùzhì yǔ jīngshén wénmíng.
extended_reading_passages.en: A major milestone in human evolution was bipedalism liberating both hands. From crafting stone tools to operating delicate instruments in space, humanity has relied on industrious hands to turn ideals into reality, creating civilization.
extended_reading_passages.es: El gran hito evolutivo fue la marcha bípeda que liberó ambas manos. Desde las rudimentarias herramientas de piedra hasta los instrumentos espaciales, la humanidad ha transformado sus sueños en realidad gracias a sus manos laboriosas.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Ice droplets (冫) freezing liquids solid across the eastern lands (东) will freeze (冻) everything solid.
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Gotas de hielo (冫) helando el campo oriental (东) terminan por congelar (冻) la tierra entera.
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The ancient proverb 冰冻三尺，非一日之寒 uses the slow freezing of thick ice as an allegory for historical habit, deep conflicts, or steady moral cultivation.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High-falling 4th tone: dòng (51). Deliver with decisive, crisp downward drop.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 冻 specifically describes the physical phase change of freezing into ice or bodily numbness and pain from cold.

contrasts.analysis: 冷 is an adjective describing temperature sensation, whereas 冻 functions as a verb or resultative complement denoting solid freezing or physical distress.
冻 requires low temperature to solidify, whereas 凝 denotes general liquid congealing or condensing regardless of temperature.
冻 involves freezing sub-zero ice levels, while 凉 describes mildly cool or refreshing temperatures.

example_sentences.hanzi: 呼啸刺骨的北风刮了一整夜，子路的双耳与脚趾被严寒冻得失去了知觉，但他丝毫没有放慢脚步。
example_sentences.pinyin: Hūxiào cìgǔ de běifēng guā le yì zhěng yè, Zǐlù de shuāng'ěr yǔ jiǎozhǐ bèi yánhán dòng de shīqù le zhījué, dàn tā sīháo méiyǒu fàngmàn jiǎobù.
example_sentences.en: The bone-chilling north wind howled all night; Zilu's ears and toes were frozen numb from the cold, yet he did not slacken his pace at all.
example_sentences.es: El gélido viento del norte aulló durante toda la noche; las orejas y los dedos de los pies de Zilu perdieron la sensibilidad por el frío, pero no aminoró el paso.

example_sentences.hanzi: 冬季降温前必须对室外供水管网实施全面包裹保温，防止水管冻裂导致供水中断。
example_sentences.pinyin: Dōngjì jiàngwēn qián bìxū duì shìwài gōngshuǐ guǎnwǎng shíshī quánmiàn bāoguǒ bǎowēn, fángzhǐ shuǐguǎn dòngliè dǎozhì gōngshuǐ zhōngduàn.
example_sentences.en: Before winter temperatures drop, outdoor water supply pipes must be insulated to prevent pipes from freezing and bursting.
example_sentences.es: Antes de que bajen las temperaturas invernales, las tuberías exteriores deben aislarse para evitar que se revienten por congelación cortando el suministro.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 冫 (ice) + 东 (dōng phonetic / tied solid bundle), indicating liquids freezing into rigid solid blocks of ice.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Two drops of ice (冫) locking a bundled package (东) into solid frost.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Dos gotas de hielo cristalino (冫) atando en sólido bloque helado todo lo que tocan (东).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 天地苍茫，寒风凛冽。虽然单薄的布鞋早已湿透并冻成了硬块，脚趾痛如针扎，但子路心中只有一个念头：快些回家，让父母不再受冻挨饿。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Tiāndì cāngmáng, hánfēng lǐnliè. Suīrán dānbó de bùxié zǎoyǐ shītòu bìng dòng chéng le yìngkuài, jiǎozhǐ tòng rú zhēnzhā, dàn Zǐlù xīnzhōng zhǐyǒu yí gè niàntou: kuài xiē huíjiā, ràng fùmǔ búzài shòudòng ái'è.
extended_reading_passages.en: The sky was bleak and gales pierced deep. Though his thin cloth shoes were soaked and frozen solid, and his toes stung like needles, Zilu held but one thought: hurry home so his parents would no longer suffer cold and hunger.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la desolada inmensidad, el viento gélido azotaba sin piedad. Aunque sus finos zapatos estaban empapados y congelados en bloques duros, Zilu solo pensaba en volver rápido a casa para que sus padres no sufrieran más hambre ni frío.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在食品保鲜与冷链物流领域，超低温快速冷冻技术发挥着至关重要的作用。该技术能在极短时间内使食品细胞水分快速冻结成微细冰晶，最大限度地锁住食材的原汁原味与营养成分，有效延长了优质农产品的货架期。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài shípǐn bǎoxiān yǔ lěngliàn wùliú lǐngyù, chāodīwēn kuàisù lěngdòng jìshù fāhuī zhe zhìguān-zhòngyào de zuòyòng. Gāi jìshù néng zài jí duǎn shíjiān nèi shǐ shípǐn xìbāo shuǐfèn kuàisù dòngjié chéng wēixì bīngjīng, zuìdà xiàndù de suǒzhù shícái de yuánzhī-yuánwèi yǔ yíngyǎng chéngfèn, yǒuxiào yáncháng le yōuzhì nóngchǎnpǐn de huòjiàqī.
extended_reading_passages.en: In food preservation and cold-chain logistics, ultra-low-temperature flash freezing plays a vital role. Freezing cellular moisture into microscopic crystals locks in nutrients and flavors, extending shelf life.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la logística de frío alimentario, la ultracongelación rápida desempeña un papel clave. Al transformar el agua celular en microcristales helados al instante, preserva el sabor y los nutrientes alargando la vida comercial de los alimentos.

meanings_summary.en: to stop; to pause; to halt; to come to a standstill
meanings_summary.es: detenerse; parar; hacer un alto; cesar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: A traveler halting at a pavilion (停) and settling downward (下) into stillness as rest arrives (来) means you stop completely (停下来).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Un caminante que reposa en el quiosco (停) asentándose (下) hasta alcanzar la quietud (来) se detiene por completo (停下来).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The compound verb phrase combines 停 with the compound directional complement 下来, which metaphorically denotes the transition from fast dynamic motion into stillness and rest.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by neutral tones: tíng xià lái (35-51-35) or in casual rapid speech tíng xia lai (35-0-0).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 停下来 highlights the physical or metaphorical act of halting an ongoing dynamic action to enter rest or reflection.

contrasts.analysis: 停下来 is descriptive and colloquial, emphasizing a living agent halting motion, whereas 停止 is formal, administrative, and absolute.
停下来 can mean stopping without explicit resumption plans, whereas 暂停 strictly denotes a temporary programmatic interruption to resume shortly.
停下来 is voluntary or gradual deceleration, whereas 中断 denotes sudden disruptive severing or breakdown by external factors.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Lacks the person radical 亻 of 停
Similar to 下 with 上 combined
Has slash across vertical stroke unlike 下
Has shorter top horizontal stroke than 来

senses.definition_en: to cease motion or activity and come to a rest
senses.definition_es: detenerse; parar la marcha o actividad
senses.example_phrase: 停下来休息 (stop to rest)

example_sentences.hanzi: 尽管四肢酸痛、疲惫到了极点，但子路不敢停下来歇息，生怕耽搁了时间会让家中父母挨饿受冻。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn sìzhī suāntòng, píbèi dào le jídiǎn, dàn Zǐlù bù gǎn tíng xiàlái xiēxi, shēngpà dānge le shíjiān huì ràng jiāzhōng fùmǔ ái'è shòudòng.
example_sentences.en: Even though his limbs ached and he was exhausted to the limit, Zilu did not dare stop to rest, fearing delay would leave his parents starving in the cold.
example_sentences.es: A pesar de que sus extremidades dolían y el agotamiento era extremo, Zilu no se atrevía a detenerse a descansar, temiendo que la demora dejara a sus padres pasando hambre y frío.

example_sentences.hanzi: 在快节奏的现代都市生活中，我们需要适时停下来静心思考，倾听自己内心真实的渴望与声音。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zài kuàijièzòu de xiàndài dūshì shēnghuó zhōng, wǒmen xūyào shìshí tíng xiàlái jìngxīn sīkǎo, qīngtīng zìjǐ nèixīn zhēnshí de kěwàng yǔ shēngyīn.
example_sentences.en: In fast-paced modern urban life, we need to pause at appropriate times to reflect quietly and listen to our inner true desires and voice.
example_sentences.es: En la vertiginosa vida urbana actual, conviene detenerse a reflexionar con calma de vez en cuando, escuchando la voz y los anhelos más íntimos del alma.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una señal descendente que indica el cese y asentamiento de un movimiento.

character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Ripe grain descending, drawing the motion toward a state of stillness.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Trigo que desciende, atrayendo la acción hacia un estado de reposo presente.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 寒风呼啸如雷，子路两腿酸软得几乎失去了知觉。他多想靠在路旁的树干上停下来喘一口气，但想到空腹等待自己的年迈父母，他又强打精神，咬牙迈出了沉重的脚步。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Hánfēng hūxiào rú léi, Zǐlù liǎng tuǐ suānruǎn de jīhū shīqù le zhījué. Tā duō xiǎng kào zài lùpáng de shùgàn shàng tíng xiàlái chuǎn yì kǒu qì, dàn xiǎngdào kōngfù děngdài zìjǐ de niánmài fùmǔ, tā yòu qiáng dǎ jīngshén, yǎoyá màichū le chénzhòng de jiǎobù.
extended_reading_passages.en: Gales roared like thunder as Zilu's limbs grew numb with exhaustion. He longed to lean against a roadside tree to catch his breath, but thinking of his starving parents, he rallied his spirit and pressed on.
extended_reading_passages.es: El viento aullaba como un trueno y las piernas de Zilu apenas respondían. Deseaba apoyarse en un árbol a tomar aliento, mas al recordar a sus padres hambrientos, cobró ánimo y apretó el paso con entereza.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在工业化与信息化全面加速的时代背景下，“停下来”成为一种难能可贵的生存智慧。这不仅关乎生理机能的休养生息，更意味着个体在纷繁复杂的信息洪流中重新找回专注与清醒，避免在盲目的内卷中迷失自我。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài gōngyèhuà yǔ xìnxīhuà quánmiàn jiāsù de shídài bèijǐng xià, "tíng xiàlái" chéngwéi yì zhǒng nánnéng-kěguì de shēngcún zhìhuì. Zhè bùjǐn guānhū shēnglǐ jīnéng de xiūyǎng-shēngxī, gèng yìwèizhe gètǐ zài fēnfán-fùzá de xìnxī hóngliú zhōng chóngxīn zhǎohuí zhuānzhù yǔ qīngxǐng, bìmiǎn zài mángmù de nèijuǎn zhōng míshī zìwǒ.
extended_reading_passages.en: In an era of accelerating industrialization and data, pausing has become a precious art of living. It concerns not only physiological recuperation, but regaining clarity and focus amidst information overload to avoid burnout.
extended_reading_passages.es: En una era de aceleración constante, saber detenerse es una valiosa sabiduría vital. No solo permite reponer energías físicas, sino recobrar la lucidez y el sosiego en medio del ruido informativo para no perder el rumbo.

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: When a negative barrier (不) blocks your ability to walk or succeed across the crossroads (行), the plan is no good and won't do (不行).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Cuando una barrera negativa (不) frena tu paso en la encrucijada del camino (行), el intento no sirve y no puede ser (不行).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In colloquial Chinese syntax, 不行 possesses great pragmatic versatility, functioning as an emphatic prohibition, an evaluation of incompetence, or an extreme degree complement.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Rising 2nd tone followed by rising 2nd tone: bù xíng -> bú xíng (35-35). 'bù' undergoes tone sandhi before 2nd tone 'xíng' to become 2nd tone.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 不行 indicates that something is unacceptable, unviable, inadequate, or describes extreme degrees of intensity.

contrasts.analysis: 不行 evaluates viability, competence, or quality, whereas 不能 specifically expresses inability due to external restrictions or objective physical rules.
不行 is blunt, oral, and categorical, whereas 不可以 is polite and standard for denying permission or instructing rules.
不行 can function as a predicate adjective, adverbial complement, or exclamation, whereas 不成 is primarily used at the end of rhetorical questions.

example_sentences.hanzi: 面对山路上狂风暴雪的凶猛阻击，同行的脚夫劝子路歇脚，子路却连连摇头说：“天黑前赶不回家绝对不行！”
example_sentences.pinyin: Miànduì shānlù shàng kuángfēng-bàoxuě de xiōngměng zǔjī, tóngxíng de jiǎofū quàn Zǐlù xiējiǎo, Zǐlù què liánlián yáotóu shuō: "Tiānhēi qián gǎn bù huí jiā juéduì bùxíng!"
example_sentences.en: Facing the fierce onslaught of the blizzard, a fellow porter urged Zilu to rest, but Zilu shook his head: "Failing to reach home before dark is out of the question!"
example_sentences.es: Frente al azote de la ventisca en el sendero, un arriero le sugirió hacer un alto, pero Zilu negó con la cabeza: "¡No llegar a casa antes del anochecer es inaceptable!".

example_sentences.hanzi: 该方案在抗震设防与消防疏散指标上存在多处重大隐患，安全评估专家一致判定绝对不行，必须推倒重来。
example_sentences.pinyin: Gāi fāng'àn zài kàngzhèn shèfáng yǔ xiāofáng shūsàn zhǐbiāo shàng cúnzài duō chù zhòngdà yǐnhuàn, ānquán pínggū zhuānjiā yízhì pàndìng juéduì bùxíng, bìxū tuīdǎo-chónglái.
example_sentences.en: The proposal contained major hazards in seismic and fire evacuation metrics; safety experts unanimously declared it unacceptable, requiring a complete redesign.
example_sentences.es: La propuesta presentaba graves riesgos en resistencia sísmica y evacuación; los inspectores dictaminaron que no servía en absoluto y debía rediseñarse desde cero.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 虽然寒气逼人，两腿冻得发抖，但子路心里清楚：如果自己半途停下，老迈的双亲今晚就无米下锅。他不断告诫自己：“绝不行停下来，哪怕再冷再累也要赶回去！”
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Suīrán hánqì-bīrén, liǎng tuǐ dòng de fādǒu, dàn Zǐlù xīnlǐ qīngchu: rúguǒ zìjǐ bàntú tíngxià, lǎomài de shuāngqīn jīnwǎn jiù wú mǐ xià guō. Tā búduàn gàojiè zìjǐ: "Jué bùxíng tíng xiàlái, nǎpà zài lěng zài lèi yě yào gǎn huíqù!"
extended_reading_passages.en: Though the cold pierced deep and his legs shook, Zilu knew that if he halted, his parents would have no rice for dinner. He told himself repeatedly: "Stopping is out of the question; no matter how cold or tired, I must reach home!"
extended_reading_passages.es: Aunque el frío calaba hasta los huesos y sus piernas temblaban, Zilu sabía que si se detenía sus padres no tendrían qué cenar. Se repetía sin cesar: "¡De ninguna manera puedo parar; por más frío y cansancio que sienta, he de llegar!".

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 现代项目质量管理遵循严苛的标准红线，任何细微的数据偏差与工序缺陷在验收环节都被判定为“不行”。唯有建立全流程零缺陷的质量监控体系，杜绝马虎敷衍的侥幸心理，才能打造出经得起严苛市场检验的卓越产品。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Xiàndài xiàngmù zhìliàng guǎnlǐ zūnxún yánkē de biāozhǔn hóngxiàn, rènhé xìwēi de shùjù piānchā yǔ gōngxù quēxiàn zài yànshōu huánjié dōu bèi pàndìng wéi "bùxíng". Wéiyǒu jiànlì quánliúchéng líng-quēxiàn de zhìliàng jiānkòng tǐxì, dùjué mǎhu fūyǎn de jiǎoxìng xīnlǐ, cáinéng dǎzào chū jīngdeqǐ yánkē shìchǎng jiǎnyàn de zhuóyuè chǎnpǐn.
extended_reading_passages.en: Modern quality control enforces strict red lines; any minute discrepancy or defect is ruled unacceptable. Only by establishing zero-defect oversight and eliminating complacency can organizations deliver products that survive scrutiny.
extended_reading_passages.es: La gestión moderna de calidad impone estrictos controles; cualquier fallo o desviación es calificado como inaceptable. Solo mediante una vigilancia rigurosa y sin tolerar la desidia se obtienen productos de excelencia que triunfan en el mercado.

meanings_summary.en: to hurry on with one's journey; to hasten on one's way
meanings_summary.es: apresurarse en el camino; apurar el paso; viajar de prisa

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Racing your feet (赶) with urgent speed across the highway (路) means you hurry on with your journey (赶路).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Apurar el paso (赶) con apremio a lo largo del sendero (路) significa viajar de prisa (赶路).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In pre-modern travel, 赶路 carried existential urgency, as failing to reach an inn or shelter before sundown left travelers exposed to bandits, cold, and predators.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Dipping 3rd tone followed by falling 4th tone: gǎn lù (214-51). 'gǎn' dips softly before snapping cleanly into high-falling 'lù'.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 赶路 emphasizes accelerating one's pace or traveling through difficult hours to arrive before an urgent deadline.

contrasts.analysis: 上路 denotes the initial commencement of a journey, whereas 赶路 denotes the rushed speed of travel while already mid-course.
赶路 focuses on the grueling process of rapid traveling itself, whereas 赶往 takes a specific destination as its direct object.
赶路 stresses urgency, hurry, and fatigue, whereas 行路 is classical and objective, describing simply walking or traveling on a road.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Has 己 on the right of 走 instead of 旱
Has 召 on the right of 走 instead of 旱

Has 尚 on the right of 走

etymological_cognates.gloss_en: work overtime to beat a deadline

senses.definition_en: to travel in haste to reach a destination before a deadline or dusk
senses.definition_es: apresurarse en el camino; apurar el paso en un viaje
senses.example_phrase: 连夜赶路 (hurry on journey through the night)

example_sentences.hanzi: 担心年迈体弱的双亲在家中挨饿受冻，年轻的子路哪怕疲惫不堪，也依然顶着风雪星夜赶路。
example_sentences.pinyin: Dānxīn niánmài tǐruò de shuāngqīn zài jiāzhōng ái'è shòudòng, niánqīng de Zǐlù nǎpà píbèi-bùkān, yě yīrán dǐngzhe fēngxuě xīngyè gǎnlù.
example_sentences.en: Anxious that his frail aging parents were starving in the cold at home, young Zilu, exhausted though he was, hurried on through wind and snow by night.
example_sentences.es: Temiendo que sus ancianos y débiles padres pasaran frío y hambre en casa, el joven Zilu, aun rendido de cansancio, apuró el paso noche y día bajo el temporal.

example_sentences.hanzi: 为了赶在强台风登陆前抵达安全避风港，巡逻船队加足马力，争分夺秒地劈波斩浪加紧赶路。
example_sentences.pinyin: Wèile gǎn zài qiáng táifēng dēnglù qián dǐdá ānquán bìfēnggǎng, xúnluó chuánduì jiāzú mǎlì, zhēngfēn-duómiǎo de pībō-zhǎnlàng jiājǐn gǎnlù.
example_sentences.en: To reach a safe haven before the super typhoon made landfall, the patrol fleet steamed at full speed, cleaving waves to hurry on their journey.
example_sentences.es: Para llegar a un puerto seguro antes de que tocara tierra el tifón, la flotilla de patrulla aceleró a toda máquina, cortando las olas contra reloj en su travesía.

character_decomposition.sound_component: 旱 (hàn / drought / sun over shield phonetic)
character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 走 (running motion) + 旱 (phonetic/urgent sun scorch), originally running swiftly to pursue prey or arrive before time expires.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Running feet (走) racing beneath scorching dry skies (旱) to catch up before dusk.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Pies que corren (走) bajo el sol ardiente (旱) para alcanzar el destino antes del anochecer.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 足 (foot) + 各 (arrival), representing the highway or mountain trail trodden by travelers.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Feet (足) treading continuous steps across the winding path (各).
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Pies firmes (足) avanzando acompasados por senderos sinuosos (各).

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 山道上的积雪越来越深，风雪如怒涛般咆哮。年轻的子路顾不得擦拭脸上的冰碴，双手紧紧扣住沉重的米袋，一刻也不敢耽搁地在大雪中摸黑赶路。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Shāndào shàng de jīxuě yuèláiyuè shēn, fēngxuě rú nùtāo bān páoxiào. Niánqīng de Zǐlù gùbude cāshì liǎn shàng de bīngchá, shuāngshǒu jǐnjǐn kòuzhù chénzhòng de mǐdài, yíkè yě bù gǎn dāngē de zài dàxuě zhōng mōhēi gǎnlù.
extended_reading_passages.en: Deep snow piled along the pass and gales roared like tidal waves. Unable even to brush off ice crusting his face, Zilu clutched his rice sack and hurried on through darkness without a moment's pause.
extended_reading_passages.es: La nieve se acumulaba en el desfiladero y la ventisca rugía como una tempestad marina. Sin detenerse a quitarse la escarcha del rostro, Zilu aferró el pesado saco y apuró el paso en la penumbra.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在古代交通闭塞的漫长岁月中，“赶路”是行旅者生命状态的最真实写照。那些为了家庭生计、科举功名或探望至亲而星夜兼程的匆匆行者，在漫长的跋涉中将深沉的情感转化为丈量大地的坚实脚步。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài gǔdài jiāotōng bìsè de màncháng suìyuè zhōng, "gǎnlù" shì xínglǚzhě shēngmìng zhuàngtài de zuì zhēnshí xiězjiào. Nàxiē wèile jiātíng shēngjì, kējǔ gōngmíng huò tànwàng zhìqīn ér xīngyè-jiānchéng de cōngcōng xíngzhě, zài màncháng de báshè zhōng jiāng shēnchén de qínggǎn zhuǎnhuà wéi zhàngliáng dàdì de jiānshí jiǎobù.
extended_reading_passages.en: In ancient times of isolated transport, hurrying along roads reflected the authentic plight of travelers. Those hastening day and night for livelihood, exams, or kin turned profound devotion into footsteps measuring the earth.
extended_reading_passages.es: En los siglos de precarios caminos, apurar el paso reflejaba la viva condición del viajero. Aquellos que marchaban sin tregua por el sustento familiar, exámenes o amor filial convertían sus afectos en huellas que medían la tierra.

meanings_summary.en: to remain; to be left over; remainder; surplus
meanings_summary.es: sobrar; quedar; restar; remanente

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: What a cutting knife (刂) leaves behind on the table to settle downward (下) is the remainder (剩下).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Lo que el corte (刂) deja apartado posándose hacia abajo (下) es lo que sobra o queda (剩下).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In traditional Chinese frugality, not leaving a single grain of rice behind is drilled into children as moral respect for farmers' backbreaking sweat.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two consecutive falling 4th tones: shèng xià (51-51) or shèng xia (51-0) when unstressed as a complement.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 剩下 emphasizes the residual surplus or remainder lingering after consumption, departure, or expenditure.

contrasts.analysis: 剩下 is conversational, oral, and verbal, whereas 剩余 is formal, written, and economic/statistical.
剩下 focuses on the quantity that is leftover or not consumed, whereas 留下 emphasizes intentional retention, preservation, or staying behind.
剩下 simply reports the objective remainder, whereas 多余 carries a negative evaluation meaning redundant or superfluous.

look_alikes.distinction_note: Left component of 剩 without the knife radical 刂
Has vertical strokes parting in the middle, lacking 禾 top
Has 木+爻 on the left of 刂 instead of 乘
Has 艹 (grass) atop 开 on the left of 刂

senses.definition_en: to remain behind or be left over after part has been used, taken, or consumed
senses.definition_es: sobrar; quedar; restar de una cantidad o grupo
senses.example_phrase: 剩下的时间 (the remaining time)

example_sentences.hanzi: 扣除购买这一大袋白米所花费的铜钱，子路将剩下的一点碎银子小心翼翼地缝进了棉袄内衬。
example_sentences.pinyin: Kòuchú gòumǎi zhè yí dà dài báimǐ suǒ huāfèi de tóngqián, Zǐlù jiāng shèngxià de yìdiǎn suìyínzi xiǎoxīn-yìyì de féng jìn le mián'ǎo nèichèn.
example_sentences.en: Deducting the copper coins spent on purchasing this large sack of rice, Zilu carefully sewed the remaining broken silver into the lining of his cotton coat.
example_sentences.es: Descontadas las monedas de cobre gastadas en la compra del gran saco de arroz, Zilu cosió con esmero los pocos trozos de plata sobrantes en el forro de su abrigo.

example_sentences.hanzi: 经过前期艰苦卓绝的技术攻关，摆在整个项目团队面前的只剩下系统兼容性联调这一道最终关卡。
example_sentences.pinyin: Jīngguò qiánqī jiānkǔ-zhuójué de jìshù gōngguān, bǎi zài zhěnggè xiàngmù tuánduì miànqián de zhǐ shèngxià xìtǒng jiānróngxìng liántiáo zhè yí dào zuìzhōng guānkǎ.
example_sentences.en: After overcoming grueling technical hurdles in early phases, only the final hurdle of joint system compatibility debugging remains before the project team.
example_sentences.es: Tras superar extenuantes desafíos técnicos en las fases iniciales, ante el equipo del proyecto solo queda el último obstáculo: la depuración conjunta de compatibilidad del sistema.

the only surviving fruit; solitary survivor of a past era

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 乘 (chariot/tally phonetic) + 刂 (cutting knife), originally cutting off surplus material or what remains after division.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A cutting blade (刂) carving away parts while leaving a surplus amount (乘) intact.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una cuchilla (刂) que recorta porciones dejando intacto el remanente (乘).

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Indicative character pointing downwards, functioning as a resultative verbal complement denoting remaining settled behind.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An indicator line marking what settles downward and stays behind.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una señal indicativa que marca lo que queda asentado y permanece atrás.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 子路在富人家中舂米多日，除了换来那袋白米，还剩下了几块散碎银子。他把剩下的一切都视作家中父母度过严冬的命根子，在漫天飞雪中片刻不敢耽误。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǐlù zài fùjiā zhòng chōngmǐ duō rì, chúle huànlái nà dài báimǐ, hái shèngxià le jǐ kuài sǎnsuì yínzi. Tā bǎ shèngxià de yíqiè dōu shìzuò jiāzhōng fùmǔ dùguò yándōng de mìnggēnzi, zài màntiān fēixuě zhōng piànkè bù gǎn dānwù.
extended_reading_passages.en: Pounding rice for days in the rich manor, Zilu earned a sack of white rice and had several pieces of broken silver remaining. Viewing all that remained as his parents' lifeline for winter, he dared not tarry a moment.
extended_reading_passages.es: Tras moler grano en la mansión, a Zilu le sobraron unos trozos de plata tras adquirir el arroz. Viendo en ese remanente el sustento vital de sus padres para el crudo invierno, no se demoró un instante en la nieve.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在宏观资源配置与循环经济理论中，如何将工业生产中剩下的废弃副产品转化为高附加值的新型环保建材，是实现绿色转型的重要突破口。变废为宝不仅能最大化地榨取资源潜能，更是从源头上根治环境污染的治本之策。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài hóngguān zīyuán pèizhì yǔ xúnhuán jīngjì lǐlùn zhōng, rúhé jiāng gōngyè shēngchǎn zhōng shèngxià de fèiqì fùchǎnpǐn zhuǎnhuà wéi gāofùjiāzhí de xīnxíng huánbǎo jiàncái, shì shíxiàn lǜsè zhuǎnxíng de zhòngyào tūpòkǒu. Biàn fèi wéi bǎo bùjǐn néng zuìdàhuà de zhàqǔ zīyuán qiánnéng, gèng shì cóng yuántóu shàng gēnzhì huánjìng wūrǎn de zhìběn zhī cè.
extended_reading_passages.en: In resource allocation and circular economics, converting residual byproducts from industrial manufacturing into high-value green building materials is key to green transition. Turning waste into treasure cures pollution at its root.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la economía circular, aprovechar los subproductos que sobran de la manufactura industrial para crear materiales ecológicos de alto valor es crucial. Transformar residuos en recursos optimiza el potencial material y ataja la contaminación desde el origen.

meanings_summary.en: to hand over; to entrust; to deliver to
meanings_summary.es: entregar; poner en manos de; confiar a

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Crossing paths (交) to deliver tightly bound provisions (给) means to hand over and entrust (交给).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Salir al cruce (交) para entregar un atadillo de seda (给) simboliza entregar en propias manos (交给).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: In Confucian filial piety, the solemn act of 交给 symbolizes not merely handing over material food, but delivering one's filial devotion, loyalty, and heart to one's lineage.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: High level 1st tone followed by a 3rd tone dipped low: jiāo gěi (55-214).

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 交给 emphasizes transferring custody, physical possession, or moral responsibility from one party into the direct care of another.

contrasts.analysis: 交给 emphasizes the shift of ownership, duty, or custody, whereas 递给 focuses strictly on the physical motion of extending one's arm to pass an item.
交给 applies broadly to goods, duties, and trust, whereas 付给 is restricted to monetary payment and compensation.
交给 implies an obligation, duty, or returning of custody, whereas 送给 denotes a voluntary gift or generous donation.

senses.definition_en: to transfer physical custody, possession, responsibility, or authority into someone's hands
senses.definition_es: entregar; encomendar; poner en manos o custodia de otra persona
senses.example_phrase: 交给父母 (hand over to parents)

example_sentences.hanzi: 子路一进家门，便迫不及待地将装满百斤白米的大口袋稳稳交给了倚在床头的双亲。
example_sentences.pinyin: Zǐlù yí jìn jiāmén, biàn pòbùjídài de jiāng zhuāngmǎn bǎijīn báimǐ de dà kǒudài wěnwěn jiāogěi le yǐ zài chuángtóu de shuāngqīn.
example_sentences.en: The moment Zilu crossed the threshold, he eagerly handed over the heavy sack of white rice securely to his parents resting on the bed.
example_sentences.es: En cuanto Zilu cruzó el umbral, entregó con premura y firmeza el pesado saco de arroz a sus padres que reposaban en la cama.

example_sentences.hanzi: 项目经理在例会上郑重决定，将下一季度核心算法架构优化的重任交给出色的青年骨干团队。
example_sentences.pinyin: Xiàngmù jīnglǐ zài lìhuì shàng zhèngzhòng juédìng, jiāng xià yí jìdù héxīn suànfǎ jiàgòu yōuhuà de zhòngrèn jiāogěi chūsè de qīngnián gǔgàn tuánduì.
example_sentences.en: At the regular meeting, the project manager solemnly decided to entrust next quarter's core algorithm optimization to the outstanding young backbone team.
example_sentences.es: En la reunión regular, el director de proyecto decidió solemnemente confiar la optimización del algoritmo central del próximo trimestre al sobresaliente equipo de jóvenes líderes.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Pictogram of a person standing with legs crossed in an exchange or meeting, developing into handing over or mutual interaction.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: A figure crossing paths to hand over and exchange goods.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Una persona que cruza sus pasos para entregar e intercambiar pertenencias.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Phono-semantic compound: 纟 (silk cord tying a package) + 合 (fitting together), meaning to supply, equip, or pass along tightly bound supplies.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: Tying silk threads (纟) around provisions to fit together (合) and give them to someone in need.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Atar hilos de seda (纟) a los víveres para que encajen (合) y dárselos al necesitado.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 子路顶着刺骨风雪将白米背回家中。他顾不上拍去肩头厚厚的积雪，恭敬地将米袋和碎银子全部交给了双亲。老母亲抚摸着他冻僵的双手，满含热泪地笑了。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zǐlù dǐngzhe cìgǔ fēngxuě jiāng báimǐ bēi huí jiāzhōng. Tā gùbushàng pāi qù jiāntóu hòuhòu de jīxuě, gōngjìng de jiāng mǐdài hé suìyínzi quánbù jiāogěi le shuāngqīn. Lǎo mǔqīn fǔmōzhe tā dòngjiāng de shuāngshǒu, mǎnhán rèlèi de xiào le.
extended_reading_passages.en: Braving the freezing snowstorm, Zilu carried the rice home. Without even brushing snow from his shoulders, he respectfully handed the rice sack and silver to his parents. His mother caressed his frozen hands and smiled through tears.
extended_reading_passages.es: Desafiando la gélida ventisca, Zilu cargó el arroz hasta casa. Sin sacudirse la nieve, entregó respetuosamente el saco y las monedas a sus padres. Su anciana madre acarició sus manos congeladas y sonrió entre lágrimas.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在现代软件工程与敏捷研发流程中，系统集成测试完毕后，开发团队必须按照严格的标准将稳定版本和详尽的运维文档正式交给出海支持团队。明确的交接界面不仅有助于各部门厘清权责，更能最大限度地降低生产环境出现重大技术故障的潜在风险。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài xiàndài ruǎnjiàn gōngchéng yǔ mǐnjié yánfā liúchéng zhōng, xìtǒng jíchéng cèshì wánbì hòu, kāifā tuánduì bìxū ànzhào yángé de biāozhǔn jiāng wěndìng bǎnběn yǔ xiángjìn de yùnwéi wéndàng zhèngshì jiāogěi chūhǎi zhīchí tuánduì. Míngquè de jiāojiē jièmiàn bùjǐn yǒuzhùyú gè bùmén líqīng quánzé, gèng néng zuìdà xiàndù de jiàngdī shēngchǎn huánjìng chūxiàn zhòngdà jìshù gùzhàng de qiánzài fēngxiǎn.
extended_reading_passages.en: In modern software engineering and agile development, after integration testing, developers must officially hand over the stable build and documentation to operations. A clear handover interface clarifies responsibilities across teams and minimizes the risk of production failure.
extended_reading_passages.es: En la ingeniería de software moderna y las metodologías ágiles, el equipo de desarrollo debe entregar oficialmente la versión estable y la documentación técnica al equipo de operaciones. Delimitar con rigor esta entrega define responsabilidades y previene fallos críticos en producción.

meanings_summary.en: to have a reunion; to reunite; family reunion
meanings_summary.es: reunirse (la familia); reencontrarse; unión familiar

mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_en: Enclosing everyone in a group (团) within a complete round circle like the full moon (圆) creates a heartwarming family reunion (团圆).
mnemonics_and_roots.composite_memory_hook_es: Encerrar a todos en un abrazo grupal (团) dentro de un círculo pleno como la luna llena (圆) representa el reencuentro familiar (团圆).
mnemonics_and_roots.cultural_and_cognitive_roots: The circular motif in 团圆 echoes the Chinese philosophical concept of 圆满 (perfection and completeness), embodied in the full moon on Mid-Autumn night and eating round dumplings or mooncakes.
mnemonics_and_roots.tone_sandhi_and_pitch_modulation: Two rising 2nd tones: tuán yuán (35-35). Both syllables rise gracefully with sustained melodic cadence.

semantic_boundary_contrasts.core_nuance: 团圆 specifically conveys the emotional, intimate joy of family members or loved ones reuniting in harmonious completeness after separation.

contrasts.analysis: 团圆 carries profound emotional and cultural weight regarding family reunion and completeness, whereas 聚会 is an everyday social gathering of friends, colleagues, or clubs.
团圆 emphasizes the warm, unified state of the whole family together, whereas 重逢 highlights the specific moment of crossing paths again after parting.
团圆 is a culturally solemn reunion of kin, whereas 见面 is an ordinary meeting or casual encounter between people.

senses.definition_en: to reunite and gather together happily after a period of separation (especially family members)
senses.definition_es: reunirse alegremente los miembros de una familia tras una separación
senses.example_phrase: 全家团圆 (the whole family reunites)

example_sentences.hanzi: 炊烟在简陋的茅屋顶上袅袅升起，一家三口围坐在热气腾腾的白米饭前，享受着风雪夜中最珍贵的全家团圆。
example_sentences.pinyin: Chuīyān zài jiǎnlòu de máowū dǐng shàng niǎoniǎo shēngqǐ, yì jiā sān kǒu wéizuò zài rèqì-téngténg de báimǐfàn qián, xiǎngshòuzhe fēngxuě yè zhōng zuì zhēnguì de quánjiā tuányuán.
example_sentences.en: Cooking smoke curled up gently from the thatched roof as the family of three gathered around steaming white rice, cherishing the most precious family reunion on this snowy night.
example_sentences.es: El humo de la cocina se elevaba sobre la humilde choza mientras la familia de tres se sentaba ante el arroz humeante, gozando de la más preciada reunión familiar en esa noche de nieve.

example_sentences.hanzi: 每逢中秋佳节，无论身在何方，无数游子都会竭尽全力赶回家乡，只为与期盼已久的父母共度一个温馨祥和的团圆之夜。
example_sentences.pinyin: Měi féng Zhōngqiū jiājié, wúlùn shēn zài héfāng, wúshù yóuzǐ dōuhuì jiéjìn quánlì gǎnhuí jiāxiāng, zhǐ wèi yǔ qīpàn-yǐjiǔ de fùmǔ gòngdù yí gè wēnxīn xiánghé de tuányuán zhī yè.
example_sentences.en: Every Mid-Autumn Festival, no matter where they are, countless wanderers strive their utmost to return home to share a warm, peaceful reunion evening with their waiting parents.
example_sentences.es: En cada Fiesta del Medio Otoño, sin importar la lejanía, innumerables viajeros hacen lo imposible por regresar a casa y compartir una cálida noche de reencuentro con sus ancianos padres.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Enclosure 囗 encircling members tightly into a cohesive sphere or cluster, representing intimate solidarity.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An enclosure (囗) drawing talented loved ones (才) together into a warm circular group.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un recinto (囗) que abraza a los seres queridos (才) en un círculo de afecto y unión.

character_decomposition.etymology_and_mnemonic: Enclosure 囗 wrapping around 员, depicting the round, complete shape of an ancient jade disc or the full moon, symbolizing completeness.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_en: An enclosing circle (囗) embracing all family members (员) into harmonious wholeness like the full moon.
character_decomposition.visual_mnemonic_story_es: Un círculo exterior (囗) que envuelve a cada miembro (员) en una esfera perfecta como la luna llena.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 外面北风呼啸、天寒地冻，草屋内却炭火微明、饭香扑鼻。子路为父母盛上洁白的米饭。看到儿子平安归来，父母笑逐颜开，这风雪夜中的全家团圆胜过了一切荣华富贵。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Wàimiàn běifēng hūxiào, tiānhán-dìdòng, cǎowū nèi què tànhuǒ wēimíng, fànxiāng pūbí. Zǐlù wèi fùmǔ chéng shàng jiébái de mǐfàn. Kàndào érzi píng'ān guīlái, fùmǔ xiàozhúyánkāi, zhè fēngxuě yè zhōng de quánjiā tuányuán shèngguò le yíqiè rónghuá-fùguì.
extended_reading_passages.en: Outside, freezing winds howled, but inside the hut embers glowed and rice aroma filled the air. Zilu served bowls of pure white rice to his parents. Seeing their son return safe brought joyful smiles; this blizzard family reunion surpassed all worldly riches.
extended_reading_passages.es: Afuera aullaba el viento gélido, pero en la choza brillaban las brasas y flotaba el dulce aroma del arroz. Zilu sirvió el blanco manjar a sus padres. Ver a su hijo regresar sano colmó sus rostros de gozo; este reencuentro familiar en la nieve superó toda la riqueza terrenal.

extended_reading_passages.hanzi: 在当代跨国劳动力流动与快速城市化背景下，如何保障数以千万计在异乡打拼的建设者拥有阖家团圆的权利，成为了社会政策考量的重要议题。便捷的高铁网络和逐渐延长的带薪年假制度，正让曾经奢侈漫长的归乡团圆之旅变得更加触手可及。
extended_reading_passages.pinyin: Zài dāngdài kuàguó láodònglì liúdòng yǔ kuàisù chéngshìhuà bèijǐng xià, rúhé bǎozhàng shù yǐ qiānwàn jì zài yìxiāng dǎpīn de jiànshèzhě yǒngyǒu héjiā tuányuán de quánlì, chéngwéile shèhuì zhèngcè kǎoliáng de zhòngyào yìtí. Biànjié de gāotiě wǎngluò yǔ zhújiàn yáncháng de dàixīn niánjià zhìdù, zhèng ràng céngjīng shēchǐ màncháng de guīxiāng tuányuán zhī lǚ biànde gèngjiā chùshǒu-kějí.
extended_reading_passages.en: In the era of labor mobility and rapid urbanization, securing the right to family reunion for millions of migrant workers has become an important social policy issue. High-speed rail networks and extended paid leave are making the once-luxurious reunion journey increasingly accessible.
extended_reading_passages.es: En el contexto de la migración laboral y la urbanización acelerada, garantizar el derecho a la reunión familiar a millones de trabajadores es un reto clave de política social. Las redes de trenes de alta velocidad y las vacaciones remuneradas hacen que el ansiado regreso al hogar sea hoy más accesible.
